techniques.name: 100-Type Guanyin Bodhisattva
techniques.summary: A prayer completed faster than violence can begin: a colossal golden Guanyin answers with a hundred hands — and at the end, the Zero Hand converts everything into light.

arts.name: Prayer Palm: Focused
arts.text: a golden palm on the foe nearest the cursor: Prayer Die + CE mod, plus one more Prayer Die

arts.name: Prayer Palm: Driving
arts.text: Prayer Die + CE mod and the foe is hurled 30 ft away (Str)

arts.name: Prayer Palm: Grasping
arts.text: Prayer Die + CE mod and the foe is held (Str) for a round

arts.name: First Hand: Heaven's Descent
arts.text: the Guanyin manifests above a foe: 2 Prayer Dice + CE mod, driven 20 ft down and held

arts.name: Third Hand: Converging Mercy
arts.text: two palms at one foe; if both land it's restrained until your next turn

arts.name: Ninety-Ninth Hand
arts.text: PB CE · 2×PB palms spread among foes in reach, 2 Prayer Dice each

quick.name: Faster Than Sound
quick.text: one more Prayer Palm, in the same breath

maximum.name: Zero Hand: Final Gratitude
maximum.text: all CE (min 15) · one foe within 600 ft takes 2×PB d12 + CE mod, plus d12 more for every CE spent, ignoring defense · afterwards CE 0 and exhausted

passives.name: Palm Reach
passives.text: 60 ft · 120 ft at L6 · 300 ft at L11 · 600 ft at L20, and palms hit harder at each step.

passives.name: Prayer Before Violence
passives.text: Automatic, 1 CE + palm, once per round: when a foe in reach hits you, the statue answers with a palm first.

passives.name: Guarding Palm
passives.text: Automatic, 1 CE, once per round: a heavy hit is reduced by a Prayer Die + CE mod.

passives.name: Prayer Outside Time
passives.text: Every round, one free palm strikes the nearest foe in reach (1 CE).

feats.name: Unbroken Mudra
feats.text: The gesture completes itself: once a round, a palm that lands flows on to a second foe within 15 ft.

feats.name: Hundred-and-First Hand: Lotus Prison
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (4 CE): three palms close on the foe at your cursor like petals — 2 Prayer Dice each, and it's held for 10 s.

feats.name: The Hundredth Name
feats.text: Your own hand, two intentions in one: every palm also grasps, holding its foe a moment.

domain.name: Temple of Ten Thousand Gratitudes
domain.sureHit: Hundredfold Benediction: 2×PB Prayer Dice + CE mod and grasped until the next round, every round

techniques.name: Anti-Cursed Grimoire
techniques.summary: Zero cursed energy, and swords that unmake the premise curses are built on. Anti-Energy fuels the Demon-Slayer, Black Form, and the devil's union.

arts.name: Demon-Dweller Slash
arts.text: 1 Anti-Energy · a 60-ft anti-energy slash, 2 HR Dice

arts.name: Demon-Destroyer
arts.text: 2 Anti-Energy · cut away every curse on you, and strip the foe in reach of its buffs

arts.name: Black Divider
arts.text: 2 Anti-Energy · the sword lengthens into a 20-ft arc: weapon damage to each, +3 HR Dice to spellcasters

arts.name: Demon-Slasher Katana
arts.text: 3 Anti-Energy · a selective 60-ft line, 5 HR Dice

arts.name: Devil Union
arts.text: 4 Anti-Energy, 1 minute (once per long rest; twice at L18): flight, speed, half damage from projectiles

quick.name: Black Form
quick.text: 2 Anti-Energy, 1 minute: +speed, double jumps, hits weaken a caster's attacks

maximum.name: Infinite Slash Equinox
maximum.text: all Anti-Energy (min 6), once per long rest · a 120-ft line, 8 HR Dice to each foe

passives.name: Zero CE
passives.text: Anti-Energy = level + PB (doubled at L20); it returns after a long rest or two minutes out of combat.

passives.name: Demon-Slayer Sword
passives.text: Melee hits on foes that cast (anything that has fired an attack) deal +1 HR Die. Reaction, 1 Anti-Energy, once per round: block a projectile with the flat, halving it.

feats.name: Bull Thrust
feats.text: In Black Form, a melee blow landed at a full run drives the anti-cursed sword home: two HR Dice more, and the foe is thrown back (once a round).

feats.name: Sword Flight
feats.text: You ride the sword: while Black Form lasts you fly (hold Jump).

feats.name: Liebe's Partner
feats.text: When Devil Union ends, the departing devil's anti-magic discharges: every foe within 30 ft is blinded and fights weaker for 10 s.

techniques.name: Battle Waltz
techniques.summary: Spinning tops with brutally simple orders. Their randomness is area denial — and the dancer becomes a top too.

arts.name: Battle Waltz
arts.text: 2 × PB tops swarm a 20-ft area within 60 ft for 30 s: foes inside stumble · at most 4 × PB swarm tops at once, the oldest stop

arts.name: Shotgun Blues
arts.text: your tops fire as one: a 60-ft line, 5 Top Dice

arts.name: Tornado Top
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: spin your own body

quick.name: Dancing Top
quick.text: launch a top toward the cursor; it spins, ricochets and strikes whatever's near (a Top Die) · up to 3 + PB loose tops, the oldest stops

maximum.name: Fifty-Top Funeral
maximum.text: fifty spectral tops in five swarms around the cursor for 30 s: a Top Die to whatever they touch (a new Funeral ends the last)

passives.name: Tops
passives.text: Each top hits for a Top Die, and tops hit harder at L6, L11 and L18. Loose tops spin 30 s (45 s at L11).

passives.name: Tornado Top
passives.text: Bonus, 3 CE, Focus 1 minute (art below): +4 defense, no knockback, anything that touches you takes a Top Die; Spinning Guard (2 CE) blunts a heavy hit by PB Top Dice.

feats.name: Low Waltz
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE) sends a top within 30 ft of the foe at your cursor spinning into its feet: a Top Die, and it trips (a nimble foe keeps its feet).

feats.name: Blue Shot
feats.text: One dancer spent for a louder note: Shotgun Blues shatters one of its tops for 2 more Top Dice.

techniques.name: Bungee Gum & Texture Surprise
techniques.summary: Aura with the properties of rubber and gum: it sticks to anything, stretches impossibly far, and snaps back exactly when you tell it to.

arts.name: Bungee Gum
arts.text: fire a strand up to 60 ft; it sticks to an enemy or surface (3 strands, 6 at L11)

arts.name: Detach
arts.text: let go of every strand

arts.name: Texture Surprise
arts.text: your skin becomes wallpaper: enemies lose track of you until you attack or are touched

quick.name: Contract
quick.text: snap the newest strand back (L11: every strand): fly to a surface, or slam into a heavy foe for 2d8 + CE mod · a light foe is yanked to you and takes 2d8

maximum.name: Gum Storm
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute · gum erupts within 60 ft: foes are stuck (Str) and slowed; Contract yanks the nearest stuck foe

passives.name: Rubber and gum
passives.text: Strands stretch 60 ft, then pull back like rubber.

passives.name: Slingshot
passives.text: Contracting flings you up to 90 ft. A strand anchored above you means no fall damage.

passives.name: Web of Strings
passives.text: 6 strands, and Contract snaps every one at once.

passives.name: Prosthetic Gum
passives.text: Automatic, 3 CE, once per round: a killing blow leaves you at 1 life instead.

passives.name: Post-Mortem Heartbeat
passives.text: Once per long rest: when you die, the gum squeezes your heart — you stand back up at half life a round later.

feats.name: Tripwire
feats.text: Your strands are tripwires: anything that comes within 30 ft of one is revealed to you.

feats.name: Bungee Parachute
feats.text: The shimmer in the air is anchor enough: falls never hurt you, and holding Down while you fall drifts you down gently.

domain.name: Playground of Strings
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is stuck by a strand that can't be detached · Contract pulls a stuck foe 20 ft

techniques.name: Chronological Reserve
techniques.summary: Time is a currency. Steal seconds from your enemies, store them as Time Units, and spend them to accelerate, freeze, rewind, or restore.

arts.name: Stasis Sphere
arts.text: 3 TU · a foe within 60 ft is set aside — held and helpless for a round (Con)

arts.name: Accelerate
arts.text: 5 TU, once per round · an extra action now: your next cast is ready at once and you attack faster for a round

arts.name: Age to Dust
arts.text: 8 TU · 8 Time Dice on a foe within 60 ft, and its maximum life shrinks by half the damage

arts.name: Chrono Anastasis
arts.text: all TU (min 15), once per long rest · rewind yourself to the start of the round: life and place

arts.name: Archive: AGE / FREEZE / RETURN
arts.text: choose what your Domain declares each round

quick.name: Chrono Step
quick.text: 2 TU · attend a different moment: a short untouchable slip toward the cursor

maximum.name: The Future I Refuse
maximum.text: automatic, once per long rest, 12 CE + 12 TU: when you'd die, you're rewound to the start of the round

passives.name: Time Theft
passives.text: Once per round, a hit steals time: the foe is slowed and you gain 2 TU (1 CE). TU max = 2 × level + CE mod; a long rest starts you at your level in TU.

passives.name: Stored Future
passives.text: Automatic, 4 CE + 4 TU, once per round: a blow that would land never happened.

passives.name: Time Emperor
passives.text: TU max doubles; combat starts with at least 10 TU; theft steals 2 more.

domain.name: Archive of the Stolen Hour
domain.sureHit: each round declare AGE (8 Time Dice), FREEZE (held and harmless), or RETURN (dragged back to where they stood a round ago)

techniques.name: Contact Decay
techniques.summary: Whatever the hand touches should not exist. Decay Marks pile up and crumble; awakened, the ruin spreads through the ground itself. No Domain — the ground is the barrier.

arts.name: Five-Finger Decay
arts.text: touch the foe nearest the cursor: a Decay Die and a Mark (two at L20) · at 5 Marks it Crumbles (L6)

arts.name: Awakening
arts.text: touch the ground: ruin spreads 30 ft through it (60 ft at L13, 90 ft at L15, 120 ft at L20) — 5 Decay Dice and 2 Marks to all standing on it

maximum.name: Deika Collapse
maximum.text: 150 ft of ground unmade: 10 Decay Dice and 3 Marks · recoil: you lose about a quarter of your life, and an arm breaks (Broken Armor)

passives.name: Decay Marks
passives.text: Up to 5 per foe; they fade after a minute if it survives.

passives.name: Touch Goes Both Ways
passives.text: Whatever hits you with its body has touched your hand: a Decay Die and a Mark (1 CE, once per round).

passives.name: Crumble
passives.text: A touch on a 5-Mark foe spends 3 CE (free at L20) for 4 more Decay Dice and clears the Marks.

passives.name: Four Fingers
passives.text: Each round, a marked foe touching another spreads a Mark to it (1 CE).

passives.name: Avalanche
passives.text: Awakening also knocks its victims down.

feats.name: Chain Reaction
feats.text: A foe your Decay reduces to nothing spreads a Mark to everything touching it.

feats.name: Ruined City
feats.text: You shape the ruin as you make it: Awakening also raises a rubble rampart at your cursor (1 CE).

techniques.name: Crazy Slots
techniques.summary: A clown, a lottery, nine weapons: spin and fight with whatever the clown deals. A drawn weapon can't be dismissed until it's used. And there's a number you've never rolled.

arts.name: Use Weapon
arts.text: attack with the weapon the clown dealt (each has its own use-condition before it vanishes)

arts.name: Second Spin
arts.text: once per long rest: spin twice — you must take the second

arts.name: Double Feature
arts.text: once per long rest: deal two weapons at once

arts.name: The Clown's Contract
arts.text: pay about [7 life] of your life: spin twice and keep the one that fits the fight

quick.name: Spin the Clown
quick.text: spin the clown's reel (it never lands on 9) and draw that weapon

maximum.name: Full House
maximum.text: 1 minute: all nine at once, no conditions — Use Weapon swings a random one · exhausted after

passives.name: The nine numbers
passives.text: Daggers (2 throws) · Scythe (3 swings) · Bow (3 arrows) · Hammer (2 blows) · Gun (3 shots) · Shield (blocks one hit) · Whip (one grab) · Mace (2 blows, knocks down).

passives.name: Encore
passives.text: Once per long rest, when a weapon is used up, the clown spins again at once (2 CE).

passives.name: The Number You Never Rolled
passives.text: Once per long rest, at 0 life: 3 CE — back to half life, holding the Survivor, which deals double to whatever brought you down.

feats.name: The Clown Knows
feats.text: It loves an audience: when you spin, the clown whispers where the foe at your cursor is soft — the weapons it deals cut through half its armor.

feats.name: Rigged Applause
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): flourish the weapon in your hand — foes within 30 ft that fall for it stop to watch for a round.

domain.name: The House Always Deals
domain.sureHit: everyone plays: each chosen foe juggles the clown's prop and hits 30% softer every round

techniques.name: Crimson Legion
techniques.summary: A walking graveyard. Consumed souls are extra lives, summonable familiars, and the fuel for your most horrifying release.

arts.name: Blood Drinker
arts.text: drink the soul of a fresh body within reach (bodies you walk over are drunk on their own)

arts.name: Black Hound
arts.text: 1 minute: a shadow hound at your side; your hits gain 2 Crimson Dice once per round

arts.name: Named Familiar
arts.text: 1 minute: raise your finest stored soul in its own shape

arts.name: Restriction Level One
arts.text: 1 minute: release up to PB familiars at once

arts.name: Restriction Level Zero
arts.text: the court, deployed for 3 minutes: up to 2 × CE mod swarms (a soul each, a Crimson Die a hit) and every named familiar · no Extra Life while they're out

arts.name: Vampiric Mist
arts.text: become mist until next round: untouchable, but you can't attack

quick.name: Feed
quick.text: spend a soul: heal 2 Crimson Dice

maximum.name: Sea of the Dead
maximum.text: 30 souls released as a 60-ft tide: 10 Crimson Dice and restrained by the dead

passives.name: Soul Stock
passives.text: Up to level × CE mod souls; a long rest starts you with at least your level. PB Elite or Named souls are kept by name.

passives.name: Extra Life
passives.text: Automatic, 3 CE + 3 souls, once per round: at 0 life you stand at 1 and heal 2 Crimson Dice.

passives.name: Vampiric Body
passives.text: Tougher (15% less damage), climb walls; mist form on the Feed key while out of souls is not needed — see Vampiric Mist.

passives.name: True Vampire
passives.text: Once per round, a kill feeds you its soul automatically (1 CE).

feats.name: Baskerville
feats.text: Your hound hunts with a body now: its bites seize what they hit, holding it a moment.

feats.name: Casull & Jackal
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): both cursed pistols fire toward your cursor, 1d10 + CE mod each.

feats.name: No Life King
feats.text: When Extra Life saves you, one more soul lets the moment land: foes within 10 ft that see it freeze in dread for 3 s.

techniques.name: Dark Dimension
techniques.summary: A swordsman's darkness: read every intent in the room, swallow what you read, and cut where the reading ends — until space itself stops being an obstacle.

arts.name: Dark Cloaked Slash
arts.text: toggle · weapon hits add a Dark Die (1 CE, at most once a second)

arts.name: Avidya Wild Slash
arts.text: cut every foe within reach: weapon damage + 2 Dark Dice each

arts.name: Mana Zone
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: a 30-ft zone — you sense everything moving in it, and it answers your blade

arts.name: Dimension Slash
arts.text: a 120-ft cut through space: 7 Dark Dice, through walls

arts.name: Black Moon
arts.text: with Mana Zone up: for a round, hostile attacks entering 15 ft of you are erased

quick.name: Ki Read
quick.text: 1 minute: read the room — every foe revealed, +5% crit

maximum.name: Dark Cloaked Dimension Sever
maximum.text: a 150-ft cut, 10 Dark Dice · Equinox at L18: 300 ft, 12 Dark Dice

passives.name: Black Hole
passives.text: Automatic, 2 CE, once per round: the darkness swallows a hostile projectile about to reach you.

passives.name: Iai: Death Draw
passives.text: Automatic, 4 CE, once per round, in Mana Zone: whoever strikes you is cut first — weapon + 4 Dark Dice.

passives.name: Captain's Black Moon
passives.text: Mana Zone is 60 ft and needs no Focus; one Black Hole or Iai each round is free.

feats.name: Dark Cloaked Blade
feats.text: Your weapon counts as cursed steel: its blows cut through a quarter of a foe's armor.

feats.name: Black Hole Mastery
feats.text: You catch rather than erase: a projectile your Black Hole swallows is sent back down a 60-ft line toward your cursor at twice its force (2 CE).

feats.name: Surpass Your Limits
feats.text: At 0 life, before you fall, everything left (5 CE or more) goes into one final Dimension Slash.

techniques.name: Deep Purple
techniques.summary: An army, exhaled: smoke soldiers that fight, screen and grapple while the general hides somewhere in the fog.

arts.name: Smoke, Obey
arts.text: exhale PB smoke soldiers (at least 2): 1d6 + CE mod, one hit dissipates them, and they disperse after a minute

arts.name: Dismiss the Ranks
arts.text: let every soldier drift away

arts.name: The Fog Itself
arts.text: once per long rest, 1 minute: you are smoke — nothing can touch you, and you fight only through your soldiers

quick.name: The General Vanishes
quick.text: dissolve and re-form beside the soldier nearest your cursor

maximum.name: The Smoking Parade
maximum.text: 1 minute: the whole army at once — every foe hemmed in by three soldiers takes 6d8 each round · exhausted after

passives.name: The Ranks Swell
passives.text: Up to 5 × level soldiers (capped for the game's sake at 60).

passives.name: Screen
passives.text: Automatic, 1 CE, once per round: a soldier beside you steps in and takes the hit.

passives.name: Hands of Smoke
passives.text: Soldiers grapple: their hits hold foes (Str) briefly.

feats.name: Secondhand Lungs
feats.text: A soldier fitted as a breathing mask: while any soldier stands, you breathe underwater and foul air can't touch you.

feats.name: False General
feats.text: One soldier wears your exact likeness: while any stand, foes are much slower to pick out the real you.

feats.name: Fog of War
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE): your soldiers exhale a 60-ft cloud of heavy smoke at your cursor for a minute — every foe inside is blinded.

feats.name: The Last Soldier
feats.text: Once per long rest, when you'd fall, you dissolve instead and re-form beside your farthest soldier (within 300 ft) at 1 life.

domain.name: The Barracks of Fog
domain.sureHit: Nowhere to Stand: 4d8 to every chosen foe each round, and they're blinded beyond 10 ft

techniques.name: Directive Arrows
techniques.summary: Write glowing arrows into the battlefield, ride their instructions at impossible speed, and turn a carefully drawn route into one decisive strike.

arts.name: Directive Inscription
arts.text: 1 CE inks PB arrows · press where an arrow should hang, drag toward where it should send you, release · a quick tap aims it along your route instead · ride one by walking into it

arts.name: Acceleration Sphere
arts.text: PB CE · a foe within 60 ft: PB legs around it, each a strike with your held weapon + Vector Edge

arts.name: Imposed Directive
arts.text: toggle · once per round a weapon hit spends 2 CE to march the foe an Arrow Distance away from you (Str); walls turn it into collision

quick.name: Erase Route
quick.text: clear your arrows and start a new chart (inside your Palace: ride a virtual arrow toward the cursor)

maximum.name: Dominion of Borrowed Speed
maximum.text: 1 minute: a 40-ft field moves with you · each round foes inside lose speed and you gain it, and PB free arrows bloom around you

passives.name: Arrowpath
passives.text: Riding an arrow carries you its Arrow Distance (20 ft · 30 ft at L11 · 40 ft at L18) without using your own movement; passing through another arrow chains into its direction. PB rides per round.

passives.name: Vector Edge
passives.text: Once per round, a weapon hit adds an Arrow Die per arrow ridden this round, up to PB of them (stronger at L11 and L18).

passives.name: Quick Inscription
passives.text: A weapon hit drops a free arrow at your feet, pointing toward the cursor (PB per round at L18).

passives.name: Projectile Redirection
passives.text: A hostile projectile within 10 ft of an arrow is bent along it and becomes yours (1 CE, spends the arrow).

passives.name: Persistent Line
passives.text: Once per round, an arrow you ride stays.

passives.name: Routebreaker
passives.text: After a chain of 3+ arrows, a free strike with your held weapon on the foe nearest the end.

feats.name: Snare Glyph
feats.text: Up to PB of your arrows are snares as well: a foe that steps onto one is held for half a round (a strong one tears free).

domain.name: Palace of the Predestined Road
domain.sureHit: every point is an arrow (F rides 40 ft toward the cursor, full Vector Edge); each round every foe walks the route you drew and breaks on what it hits

techniques.name: Emperor's Chains
techniques.summary: Five chains: a jailer, a judge, a dowser, a healer, and the scarlet-eyed emperor. Chain Jail binds the sworn designated group absolutely — and every round of Emperor Time burns an hour of your life.

arts.name: Swear the Vow
arts.text: name your designated group: the kind of foe nearest the cursor (one per character)

arts.name: Chain Jail
arts.text: the middle chain lashes the foe at your cursor (60 ft): a designated foe is bound and silenced in full · anyone else only briefly, and a strong foe may tear loose

arts.name: Holy Chain
arts.text: the thumb mends: up to 5 CE, 2d6 healing per CE (3d6 in Emperor Time)

arts.name: Steal Chain
arts.text: the syringe tip, 30 ft: the foe's strength drains for a round, and the stolen aura comes back to you (3 CE, once per round)

arts.name: Judgment Chain
arts.text: stake a foe within reach with a rule: "do not strike me." If it does, the stake falls

quick.name: Emperor Time
quick.text: scarlet eyes: chains at full power, faster casting — every round burns an hour of life

maximum.name: The Unappealable Sentence
maximum.text: burn 12 hours: the foe at your cursor (120 ft) is bound, unbreakable, and judged — a minute for a designated foe, ten seconds for anyone else

passives.name: Binding Vow of the Designated
passives.text: Chain Jail binds your sworn kind of foe in full; anyone else, it barely holds. The same stake rests in your heart.

passives.name: Lifespan Ledger
passives.text: Every 24 hours burned by Emperor Time lowers your max life by 5 for good.

passives.name: Twin Fetters
passives.text: Chain Jail reaches 120 ft and also binds a second designated foe near the first.

passives.name: Post-Mortem Protocol
passives.text: Once per long rest, falling to 0 leaves you standing for a minute in free Emperor Time.

feats.name: The Snare Left Behind
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE) lays a loop of Chain Jail at your cursor: the first foe to step in is bound (in full if it's your sworn kind). Up to three.

feats.name: Borrowed Hours
feats.text: The scarlet eyes do not accept no: in Emperor Time, once every 10 s an affliction on you is thrown off at once (2 CE and six more hours of life).

domain.name: The Scarlet Courtroom
domain.sureHit: the vow executed perfectly: every chosen foe is chained each round; the designated are judged for PB d10

techniques.name: Explosion
techniques.summary: Palms that sweat nitroglycerin. Blasts, piercing AP Shots, blinding Stun Grenades and the diving Howitzer Impact — and the longer the fight runs, the more sweat feeds them.

arts.name: Explosion
arts.text: a blast at the cursor within 30 ft, 2d6 (3d6 at L6) + 1d6 per Sweat fed (hold to feed)

arts.name: Explosion (Cone)
arts.text: a 15-ft cone of fire, same dice

arts.name: AP Shot
arts.text: a 60-ft piercing line that punches through thin cover, 4d6 + up to 2 Sweat

arts.name: Stun Grenade
arts.text: a blinding flash, 20-ft radius within 60 ft: confused and half as dangerous for a round (Con)

arts.name: Howitzer Impact
arts.text: spin-dive 60 ft and detonate, 20-ft radius, 8d6 + 1d6 per 2 Sweat · recoil: you lose about [7 life] life (until L18)

quick.name: Blast Dash
quick.text: ride the recoil 30 ft toward the cursor

passives.name: Nitroglycerin Sweat
passives.text: Sweat pool PB + 2: +1 every round, +1 when hurt (once per round). Hold the cast key to feed Sweat into a blast.

passives.name: Blast Jump
passives.text: Press Jump in midair (with no other jump left) to blast off the air beneath you: 1 CE, and whatever's under you takes 1d6.

passives.name: Growing Arsenal
passives.text: Explosion deals 3d6.

passives.name: Cluster
passives.text: No more recoil. Once per round, a CE explosion that connects pours your remaining Sweat in: +1d6 each.

feats.name: Grenadier Gauntlets
feats.text: Your gauntlets keep what your palms make: Sweat holds 4 more, and every fight starts with at least 2 stored.

feats.name: Point-Blank
feats.text: An explosion that lands within 5 ft of you adds 2d6 fire and throws the foe 10 ft.

feats.name: AP Shot: Auto-Cannon
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE and 1 Sweat): a quick AP Shot — a 30-ft line, 2d6.

techniques.name: Full Counter
techniques.summary: Every attack you can see is a gift: catch it on the blade and return it stronger than it arrived. The Captain doesn't dodge. He answers.

arts.name: Revenge Counter
arts.text: everything you've endured since your last Revenge, returned at once to the foe at your cursor (60 ft)

quick.name: Full Counter
quick.text: a split-second guard: a blow that lands in it is caught — you take nothing, and it returns to its sender half again as hard (double from 11th) · shots fly back the way they came

maximum.name: Maximum: Absolute Counter
maximum.text: once per long rest, for a minute: every blow you can see is countered automatically (1 CE each), returned two and a half times as hard

passives.name: Read the Blow
passives.text: You can't be caught off guard: hidden attackers show to you.

passives.name: Second Helping
passives.text: Once a round, after a counter, your next counter that round costs nothing.

passives.name: Revenge
passives.text: Every blow you take adds to your Revenge total.

techniques.name: Hakoware: Bankruptcy, Chapter Seven
techniques.summary: Potclean latches on and lends your enemy cursed energy. Everything you do to them becomes debt, compounding every round. Out-owe their own maximum and they're bankrupt.

arts.name: A.P.R. (Potclean)
arts.text: Potclean flies 60 ft and latches: your damage to the debtor becomes debt, ×1.10 every round

arts.name: Bailout
arts.text: once per long rest: forgive a loan and pocket CE from half the debt

maximum.name: Reversal: Repossession
maximum.text: the debtor takes 10% of its debt as damage and that much leaves the ledger; you regain CE from half of it (up to 10) — the loan continues

passives.name: The loan
passives.text: While indebted a foe deals 10% more damage (you armed it). Its hits on you pay the debt down. Debt past half its life: bankrupt — it deals half damage for a minute (3 min at L18).

passives.name: Audit
passives.text: You always see each debtor's balance and how close it is to ruin.

passives.name: Branch Offices
passives.text: Two loans at once.

passives.name: Garnish Wages
passives.text: Interest rises to 12% a round.

feats.name: Predatory Lending
feats.text: The vow is the rate: interest is 15% a round from the start.

feats.name: Debt Transfer
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE) moves a loan to the foe at your cursor, within 60 ft of the debtor — the whole balance follows.

feats.name: Collateral
feats.text: When a debtor goes bankrupt you seize collateral: 3 CE back and a little life.

domain.name: Ledger of Ruin
domain.sureHit: the lending itself: every chosen foe is given a loan, no roll, and interest ticks on all of them

techniques.name: Hide and Seek
techniques.summary: A fourth-dimensional mansion entered through doors only the keyholder can hang — and Scream, a window that closes on whatever it touches and files it away.

arts.name: The Mansion Door
arts.text: hang a door at the cursor (one; two at L11)

arts.name: Enter / Leave the Mansion
arts.text: step through your nearest door: inside, nothing can reach you — leave by any door · mid-fight the mansion only holds you a round

arts.name: Scream
arts.text: a portal snaps shut on a foe within 30 ft: it's filed away in your holding room for a few rounds (Str to break out)

quick.name: Keyholder's Step
quick.text: step into a door and out of the one nearest your cursor (within 500 ft)

maximum.name: Reversal: Seek and Find
maximum.text: tear the hiding off: the foe nearest your cursor within 60 ft is dragged out beside you (not bosses)

passives.name: Paired Doors
passives.text: Two doors; walking through one brings you out of the other.

passives.name: Exile
passives.text: Scream holds a foe outside reality for a full minute (resisted with will instead of strength).

feats.name: Doormat
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE) hangs a door flat on the floor at your cursor: the next foe to step on it falls into the mansion for 2 rounds. Up to two.

feats.name: Catch, Don't Kill
feats.text: Once a round, a shot about to hit you is swallowed by a portal snapping shut on it (3 CE).

domain.name: The Fourth-Dimensional Estate
domain.sureHit: everywhere is inside: each round, every chosen foe is swallowed into a holding room for that round

techniques.name: Jajanken
techniques.summary: An honest game: Rock charges a fist while you stand glowing, Paper throws it, Scissors cuts. You always say which one is coming. No Domain — only a vow that spends your future.

arts.name: Rock
arts.text: hold to charge (1 CE per charge, max 3 / 6 at L18; you're slowed and exposed), release: 2d12 per charge

arts.name: Paper
arts.text: conviction thrown 60 ft: 3d8

arts.name: Scissors
arts.text: an edge of aura: 3d8

arts.name: Everything I Have
arts.text: once per long rest, 1 minute: instant charges, free Paper and Scissors · then your CE empties and stays empty until a long rest

arts.name: Forbidden Vow: The Future, Spent
arts.text: cast twice to swear · 1 minute at level 20, instant charges, free arts, wider crits — then Jajanken leaves you forever

maximum.name: All-In Rock
maximum.text: six charges at once: 12d12, pushed 30 ft and knocked down (Str)

passives.name: Declared aloud
passives.text: Every art announces itself. While charging Rock you take 15% more damage.

passives.name: Held Gambit
passives.text: If a foe hits you while you're charging Rock, the punch releases into it at once.

passives.name: Crater
passives.text: Rock with 4+ charges also hits everything within 10 ft of the target for half and knocks it down.

feats.name: Ground Slam
feats.text: Sometimes the honest target is the floor: Rock released with no foe in front of you slams the ground — everything within 15 ft takes it and is knocked down.

feats.name: Aftershock
feats.text: The punch doesn't stop at the first body: a landed Rock drives on into the foe behind it for half (1 CE).

feats.name: Sunder
feats.text: The edge that scores can sever: Scissors strips its foes' armor for 10 s.

feats.name: Paper Mine
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE) presses a Paper charge into the ground at your cursor: the first foe to come near sets it off (3d8). Up to three.

techniques.name: Living Circuit
techniques.summary: Lightning given orders. Whirlwind dodges before your mind catches up; Speed of Lightning strikes that stop a heart. Every second burns CE — the storm always runs out.

arts.name: Lightning Step
arts.text: with Godspeed on: double-tap left or right (or press this) to flash that way (25 ft · 45 ft in Speed of Lightning, cutting through foes for 2d8 at most once a second) · no CE, a third of a second apart

arts.name: Speed of Lightning
arts.text: with Godspeed on: switch between Whirlwind and Speed of Lightning

arts.name: Thunderbolt
arts.text: a bolt at a point within 90 ft: 5d8 in 10 ft

arts.name: The Storm, Perfected
arts.text: once per long rest, 1 minute: free upkeep, both modes at once, more speed · exhausted after

quick.name: Godspeed
quick.text: enter Godspeed (Whirlwind): 1 CE every round to keep it · cast again to drop it

maximum.name: Storm's Verdict
maximum.text: become the bolt: dash 30 ft through foes — 8d8 and stunned (Con)

passives.name: Whirlwind
passives.text: While Godspeed runs: +60% speed everywhere (run, jump, swim, mine, swing), and one in three attacks misses as you sidestep it.

passives.name: Speed of Lightning
passives.text: +130% speed everywhere (+200% Perfected), melee hits +2d8 lightning, once per round a hit stuns (Con) for a round.

passives.name: Counter-Program
passives.text: When Whirlwind makes a blow miss, you flash to the attacker and strike back.

passives.name: Arc Discharge
passives.text: Your lightning arcs to a second foe within 20 ft for half.

feats.name: Static Sense
feats.text: While Godspeed runs you read the room by its charge: you sense every living creature around you.

feats.name: Ground Wire
feats.text: In Speed of Lightning the current grounds through you: you can't be electrified, and blows land 10% lighter.

feats.name: Thunderclap
feats.text: Thunderbolt comes with a flash: every foe within 30 ft of it is blinded for a round.

feats.name: Dead-Man's Program
feats.text: A standing order for Whirlwind: when a blow drops you below a fifth of your life in Godspeed, you flash 30 ft away from the nearest foe (once a minute).

domain.name: Thunderhead
domain.sureHit: Storm's Judgment: a free Thunderbolt on every chosen foe each round

techniques.name: One For All — Inherited Embers
techniques.summary: A stockpile of strength carrying the wills of eight bearers before you. Choose any percentage — Safe Output decides only whether it hurts. The vestiges lend Blackwhip, Danger Sense, Smokescreen, Float, Kinetic Surge, Gearshift.

arts.name: Smash
arts.text: hold to raise the output from your Safe Output by 5% steps · release: a Stockpile Die per 20% output, 1 CE per 20% · over Safe Output, the recoil is yours

arts.name: Air Force
arts.text: the same Smash flicked as pressure: 60 ft (90 ft at L7, with a cone behind the target)

arts.name: Blackwhip Lash
arts.text: with Blackwhip out: a tendril lash, a Stockpile Die, grabs (Str)

arts.name: Blackwhip Pull
arts.text: with Blackwhip out: anchor where you point and pull yourself 20 ft

arts.name: Blackwhip
arts.text: tendrils for a minute: lash, grab, anchor

arts.name: Smokescreen
arts.text: a 20-ft cloud (40 ft at L13; Full Blast 60 ft for +2 CE): foes inside are blinded

arts.name: Float
arts.text: 1 minute: hold Jump to fly and hover

arts.name: Gearshift: Top Gear
arts.text: 3 rounds: much faster, and your first hit each round gains 2 Stockpile Dice · after: slowed

quick.name: Full Cowl
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: the stockpile worn at your Safe Output — speed and toughness by Band

passives.name: Any percentage
passives.text: Safe Output 5% per level (100% at L20). Each 10% over it is a Recoil Step: a Stockpile Die of damage you can't reduce; 5+ steps breaks the limb (Weak + Broken Armor).

passives.name: Burst Step
passives.text: A Smash carries you 5 ft per Band toward what you hit.

passives.name: Danger Sense
passives.text: Automatic, 1 CE, once per round: a Stockpile Die off an incoming blow.

passives.name: Kinetic Surge
passives.text: Charges (max PB) from running 20 ft or landing two hits in a round; each adds 15% to a Smash with no recoil. Faux 100% at L12.

passives.name: One For All Unbound
passives.text: Every Stockpile hit is far heavier; vestiges cost 1 less once each.

passives.name: The Ninth's Completion
passives.text: Safe Output 100%, Stockpile hits heavier still, and your first 100% Smash each round is free.

feats.name: Armored Vessel
feats.text: Under Full Cowl your whole body is one braced vessel: falls never hurt you.

feats.name: Smash Artisan
feats.text: Once a round, a landed Smash takes 2 CE more to carry another form's rider: the foe is knocked down and thrown farther.

feats.name: Tendril Snare
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE): Blackwhip lattices a 15-ft area at your cursor — every foe in it is held for a round (a strong one tears free).

techniques.name: Overhaul
techniques.summary: Touch gives complete authority over matter's arrangement, not its soul: execution, healing, terrain, and horrifying fusion. He doesn't heal or harm. He revises.

arts.name: Disassemble
arts.text: touch: 2 Overhaul Dice

arts.name: Reconstruction
arts.text: 1 AP · heal yourself 2 Overhaul Dice

arts.name: Ground Spikes
arts.text: the floor is a draft: a 15-ft line of spikes, 3 Overhaul Dice, knocked down

arts.name: Biological Repair
arts.text: 2 AP · heal 4 Overhaul Dice + CE mod and end poison, bleeding and blindness

arts.name: Fusion
arts.text: 4 AP · fuse with a held (restrained) foe in reach: it's absorbed; you gain half its life as a shield for 10 minutes

arts.name: Terrain Dominion
arts.text: restructure 30 ft of ground at the cursor: 6 Overhaul Dice

arts.name: Theater: Disassemble / Reassemble
arts.text: choose what your Domain declares each round

maximum.name: City Block Reconstruction
maximum.text: 5 AP · reshape 60 ft around you: 10 Overhaul Dice, foes restrained by architecture

passives.name: Assembly Points
passives.text: PB + CE mod (min 2; doubled at L20). They return after a long rest or two minutes out of combat.

passives.name: Instant Reassembly
passives.text: Automatic, 2 AP + 3 CE, once per round: after a heavy hit, your body is put back together — bleeding, broken armor and poison are undone.

passives.name: Complete Rebuild
passives.text: Once per long rest, 4 AP + 6 CE: rebuilt from 0 to 1 life.

feats.name: Surgeon's Hand
feats.text: Your repairs rebuild more than flesh: every Overhaul heal also takes poison, bleeding and blindness apart.

feats.name: Plague Mask
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 AP and 1 CE): for a minute the air around you is overhauled — poisons, foul air and weakness can't take hold.

domain.name: Operating Theater of Perfect Matter
domain.sureHit: each round, DISASSEMBLE (8 Overhaul Dice to every chosen foe) or REASSEMBLE (you heal 5 Overhaul Dice)

techniques.name: Pain Packer
techniques.summary: Heat-proof armor drinks every wound and banks it as heat — then gives it all back as a rising sun. The more it hurts, the bigger the dawn.

arts.name: Vent
arts.text: the bank bursts in 15 ft: 1d8 per 10 Pain (at least 1d8) · the bank empties

arts.name: Slow Burn
arts.text: 1 minute: each round, foes within 10 ft take 1d6 per 20 Pain and the bank drains 20

quick.name: Pain Packer
quick.text: conjure (or dismiss) the heat-proof armor: immune to burning, and every wound is banked as Pain

maximum.name: Rising Sun
maximum.text: the bank becomes a sun over you: 60 ft, 1d10 per 10 Pain (at least 3d10), then 2d10 each round for a minute

passives.name: The bank
passives.text: Pain banked = damage taken while armored, up to 5 × level (10 × at L18). Hurt with the bank already full, it Overflows: a free Vent, on its own.

passives.name: Backdraft
passives.text: Automatic, 1 CE, once per round: a melee attacker eats up to 30 Pain back, 1d6 per 10.

passives.name: Solar Core
passives.text: The first wound each round banks double.

feats.name: Banked Light
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE) vents 10 Pain as pure light: every foe within 30 ft is blinded for a round.

feats.name: Cauterize
feats.text: The heat that kills also seals: once a minute, armored with 10 Pain banked, a blow that would drop you leaves you at 1 life instead (it costs the 10 Pain).

feats.name: Heat Haze
feats.text: With 20 or more Pain banked, the air bends around you: blows sometimes pass through where you seemed to be.

domain.name: High Noon
domain.sureHit: the sun doesn't miss: every chosen foe takes 1d8 per 10 Pain each round, and the bank doesn't empty

techniques.name: Ripper Cyclotron
techniques.summary: Wind the arm, and every rotation compounds the punch. Everyone can see it coming — that's the point.

arts.name: Release
arts.text: the wound punch: 1d12 per wind held

arts.name: Shockwave Release
arts.text: the punch as a 30-ft line: 1d12 per wind to everything in it

arts.name: Split Winding
arts.text: split the winds between the two nearest foes

arts.name: The Arm Never Stops
arts.text: once per long rest, 1 minute: a free wind every round, no maximum, no decay · exhausted after

quick.name: Wind
quick.text: tap to wind the arm once, or hold to keep winding, one every half second (1 CE each; max 10, 15 at L18)

maximum.name: Full Rotation
maximum.text: winds to maximum, then release: pushed 20 ft and knocked down (Str)

passives.name: A threat made in public
passives.text: While you hold winds you take 15% more damage. Winds fade after a minute without winding or releasing.

passives.name: Bleed-Off
passives.text: 1 CE, once per round: a heavy hit vents winds, each one reducing it by 1d8.

passives.name: Ground Zero
passives.text: Releasing 10+ winds also hits everything within 15 ft for half and knocks it down.

feats.name: Pre-Wound
feats.text: Walk into the fight already spinning: after 10 s with no foe near, your arm winds itself to 3, and holds them while you wait.

feats.name: Gyroscope
feats.text: The spinning arm steadies you: while it holds winds, nothing knocks you back.

feats.name: Wind Reading
feats.text: The arm reads the air it displaces: while it holds winds, you sense every creature around you.

feats.name: Backblast
feats.text: Survival, with a shockwave: winds vented by Bleed-Off burst out around you, 1d6 each, within 10 ft.

domain.name: Centrifuge
domain.sureHit: the room winds up: every round +2 winds, and every chosen foe is dragged 15 ft toward you

techniques.name: Royal Marionette
techniques.summary: A surgical shikigami theater of three dolls: Doctor Blythe repairs bodies, the Puppeteer turns corpses into soldiers, and Terpsichora makes your own body dance past its limits.

arts.name: Doctor Blythe
arts.text: Focus · the surgical doll stands beside you; Surgery and Emergency Stitch need her

arts.name: Surgery
arts.text: with Blythe: spend up to your CE modifier in CE, healing 5 per CE (8 at L11)

arts.name: Predatory En
arts.text: toggle · sense every presence nearby (Hunter) · 1 CE a minute

arts.name: Puppeteer
arts.text: raise the nearest fresh corpse as a puppet that fights for you for 3 minutes (1d6 a second)

arts.name: Snap the Strings
arts.text: destroy your nearest puppet: hostiles within 10 ft of it are snared (Str)

quick.name: Terpsichora
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute · the ballerina strings your body: +speed, triple jumps, an extra attack

maximum.name: Puppet Master's Serenity
maximum.text: 1 minute: Terpsichora needs no Focus and you can dodge twice as often · exhausted after

passives.name: One doll at a time
passives.text: Only one signature doll is fully active; switching costs 1 CE. (L20 Royal Theater: all three at once.)

passives.name: Emergency Stitch
passives.text: Automatic, 2 CE, once per round, while Blythe is up: a heavy hit is reduced by [4×PB life].

passives.name: Fifty Strings
passives.text: Up to 5 × PB puppets (10 × PB at L20).

passives.name: Last Dance
passives.text: If you die while Terpsichora dances, the doll keeps your body moving for one more round.

feats.name: Field Surgeon
feats.text: The needle reaches the dying first: while Blythe stands, every 5 s she mends the most hurt teammate within 30 ft (2 CE).

feats.name: Feral En
feats.text: Your En shapes itself to the room: it also senses danger and treasure.

feats.name: Dance Beyond Death
feats.text: The strings hold even when the dancer cannot: Last Dance works from 11th.

techniques.name: Shadow Eminence
techniques.summary: By day, an unremarkable face in the crowd. By night, a slime-clad god of theatrics who announces his apocalypses before he performs them. He has never once received the credit.

arts.name: Slime Sword
arts.text: with the suit on: the slime as a blade, 1d10 + CE mod, 10-ft reach · each hit builds Atomic

arts.name: Overcharged Strike
arts.text: toggle · slime hits spend 1 CE + 1 Atomic for +1d8

arts.name: Atomic Discharge
arts.text: 2+ Atomic · a small apocalypse within 60 ft: 10-ft radius, 2d10 per Atomic

arts.name: Slime Threads
arts.text: threads fine as lies: a foe within 30 ft is restrained (Str)

arts.name: True Eminence
arts.text: once per long rest: open I am Atomic for 10 CE with the opening detonation maximized

arts.name: Slime Wings
arts.text: 1 minute: hold Jump to fly

quick.name: Slime Bodysuit
quick.text: manifest (or dismiss) the slime suit: tougher, and every shape you need

passives.name: Mob Camouflage
passives.text: Foes overlook you; your first hit in each fight is a critical.

passives.name: Atomic
passives.text: Max PB (PB + 2 at L18): +1 per slime hit, once per round (2 at L18). With the suit on, your melee weapon is slime too: its hits build Atomic and take Overcharge.

feats.name: Slime Arsenal
feats.text: New morphs for the suit: once a round a slime buckler may catch a blow (1 CE, about a third of the time).

feats.name: Mob's Escape
feats.text: Drop a foe and you're just another face in the crowd: for 3 s you're unseen and foes lose track of you.

feats.name: Shadow Step
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE and 2 Atomic): a dash toward the cursor so fast nothing touches you on the way.

domain.name: I am Atomic
domain.sureHit: OPEN — no barrier. Opening: 8d10 force + 8d10 radiant to every foe in range; then atomic fire, 2d10 each round

techniques.name: Skill Hunter
techniques.summary: Bandit's Secret: witness a foe's attack, then press the bloody palm print to its flesh within the hour — the attack is yours, and it can't use it while your page holds it.

arts.name: Read the Open Page
arts.text: fire the attack on the open page toward the cursor (with Two Pages Open, the bookmark fires too)

arts.name: Bandit's Secret: The Palm
arts.text: press the palm print to a foe you watched attack within the hour: its attack becomes a page

arts.name: Bookmark
arts.text: mark the open page; it can be read alongside another (L6)

quick.name: Turn the Page
quick.text: open the next page of the book

maximum.name: Imprimatur
maximum.text: 1 minute: every attack you see a foe make is inscribed at once — no palm needed

passives.name: Theft, not borrowing
passives.text: A creature you stole from can't use that attack while it lives and the page is yours.

passives.name: Two Pages Open
passives.text: Reading the open page also reads the bookmarked one (+1 CE each).

feats.name: The Placed Ribbon
feats.text: The book, given standing orders: when a blow drops you below a quarter of your life, the bookmarked page reads itself at your cursor (once a minute).

domain.name: The Black Chapter
domain.sureHit: every page turns at once: each chosen foe that has attacked is inscribed when the library forms, and can't use it inside

techniques.name: Sunshine: Pride Incarnate
techniques.summary: A furnace in the chest that grows with the sun. Cruel Sun, Pride Flare, Super Slash — and at true Zenith, The One. At level 18, a fatal vow refuses the end.

arts.name: Cruel Sun
arts.text: hold to pour 1 to PB CE · a miniature sun: a Solar Die + CE mod, plus a Solar Die for every CE poured · 120 ft · keep holding a second past full for Maximum Output: the sun lingers for 30 s (Focus), follows your cursor anywhere in range, and burns whatever it touches every 1.5 s for half its dice — Pride Flare sets it off early

arts.name: Pride Flare
arts.text: detonate your Cruel Sun mid-flight (or within 3 s of it landing): radius 10 ft + 5 ft per Solar rank, PB Solar Dice · a held sun goes up far bigger: + its poured CE in Solar Dice, and 2.5 ft wider per CE · also on the quick key

arts.name: Crazy Prominence
arts.text: PB CE · PB homing suns among foes within 150 ft, 2 Solar Dice each

arts.name: Super Slash
arts.text: PB CE · surge forward, striking everything in your path PB times

arts.name: Divine Sword
arts.text: The One only · a 30-ft cone, 10 Solar Dice + Str mod

arts.name: Divine Spear
arts.text: The One only · a 15-ft thrust, 10 Solar Dice, stuns (Con)

arts.name: Solar Memory
arts.text: rite: stand still out of combat for 10 s at rank 1–3 to store it · release: 2 CE, 1 minute at the higher rank

arts.name: Lion's Heat
arts.text: toggle · once per round, a melee hit spends 1 CE for + PB Solar Dice

arts.name: Refuse the End
arts.text: while The One: the fatal vow — The One Ultimate. Lose max life every round. When it ends, you die.

arts.name: Final Prominence
arts.text: Ultimate only · all CE (min 15) · a 150-ft final sun: 20d12, plus d12 more for every CE spent, plus your Last Dawn life · then the end

quick.name: Pride Flare / Sun-Rider
quick.text: Pride Flare while a Cruel Sun is in the air or just landed; otherwise ride solar fire 30 + 10×rank ft toward the cursor, through enemies

passives.name: Solar Station
passives.text: Your sun hits harder as the day climbs: Night (weakest) · Low Sun · High Sun · Near-Noon (11:00–12:00, 13:00–14:00) · Zenith (12:00–13:00, strongest). Numbers in this book use the sun right now.

passives.name: Pride Incarnate
passives.text: Solar Strength floor (melee damage and knockback rise with the sun) · temporary life when combat begins (level × rank).

passives.name: The body rises with the sun
passives.text: Per rank: +8% run speed, higher jumps, 7% faster mining, +10% pickaxe power (The One: one more step).

passives.name: Sun-Wrought Stature
passives.text: Rank 2+: heavier knockback · rank 3+: melee weapons grow 25%.

passives.name: Solar Sovereignty
passives.text: By day you can't be set on fire or burned.

passives.name: Prideful Endurance
passives.text: Automatic, 2 CE, once per round: a heavy hit is reduced by PB Solar Dice + Str mod.

passives.name: Solar Authority
passives.text: Cruel Sun 300 ft and pour up to 2×PB CE · Prominence 3 Solar Dice per hit · your Sunshine ignores defense.

passives.name: The One
passives.text: At rank 4: half damage taken, immune to fire and knockback, +speed, an extra attack, Lion's Heat on every hit (PB per round), temp life 5 × level.

passives.name: Unbounded Sunshine
passives.text: Cruel Sun 600 ft with no limit on CE poured · Prominence 4 Solar Dice per hit.

feats.name: Night-Prowling Lion
feats.text: The sun's weakest hour is the lion's: at night foes are slower to notice you, and your first blow each round adds two Solar Dice.

feats.name: Corona of Command
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (3 CE, with the sun at rank 2 or higher): a corona pulse — every foe within 15 ft is blinded for a round.

domain.name: Throne Beneath a Merciless Noon
domain.sureHit: it is noon: rank 4 and The One inside · Sovereign Pressure each round, 8 Solar Dice + CE mod, crushed to the ground

techniques.name: Undead
techniques.summary: The technique negates approaching death. You fight with your own body — fingers for bullets, blood for propulsion — and a Repair Reserve pays the invoice.

arts.name: Parts Bullet
arts.text: tear free a finger and fire it 60 ft: 2 Undead Dice · costs a little of your life

arts.name: Dead Line
arts.text: lose [5 life] life: a 60-ft line of blood, 4 Undead Dice

arts.name: Repair Boost
arts.text: toggle · once per round a hit drives a shard of you in: lose [PB life] life, add PB Undead Dice (1 CE)

arts.name: Division
arts.text: lose [10 life] life: severed parts fight as a swarm for a minute, 3 Undead Dice

arts.name: Dead Road
arts.text: lose [10 life] life: a 90-ft road of you, 7 Undead Dice

arts.name: Victor
arts.text: 1 minute, once per long rest: repair doubles, +2 Undead Dice on hits, your own costs can't drop you below 1

quick.name: Blood Propulsion
quick.text: shed [PB life] life: slide 10 ft × PB toward the cursor

maximum.name: Dead Quartet
maximum.text: lose [25 life] life: skin, blood, bone and muscle hit up to four foes within 60 ft for 3 Undead Dice each (all twelve on one) · then reassemble and repair up to [25 life] from the Reserve

passives.name: Negate Death
passives.text: While the Repair Reserve (5 × level) lasts, 0 life doesn't kill you: you keep going at 1, slowed and weakened, and repair yourself each round. Each fall costs 10 Reserve.

passives.name: Repair
passives.text: Each round, heal up to [PB life] life from the Reserve. It refills on a long rest (and after every fight at L20).

passives.name: Interpretation Shift: Stasis Is Death
passives.text: You can't be turned to stone, frozen or webbed.

passives.name: Undead Completion
passives.text: Reserve doubles; once per long rest, even an empty Reserve can't kill you.

feats.name: Crimson Bullet
feats.text: Plant rather than fire: Technique Key 1 sets a finger in the ground at your cursor (a little life) — the first foe to come near it is hit for 2 Undead Dice. Up to three.

feats.name: Never Stop
feats.text: Conditions are suggestions: once a minute, 10 Repair throws off confusion, slowing, webs, freezing, stone or silence at once.

techniques.name: Vector Authority
techniques.summary: You don't create force — you rewrite direction and magnitude. Nothing touches you unanswered, once you've calculated it. Do not strike him; you're only lending him your weapon.

arts.name: Vector Touch
arts.text: toggle · your hits add a Vector Die and shove (1 CE, at most once a second)

arts.name: Vector Rewrite
arts.text: 1 minute: gravity is a suggestion — faster, walk on walls, longer leaps

arts.name: Atmospheric Weapon
arts.text: a 60-ft line of compressed air: 4 Vector Dice

arts.name: Vector Transformation: Repel
arts.text: a point within 90 ft violently repels: 6 Vector Dice in 20 ft, flung 30 ft (Str)

arts.name: Vector Transformation: Attract
arts.text: the same point violently attracts

arts.name: Plasma Geometry
arts.text: a plasma sphere within 120 ft: 8 Vector Dice and blinded

arts.name: Black Wings
arts.text: 1 minute (once per long rest; unlimited at L20): flight, a free reflection each round, doubled Vector Touch

arts.name: One-Way World: PUSH / PULL / REVERSE
arts.text: what your Domain declares each round

quick.name: Vector Filter
quick.text: raise (or lower) the Filter: known projectiles are reflected back at their source, 1 CE each

maximum.name: Celestial Vector Collapse
maximum.text: a point within 180 ft: 12 Vector Dice in 40 ft — everything dragged to the center, then blasted upward

passives.name: One-Way Road
passives.text: With the Filter up, a known projectile reaching you is reflected (1 CE, once per round; twice at L3, three times at L9). Melee blows are turned back on the attacker the same way.

passives.name: Calculation
passives.text: A projectile you haven't seen needs a calculation: {chance PB+CE 15} of the time it's solved and known until the next long rest; otherwise the Filter drops.

feats.name: Passive Filter
feats.text: Your customs house extends over your allies: while the Filter is up, teammates within 15 ft take 20% less from blows.

feats.name: Kihara Counterstudy
feats.text: The reflection travels the attacker's own road home: reflected blows return at three times their force instead of twice.

feats.name: White Wings
feats.text: When Black Wings would end, the wings shed in one vector discharge (4 CE): 4 Vector Dice to everything within 20 ft, and it's flung away.

domain.name: One-Way World
domain.sureHit: each round the world declares PUSH, PULL or REVERSE (pick it with the art): 8 Vector Dice, flung 40 ft — or, REVERSE, knocked flat

techniques.name: War God's Household
techniques.summary: Give a willing wandering soul a name and it joins a covenant — not as inventory, but as family. Each Regalia becomes a weapon, garment, guide, shield, scale, or sacred beast.

arts.name: Battle Muster
arts.text: call or dismiss the highlighted Regalia (F picks one) · up to your Active Limit

arts.name: Regalia Art
arts.text: the highlighted Regalia's signature Art (it must be active) · another active Regalia answers it (Household Answer, 1 CE)

arts.name: Borderline
arts.text: a 30-ft line across the cursor: the first foe to cross takes [6×PB dmg], is thrown back and stopped (Str) · 60 ft and 1 minute at L11

arts.name: Sevenfold Muster
arts.text: up to PB+1 active Regalia (all of them at L18) each strike a foe within 120 ft for 1d8

quick.name: Name the Next
quick.text: highlight the next Regalia in the household

maximum.name: Heaven's Grand Muster
maximum.text: every unbroken name answers once: up to your Active Limit, active or stored, 2d8 each on foes within 120 ft

passives.name: Household
passives.text: Eight Regalia, one of each form; three may be active at once (5 at L3 · 7 at L6 · 8 at L11 · all at L18). Active forms grant their passives.

passives.name: Guide Charm · Battle Garb
passives.text: Charm: you sense creatures and danger. Garb: +3 defense (Blessed +6) and Take the Wound blocks [5×PB + CE mod life] of a hit (1 CE, once per round).

passives.name: Greatblade · Twin Sidearms · Binding Lash
passives.text: Melee hits +1d8 once a second (Blessed 2d8, piercing defense); ranged hits +1d6 once a second; melee reach +30% and hits drag the foe in.

passives.name: Sacred Bulwark · Sky Lion · Judgment Scales
passives.text: Bulwark: +6 defense and Stand Between (2 CE, blocks [5×PB + CE mod life] of a hit). Lion: faster, higher; flies at L6. Scales: whoever hurts you is marked to take +[5×PB dmg] (2 CE, once per round).

passives.name: Coordination
passives.text: The first Household Answer each round is free.

passives.name: Hafuri Vessel
passives.text: When you would fall, the highlighted active Regalia risks its name for you: it becomes Blessed and you stand at 1 life (a second may be Blessed at L18). After that, Sacrificial Bloom: once per long rest a Blessed Vessel breaks to keep you up.

feats.name: Line That Casts Out Evil
feats.text: Your Borderline may run 120 ft long.

domain.name: Golden Citadel of Ten Thousand Names
domain.sureHit: every Regalia is active · each round every foe hears its name: [5×PB + CE mod dmg] (the Accused — whoever hurt your side — take double, are pulled inward and restrained)

techniques.name: Zero Gravity
techniques.summary: Five fingertips, and the world lets go. Make enemies, debris and yourself weightless — then decide exactly when gravity gets to remember.

arts.name: Zero Gravity
arts.text: touch the enemy nearest the cursor (within reach, Medium or smaller): it becomes weightless until released

arts.name: Lighten Self
arts.text: you go weightless: float, no fall damage (counts toward your limit) · cast again to land

arts.name: Debris Lift
arts.text: lift PB chunks of rubble that orbit you (each counts toward your limit)

arts.name: Meteor Shower
arts.text: drop every lifted chunk on a 20-ft radius within 60 ft, 1d6 each

arts.name: Weightless World
arts.text: everything within 15 ft becomes weightless

quick.name: Release
quick.text: fingertips together: gravity returns to everything at once — fallen enemies take 1d6 per 10 ft

passives.name: Target limit
passives.text: PB + 2 weightless things at once. Over the limit, your stomach rebels: every round you hold it down {chance PB 13} of the time, otherwise you're poisoned.

passives.name: Gunhead Martial Arts
passives.text: Your hits on weightless enemies deal +1d4 and knock them twice as far.

passives.name: Weightless World (passive)
passives.text: Any touch works: size limit Huge, target limit 2 × (PB + 2).

feats.name: Iron Stomach
feats.text: Her stomach still complains; she has stopped listening: 2 more weightless things at once, and the nausea grips you less often.

feats.name: Tether Pull
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): drag the weightless foe nearest your cursor (within 30 ft) toward you (a strong one resists).

feats.name: Combat Float
feats.text: While you're weightless you fly (hold Jump), swimming through the air.

techniques.name: Faultline Ledger
techniques.summary: Mark faults in bodies, let ordinary movement and impacts accumulate Strain, then cash it out in controlled ruptures.

arts.name: Rupture
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) ruptures: 1d6 per Strain banked (at least 1d6), and it staggers · 2+ Strain knocks it flat · 4+ holds it in a fissure for a round · 6+ throws it back · 8 (11th) cracks its armor too

quick.name: Survey
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) gains 1 Strain (and a Fault, if it had none)

passives.name: Accumulate Strain
passives.text: A foe you hurt gains a Fault for a minute. Once a round each, it gains Strain when it runs, when it's knocked about, and when you strike it.

passives.name: Aftershock
passives.text: Rupturing 4+ Strain passes 1 Strain to another Fault within 30 ft.

passives.name: Deep Fault
passives.text: Strain banks up to 8, and the Cataclysm tier opens.

feats.name: Hairline Crack
feats.text: When a fight begins, a hurt foe within 60 ft already has a Fault on the books.

feats.name: Cascade Failure
feats.text: When a foe bearing your Fault dies, the nearest other Fault within 30 ft gains 2 Strain.

domain.name: World Beneath the Cracks
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe gains a Fault and 2 Strain, and the deepest ruptures as a Cataclysm for free

techniques.name: Golden Fault
techniques.summary: Damage creates Fractures. Mend your own breaks into stronger seams, or strike through the enemy's before they heal.

arts.name: Gilded Seam
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft): 1d8 + CE mod, and a Fracture opens in it

quick.name: Mend the Break
quick.text: regain 5 + CE mod (twice that if you spend a Lacquer) · from 3rd you harden for a round after

maximum.name: Maximum: Golden Reassembly
maximum.text: you regain 15 + twice CE mod · every foe within 30 ft has its Fractures detonate: 2d10, plus 5 per Fracture, and it's knocked flat (a hardy foe stays standing)

passives.name: Fracture Sense
passives.text: Once a round, a foe you hurt gains a Fracture (up to 3; 5 from 11th) for a minute.

passives.name: Exploit the Break
passives.text: A weapon blow on a fractured foe spends a Fracture and a Lacquer (1 CE): 5 more (from 11th up to three at once, and three cracks its armor).

passives.name: Lacquer Pot
passives.text: You hold PB + CE mod Lacquer (at least 2), refilled by a long rest.

feats.name: Beautiful Scar
feats.text: Mending yourself leaves a golden scar: for 2 rounds, poison, burning, bleeding, confusion, slowing and weakness can't take hold.

feats.name: Shatterpoint
feats.text: When a foe reaches its most Fractures, you see the moment it will fall: your next weapon blow on it is a sure critical.

techniques.name: Mycelial Testament
techniques.summary: Grow a network through the battlefield, mend from any Node, and let the fallen feed the living.

arts.name: Symbiotic Pulse
arts.text: you regain a Spore Die + CE mod · one die more within 10 ft of a Node · each Nutrient you hold adds another (and is spent)

arts.name: Grasping Mycelium
arts.text: for a minute, 10 ft around the Node nearest your cursor (or the cursor itself) grasps: foes there are slowed and may be held fast each round

quick.name: Plant Node
quick.text: a Node at your cursor (30 ft) for ten minutes · up to your PB · foes that die within 10 ft of one feed you a Nutrient

maximum.name: Maximum: Worldroot Fruiting
maximum.text: for a minute the ground within 60 ft is your network: you gain a Nutrient each round, and foes there take 2 Spore Dice each round and are slowed

passives.name: Distributed Organism
passives.text: Near a Node, once a round (2 CE) a blow on you misses — you sink into the mycelium and surface at another Node within 60 ft.

feats.name: Medicinal Culture
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE + 1 Nutrient): graft a healing strain on the ally at your cursor, or on you, near a Node — it mends 2 Spore Dice + CE mod.

techniques.name: Nine Knots
techniques.summary: Bind motion and distance with cursed cord — simple to learn, frighteningly flexible once several knots overlap.

arts.name: Tie a Knot
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft): a Knot Die of damage, slowed, and hitched — it can't pull more than 30 ft from where it was tied · knots stack and last a minute

arts.name: Gordian Binding
arts.text: complete the knot: the foe at your cursor is bound for 3 rounds, a round more per Knot on it (a strong foe is only slowed)

quick.name: Snare
quick.text: the foe at your cursor is held fast for a round (a strong foe slips free — unless two Knots hold it)

feats.name: Executioner's Knot
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (3 CE): a hangman's noose on the foe at your cursor (30 ft) — 2 Knot Dice, and it's held fast for a round (a hardy one slips it) · on a foe bearing 3+ Knots, there's no slipping it and it holds 2 rounds.

domain.name: Temple of the Nine Ties
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is knotted, hitched and snared — no slipping free

techniques.name: Osmothèque
techniques.summary: Distill emotions and memories into supernatural perfumes: courage to wear, grief to throw, and a hunter's nose that forgets nothing.

arts.name: Formula
arts.text: use the chosen Formula (1 Note): Courage Accord — a veil of CE mod + 2×PB on you that bursts on the foes around you when it breaks · Funeral Myrrh — the foe at your cursor (30 ft) hits softer for a round · Hunter's Trace — you see every creature for an hour · Synesthetic Poison (11th, 2 Notes + 3 CE) — 2 Scent Dice and its senses scramble

maximum.name: Maximum: Perfect Accord
maximum.text: 3 Notes: for a minute a 30-ft aura — your veil refreshes every round, and foes inside hit softer

other.name: Perfumer's Case
other.text: throw the chosen Formula as a vial (30 ft): Funeral Myrrh or Synesthetic Poison splashes every foe within 10 ft of where it lands · Courage Accord and Hunter's Trace are simply worn

passives.name: Scent Notes
passives.text: PB + CE mod Notes (at least 3), refilled by a long rest; out of a fight you distill one a minute.

feats.name: Perfumer's Case
feats.text: The quick key throws your chosen Formula as a vial (2 CE): Myrrh or Poison splashes every foe within 10 ft of where it lands.

techniques.name: Palimpsest
techniques.summary: Record an earlier layer of a place or a person, then selectively restore it — red ink on the present.

arts.name: Margin
arts.text: first press: record where you stand · next press: return there and regain a Revision Die (one is spent; with none left you only return)

arts.name: Redaction
arts.text: every hostile shot within 30 ft of your cursor is struck from the page, and foes there lose their footing for a moment

quick.name: Position Note
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) is noted: a round later it's pulled back to where it stood and takes a Revision Die (a nimble foe is only stopped)

maximum.name: Maximum: First Draft
maximum.text: everything within 30 ft returns to where it stood five seconds ago: you heal 4 Revision Dice, and foes are pulled back and take 4 Revision Dice (a nimble foe takes half and stays)

feats.name: Errata
feats.text: A foe that resists its Position Note still carries the correction: it's slowed for a round.

feats.name: Margin Walker
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): step into the margin for a round — unseen, untouchable, unable to act — then return to where you stood.

techniques.name: Territorial Influence
techniques.summary: Turn the battlefield into a Go board: Stones project overlapping Influence, and foes who let themselves be surrounded lose their freedom.

arts.name: Take
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft): an Influence Die, plus one per Stone whose Influence reaches it · from 6th, with no foe at your cursor, Connect your Stones: every pair within 40 ft draws a cutting line (2 Influence Dice to what it crosses, 1 CE more)

quick.name: Place Stone
quick.text: a Stone at your cursor (30 ft) projecting 10 ft of Influence (15 from 11th) for five minutes

passives.name: Atari and Capture
passives.text: A foe in two of your Influences is slowed; in three, it's held fast for a round (once a round).

passives.name: Living Board
passives.text: Once a round, a hit lays a Stone beside the foe (1 CE).

feats.name: Reading Ahead
feats.text: When a fight begins, a Stone is placed at your feet for free.

feats.name: Sacrifice Play
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE) detonates the Stone nearest your cursor: 2 Influence Dice to foes beside it (a nimble one halves it).

domain.name: Nineteen-by-Nineteen Funeral Board
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is Captured and takes 3 Influence Dice

techniques.name: Cursed Lotus
techniques.summary: A reactive ward: a blue lotus waits on your body, and the next wound detonates it into a shower of cutting petals.

arts.name: Lotus Petal
arts.text: a single cutting petal at your cursor: 1d8

quick.name: Cursed Lotus
quick.text: a blue lotus waits on your body: the next blow on you detonates it — 4d4 to everything within 10 ft (6d4 from 6th, 8d4 from 11th)

feats.name: Double Bloom
feats.text: You can keep two lotuses waiting at once; only one bursts each round.

techniques.name: Flow Technique
techniques.summary: A counter-flow art: when a blow lands on you, blunt it and channel the residue into your next strike.

arts.name: Flowing Palm
arts.text: a palm strike on the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 1d8, plus everything the flow is holding

passives.name: The River Answers
passives.text: Once a round a blow on you is caught (1 CE): it lands a third softer, and the residue waits for your next blow.

feats.name: Catch and Release
feats.text: A blow the river catches is answered at once: the attacker (within 30 ft) takes 1d8 + PB.

techniques.name: Stone Cutting Style
techniques.summary: A martial technique that turns the body into a chisel: blows tear through stone, and two forms — Stone Cutting Strike and Swift Fury — focus that breaking force.

arts.name: Stone Cutting Strike
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2d10 (3d10 from 6th), and the stone around it cracks apart

quick.name: Swift Fury
quick.text: three chisel blows on the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 1d8 each

passives.name: The Body Is the Tool
passives.text: Your weapon blows bite 1d8 harder (once a second), and you cut through stone far faster.

feats.name: Keystone Break
feats.text: When Stone Cutting Strike cracks stone apart, the break keeps going (1 CE): foes within 10 ft take 2d8 + PB (a nimble one halves it).

feats.name: Living Quarry
feats.text: Constructs, golems and things of stone or metal are quarry to you: everything you deal them lands half again as hard.

techniques.name: Synovia Manipulation
techniques.summary: Liquefy the bones where they stand: soften the frame so every blow afterward lands deeper — and plant mites that eat the marrow.

arts.name: Synovia Manipulation
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft): 4d12, and its frame softens — every hit on it lands harder for a round (a tough foe halves it and stays firm)

quick.name: Bone Broth
quick.text: every foe within 30 ft is liquefied at once (4d12 and softened)

passives.name: Devour the Marrow
passives.text: Once a round, a weapon blow plants marrow mites (3 CE): the limb breaks — slowed and hitting softer for a minute.

passives.name: Softened Frame
passives.text: Softened foes take even more from every hit.

feats.name: Ossuary Sense
feats.text: You feel the architecture of bodies through stone: you sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Joint Lock
feats.text: Once a round, a weapon blow on a softened foe seizes the hinge: it's held a moment (a strong one tears free).

feats.name: Broth of the Fallen
feats.text: Bone Broth feeds you: PB life for each foe it catches (up to five).

techniques.name: Vairocana
techniques.summary: Harmony and chaos — the infinite universe that contains both: sense everything, then loose chaos bolts and wild cosmic effects.

arts.name: Harmony
arts.text: for a minute you sense every living thing far around you, and you mend a little

quick.name: Chaos
quick.text: a Chaos Bolt at your cursor (90 ft): 2d8 of a random element (more with level), and it may leap to another foe · or, one time in three, a roll on the Chaos Table around the foe you aim at

maximum.name: Maximum: Cosmic Genesis
maximum.text: a new law of physics in 30 ft at your cursor for a while: foes inside fall upward, slow, and take 2d10 each round

passives.name: Balance
passives.text: The Chaos Table's backlash can't touch you.

feats.name: Tides of Harmony
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE, once a minute) brings you into harmony with the world: your next weapon blow is a sure critical.

domain.name: Mandala of Mutual Paradox
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe suffers a Chaos Table effect of your choosing — every pulse, guaranteed

techniques.name: ████ and Light
techniques.summary: An innate technique that forges killing intent into bars of light — thrown, rained down, and finally ridden as the beam itself.

arts.name: Light Construct
arts.text: a bar of light thrown at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8 radiant · from 6th you flash 10 ft after it on a hit, and holding pours up to CE mod CE for more dice

quick.name: Rain of Light
quick.text: bars of light fall within 10 ft of you: 3d10 radiant (5d10 at 6th, 8d10 at 11th, 10d10 at 18th), and what they hit is pinned (a nimble foe slips free) · hold to pour more

maximum.name: Maximum: Light Speed
maximum.text: you become the beam: a 120-ft line along your aim (200 at 18th), 18d10 radiant to everything on it, and you arrive at the end

passives.name: Hyperspeed
passives.text: Light can't burn the hand that holds it: you shrug off bright flames.

feats.name: Dazzling Glare
feats.text: Once a round, a creature within 30 ft attacking you meets a flare of light (2 CE): about half the time its blow misses, and it's dazzled.

feats.name: Irradiated Light
feats.text: Once a round, a construct or rain bar that hits leaves radiation (1 CE): 1d6 more, and the foe is poisoned.

techniques.name: Braxton Veil
techniques.summary: Flood the battlefield with a nauseating, electrically wrong atmosphere whose modes reshape sight, weight, sensing and stamina.

arts.name: Atmospheric Pulse
arts.text: the Veil exhales: everything in it (or within 15 ft of you without it) takes 2d6, gains Exposure, and is poisoned (a tough foe resists)

quick.name: Unnatural Atmosphere
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: the Veil hangs around you (15 ft; 20 from 6th, 30 from 11th) — each round foes in it gain Exposure: 1 slowed · 2 weakened · 3 confused · 4 poisoned and rotting

passives.name: Modes (Technique Key 1)
passives.text: Sulfur: exposed foes heal at half · Crimson: you're hard to see · Gravitic: foes inside are dragged slow · Static: exposed foes lose their aim (hit softer).

passives.name: Floating Apparition
passives.text: You hover while the Veil is up.

feats.name: Eddy Reading
feats.text: While your Veil is up, you sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Red Star Descent
feats.text: Pulse while diving and you drive the Veil down with you: only foes within 10 ft are struck, but for 3d8 more.

domain.name: The Hill Beneath the Red Star
domain.sureHit: the whole barrier becomes the Veil with every Mode at once: every chosen foe gains Exposure and is poisoned

techniques.name: Death Makes Two
techniques.summary: Severe injury grows more spectral heads unless the wound is cauterized — more heads, more bites, more venom, more body to punish.

arts.name: Hydra Strike
arts.text: every head bites the foe at your cursor (20 ft): a Head Die each (1d6, growing to 1d10), and venom

maximum.name: Maximum: Ninefold Lernaean Body
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: nine heads at once, d12 bites, and you tower

passives.name: Two Grow Back
passives.text: A heavy blow (a tenth of your life) grows another head (up to PB + 1) — fire burns one away instead. Each head bites the nearest foe every round and toughens you.

feats.name: Swamp-Born
feats.text: You swim freely and breathe water, and while submerged fire can't burn a head away.

feats.name: Venom Reservoir
feats.text: Your heads' venom is a leash: what they bite is slowed (not a great foe).

feats.name: Heracles Problem
feats.text: Each head burned away by fire mends you a Head Die — spite, formalized.

techniques.name: Empty Herd
techniques.summary: Open feeding wounds and drain blood. Every feeding drives an automatic metamorphosis — gaunt predator, fed hunter, swollen apex.

arts.name: Feed
arts.text: drain the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2d8 and heal half of it — a wounded foe gives 3d8 and closes its wound · every feeding advances your body

quick.name: Goat-Sucker Leap
quick.text: you pounce 30 ft onto the foe at your cursor and Feed

maximum.name: Maximum: Night of the Empty Pens
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: you sense every living thing nearby, run and climb freely, and every blow opens a wound

passives.name: Feeding Wound
passives.text: Once a round a weapon blow opens a wound (1 CE; up to PB at once): it bleeds 1d6 every round for a minute.

passives.name: Metamorphosis
passives.text: Gaunt (0–1 feedings): +damage on unhurt foes · Fed (2–3): faster, Feed heals more · Swollen Apex (4+): hits harder, but slower. A long rest resets it.

feats.name: Purging Molt
feats.text: Technique Key 1: regress one stage of your Metamorphosis to slough tainted flesh — poison, venom, bleeding and sickness fall away.

feats.name: Spraying Wound
feats.text: Once a round, a critical weapon blow sprays: a second foe beside the target gains a Feeding Wound, free.

feats.name: Packless Hunter
feats.text: With no ally within 15 ft, once a round your blow on a wounded foe drives it from the herd: it reels away and hits far softer for a round (a strong will holds).

techniques.name: Gleipnir Breaker
techniques.summary: Begin under self-imposed chains: obey them for stability, snap them at the right moment to release Ragnarök — and turn every restraint into fuel.

arts.name: Fenris Bite
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 2d10, and 1d10 more for every Ragnarök token you spend (all of them)

quick.name: Snap a Bond
quick.text: a chain breaks: everything within 15 ft takes 2d8 and is thrown back, you gain a Ragnarök token, and you fight in fury for a round (faster, harder-hitting)

maximum.name: Maximum: Ragnarök Unbound
maximum.text: with 3+ Bonds broken: Focus, 1 minute — every token spent at once becomes raw strength; you're huge, swift and savage, and every blow shakes the ground

passives.name: Bonds
passives.text: While any Bond holds, blows land softer and nothing throws you. Bonds reform one at a time, out of combat.

passives.name: Restraint is Fuel
passives.text: Being slowed, held or bound gives you a Ragnarök token (once a round).

feats.name: Slipped Leash
feats.text: When something slows, webs, freezes or petrifies you, you take the token and slip it at once, 10 ft away (once a round).

techniques.name: Gorgon's Regard
techniques.summary: Force every opponent to choose between fighting blind and risking progressive petrification.

arts.name: Stone Glare
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) meets your eyes: 2d10, and it stiffens at once

quick.name: The Regard
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: every foe within 60 ft that faces you stiffens each round — slowed, weakened, then turned to stone for a few seconds (great foes only stiffen)

feats.name: Snake Crown
feats.text: The snakes lend their senses: you see in the dark and sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Cracking Stone
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): shatter the calcifying shell of the foe at your cursor (60 ft) — 2d10, and a d10 more per stiffening it carries (spent).

domain.name: Garden of the Unblinking Queen
domain.sureHit: there is nowhere not to look: every chosen foe stiffens a step, and the fully stone take 6d10 as they crack

techniques.name: Leeds Infernal
techniques.summary: Build Pursuit by running down fleeing prey, then spend it on dive-bombs, horn launches and impossible aerial strikes.

arts.name: Dive Bomb
