arts.text: you hurl yourself at the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8, and a d8 more for every Pursuit you spend (all of it)

quick.name: Horn Toss
quick.text: 1 Pursuit: your next blow launches its target into the air (a strong foe holds)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Leeds Devil Takes Flight
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: you grow huge and winged — swift flight, Pursuit up to 12, and two more every round

passives.name: Pine Barrens Predator
passives.text: You glide. Pursuit builds as you run, fall and strike on the move; standing still lets it cool away.

passives.name: True Flight
passives.text: You fly.

feats.name: Roofline Hunter
feats.text: Vertical surfaces become roads: you cling to and run up walls.

feats.name: Broken-Bridle Pursuit
feats.text: Webbed, frozen, petrified or slowed, the hunger only sharpens: gain 2 Pursuit when it takes hold.

techniques.name: Long Step Procession
techniques.summary: Turn distance into a resource: uncanny strides make Steps that dodge blows, bridge gaps, and leave glowing processions behind.

arts.name: Stilt Kick
arts.text: a kick from far too high (15 ft): 2d8 and a shove — spend a Step to knock the foe down too (a strong foe keeps its feet)

quick.name: Long Stride
quick.text: 1 Step: one impossible stride, 25 ft toward your cursor (from 3rd it leaves a glowing Procession Path: 2d6 to foes who cross it, for a minute)

passives.name: Impossible Stride
passives.text: Every 10 ft walked earns a Step (up to PB, two a round); two rounds standing still and they fade. Holding a Step, your reach is absurd.

passives.name: Between the Frames
passives.text: A blow on you can be stepped out of (2 Steps).

feats.name: Tall Enough
feats.text: Your jumps go far higher.

feats.name: Walk Behind the Camera
feats.text: Holding 2+ Steps in dim light or darkness, the procession vanishes: you're hard to see and foes lose interest.

domain.name: Footage That Should Not Exist
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe leaves a translucent frame where it stood — and is snapped back to its last frame, taking 3d8 as it's pulled through

techniques.name: Red Sand Below
techniques.summary: Build a hidden network of Tremor Paths beneath the fight, then erupt with acid, lightning, dragging strikes and collapsing ground.

arts.name: Erupt
arts.text: the ground bursts under the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8 acid and lightning · on a Tremor Path, 4d8 and it's dragged down for a moment (a strong foe holds)

quick.name: Burrow
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: you sink into the earth — unseen, hard to hit, fast — and leave Tremor Paths where you travel · attacking surfaces you

maximum.name: Maximum: Olgoi-Khorkhoi
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: you become the great worm — blows land softer, your Erupts strike everything around the target, and every foe that steps on a Path is burned

passives.name: Tremor Paths
passives.text: Paths last 10 minutes (up to twice PB); you sense every creature standing on one.

feats.name: Venom Static
feats.text: Erupt's acid and lightning short-circuit the nerves: its foe is stunned for a moment (a hardy one shrugs it off).

feats.name: False Tremor
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): lay a false Tremor Path at your cursor (60 ft) — it counts as one of yours for Erupt.

techniques.name: Red-Eyed Omen
techniques.summary: See disasters before they fully exist, stockpile Omens, and spend those warnings to step out of harm or make a foretold opening unavoidable.

arts.name: Red-Eyed Glare
arts.text: the red eyes fix the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8, and its Disaster Clock ticks

arts.name: Winged Intercession
arts.text: black wings for 10 minutes: you fly

quick.name: Omen Sight
quick.text: watch the foe at your cursor for a minute: its blows on you yield Omens, and from 3rd its Disaster Clock fills each round it acts

passives.name: Eyes Before the Storm
passives.text: A blow that would land on you is foreseen (1 Omen + 1 CE): you're already 10 ft away.

passives.name: Disaster Clock
passives.text: A watched foe's Clock fills (to 3) each round it acts; at 3 your next blow on it is a sure critical and the Clock resets.

feats.name: Scarlet Afterimage
feats.text: A foreseen blow leaves your red ghost behind: the next blow within a round strikes it instead.

feats.name: Prophet of Impact
feats.text: When a Disaster Clock reaches 3, you may spend 2 Omens + 1 CE to mark where it lands: the foe is knocked flat for a round (a nimble one keeps its feet).

domain.name: Point Pleasant
domain.sureHit: every surface shows red-eyed afterimages of near futures: every chosen foe's Disaster Clock ticks, and you gain an Omen

techniques.name: Seven Sacred Coils
techniques.summary: Wrap friends and foes in living cursed coils: friendly coils ward, heal and shed ailments; hostile coils constrict, poison and drag.

arts.name: Hostile Coil
arts.text: a coil wraps the foe at your cursor (60 ft) for a minute: each round it's squeezed (2d6), poisoned, and dragged toward you

quick.name: Friendly Coil
quick.text: a coil wraps you for a minute: blows land softer, you mend a little each round, and ailments slough off

feats.name: Jeweled Hood
feats.text: While any of your coils is wrapped, you sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Constriction Expert
feats.text: Your hostile coils anchor as they squeeze: the wrapped foe is slowed (not a great one).

domain.name: Palace Beneath the Sacred River
domain.sureHit: the river's coils rise: every chosen foe is wrapped (4d6, poisoned, held a moment), and you mend

techniques.name: Starvation Colossus
techniques.summary: Violence feeds Hunger. Spend it to assemble giant skeletal arms, ribs, jaws — and finally a towering cursed exoskeleton.

arts.name: Bone Arm
arts.text: a giant skeletal hand slams the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d10, and a d10 more for every 2 Hunger you spend (all of it)

arts.name: Gnashing Jaws
arts.text: a skull's jaws snap down a 20-ft cone: 4d8, and a Hunger for each foe caught

quick.name: Rib Cage
quick.text: 3 Hunger: ribs close around you for a round — blows land at half

maximum.name: Maximum: Gashadokuro
maximum.text: with 6+ Hunger, all of it: Focus, 1 minute — the starving skeleton rises around you: blows land far softer, your weapon reaches far, and every round the ground shakes (4d10 around you)

passives.name: Hunger
passives.text: Each blow you land feeds a Hunger (once a second); a foe dying near you, two. Up to 10.

feats.name: Bone Chime
feats.text: You hear the half-dead rattle: while any foe within 30 ft is below half its life, you sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Jaw of Famine
feats.text: Gnashing Jaws feeds you: 5 life for each foe caught (up to three).

techniques.name: Visitors at the Window
techniques.summary: Call an almost-indestructible nuisance swarm that steals, clings, rattles defenders, and keeps coming back.

arts.name: They Came Back
arts.text: for a minute a swarm of Visitors besets your foes (PB at once): 1d6 a nip, and what they nip hits softer for a few seconds · any that vanish come back while the swarm lasts

quick.name: Rattle the Doors
quick.text: every Visitor rushes the foe at your cursor at once

maximum.name: Maximum: Siege at Kelly-Hopkinsville
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: a 30-ft Visitor Perimeter at your cursor — every foe inside is nipped and rattled each round (2d6, and it hits softer)

feats.name: Shiny Eyes
feats.text: While the swarm is out, its eyes glow (dim light around each Visitor) and you sense every creature near you.

techniques.name: World Coil
techniques.summary: Lay spectral serpent coils across the field, close them into Rings, and decide whether each circle protects, poisons, or constricts.

arts.name: Close the Ring
arts.text: a serpent Ring closes at your cursor (60 ft, 20 ft across) for a minute (up to PB): Ward — you take less inside · Venom — foes inside take 2d6 each round · Constrict — foes inside are slowed and take 2d8 each round

quick.name: Tighten
quick.text: every Ring tightens at once: every foe in one takes 2d8 and is held for a moment

feats.name: Ocean Coil
feats.text: The serpent's home water: you swim freely and breathe underwater.

feats.name: Closing Snap
feats.text: A Ring that closes snaps shut on the foe nearest its heart: it's dragged toward the center and held a moment (a strong one holds its ground).

feats.name: Venom of the World
feats.text: Venom Rings bite past resistance: 1d6 more each round, and a true venom instead of poison.

domain.name: Midgard Encircled
domain.sureHit: the World Serpent closes around the Domain: every chosen foe is constricted (held, 4d8) and poisoned

techniques.name: Amazon Champion
techniques.summary: Divine arms and bracelets, the Lasso of Truth, Amazon leaps, flight, Godkiller training and the Godwave Counter.

arts.name: Divine Weapon
arts.text: your divine sword or spear toward the cursor: 1d10 + CE mod

arts.name: Lasso of Truth
arts.text: the golden lasso, 30 ft: the foe at your cursor is bound (a strength check) — a bound foe can't lie, and fights at half its heart

arts.name: Bracelet Shockwave
arts.text: 3 Favor: clash your bracelets — a 30-ft cone, 7d10, everything in it thrown 30 ft

arts.name: Champion of Themyscira
arts.text: 1 minute: blows land far softer, you fly fast, your weapon deals 2d10 more, and your Favor can't fall below 1

maximum.name: Maximum: Godwave Counter
maximum.text: spend all your Favor: for one round, the next great blow against you is met with crossed bracelets — 10d12 + your level of it stopped, and if it's stopped entirely, a 60-ft wave of the stopped force goes back the way it came (up to 12d12)

passives.name: Bracelets of Submission
passives.text: Once per round (1 CE + 1 Favor), a shot that reaches you is reduced by 1d10 + your level; stopped entirely, it's sent back.

passives.name: Favor
passives.text: Your first weapon hit each round earns 1 Favor (up to 5; 10 at 20th).

passives.name: Amazon Leap
passives.text: You jump four times as far; once per round, after running 20 ft, a weapon hit deals 2d8 more.

passives.name: Flight
passives.text: You fly (hold Jump), and once per round your weapon deals 1d8 more.

passives.name: Godkiller Training
passives.text: Against bosses you strike true more often, and your first hit each round on one earns a second Favor.

feats.name: Amazon Grappler
feats.text: A foe bound by the Lasso is hauled 15 ft toward you (1 CE; not a great one).

techniques.name: Atlantean Kingship
techniques.summary: Atlantean blood, the trident, marine telepathy, the Seven Seas' tidal wave and whirlpool, the Trench and Leviathan's Wake.

arts.name: Water Shaping
arts.text: water rises at your command: a 10-ft wave toward the cursor (15-ft with the trident), 1d8 + CE mod, shoving foes 10 ft · with the trident in hand, the cast key thrusts it instead

arts.name: Marine Telepathy
arts.text: the sea's creatures answer: PB beasts of the deep fight for you for 1 minute, 1d8 each

arts.name: King of the Seven Seas
arts.text: once a minute, chosen with Technique Key 2: a 60-ft tidal wave (2d10, knocked down, swept 30 ft) · or a 20-ft whirlpool at your cursor for 1 minute (each round, foes in it are held and drawn in)

arts.name: The Trench Answers
arts.text: a leviathan breaches under a point within 120 ft: everything within 60 ft of it takes 4d10 + 4d10, and the ground floods for a minute — foes wade through it

quick.name: Trident of the King
quick.text: the trident in your hand: thrusts reach 10 ft for 1d8 + CE mod, and Technique Key 1 throws it 60 ft — it flies back to you

maximum.name: Maximum: Leviathan's Wake
maximum.text: the ocean stands up: a 120-ft wave along a line, 8d10, everything swept 60 ft · the ground floods for a minute, and while you stand in it your arts cost 2 CE less

passives.name: Atlantean Blood
passives.text: You breathe water, swim as you walk, and the cold of the deep can't touch you.

feats.name: Pressure King
feats.text: Underwater, the trench fights with you: once a round your weapon blow on a submerged foe adds 1d8 cold, and it's chilled and slowed.

techniques.name: Backwards Magic
techniques.summary: Spoken backwards: telekinesis, fire, shields, illusions, vanishing, healing, teleporting, freezing, countercharms and the Backwards Word.

arts.name: Speak the Verb
arts.text: speak the chosen verb backwards (Technique Key 1 chooses) · EVOM EHT TCEJBO (1 CE): the foe at your cursor is thrown 30 ft (a strength check) · ERIF (1 CE): fire, 2d10 · DLEIHS (1 CE): the next blow within a round is halved · from 3rd: NOISULLI (2 CE): a 20-ft illusion at your cursor for 10 minutes — foes in it are lost in it · ESAPAHC (1 CE): you vanish until the next round · from 6th: LAEH (2 CE): heal 1d8 + CE mod · TROPELET (2 CE): teleport 60 ft to the cursor · EERF (2 CE): the foe at your cursor is frozen in ice for 3 rounds · from 11th: LLEPS EHT OTUAH (3 CE): every hostile shot within 60 ft unravels · from 18th every verb that harms deals 1d8 more

maximum.name: Maximum: The Backwards Word
maximum.text: one whole sentence, backwards, without a stumble: for 1 minute the scene within 120 ft is rewritten — every lesser foe forgets the fight, every great one fights at half its strength, and you're mended 4d8

other.name: Escape Artist
other.text: it was a trick all along: you slip webs, ice, stone and anything else that holds or slows you

feats.name: Escape Artist
feats.text: The quick key slips any hold (1 CE): webs, ice, stone, slowing and confusion fall away.

feats.name: Stage Fright
feats.text: Each verb you speak unnerves the foe at your cursor (30 ft): it hits far softer for a round (a strong will holds).

feats.name: The Prestige
feats.text: Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 life, already 60 ft away toward your cursor.

techniques.name: Emerald Will
techniques.summary: Constructs of will, flight and shield, complex constructs, willpower, the Mecha Construct, the Emerald Colossus and Sector 2814.

arts.name: Emerald Construct
arts.text: 1 CE + 1 Charge: a construct of will flies at the cursor, 60 ft, 2d8

arts.name: Flight
arts.text: 1 CE + 1 Charge: 10 minutes of flight (hold Jump)

arts.name: Complex Construct
arts.text: 1 CE + 2 Charge, at your cursor (60 ft), chosen with Technique Key 1: a giant hand (4d8, and held a round) · a cage (held 3 rounds) · a wall of will (stops foes and shots for a minute)

arts.name: Mecha Construct
arts.text: 5 Charge, 1 minute: construct armor — much tougher, flight, and your constructs hit 2d10 harder

maximum.name: Maximum: Emerald Colossus
maximum.text: 10 Charge, 3 rounds: a towering construct fights beside you — every second it slams the foes nearest your cursor, 6d10 in 20 ft

passives.name: Power Ring
passives.text: Ring charge (10; 20 at 20th) comes back 1 every 10 s, and in full on a long rest.

passives.name: Shield of Will
passives.text: Once per round (1 CE + 1 Charge), a blow is caught on a construct shield: 2d10 + PB less — and you gain 1 Will.

passives.name: Willpower
passives.text: With Will, each construct spends 1 for 1d10 more.

passives.name: No Evil Shall Escape
passives.text: While holding 3+ Will, the first construct each round costs 1 less Charge.

feats.name: Ring Slinging
feats.text: Emerald Construct launches from a point near your cursor (within 30 ft), not from you.

feats.name: Emergency Protocol
feats.text: Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you makes the ring flare on instinct (2 CE): you stand at 1 life and mend Will + PB.

domain.name: Sector 2814
domain.sureHit: each pulse a construct acts on its own, in turn: an 8d10 blast on every chosen foe · a giant hand that holds them until the next pulse

techniques.name: Empathic Sorcery
techniques.summary: Empathic sense, the raven soul-self, empathic bolts, shared pain, Azarath ascendant and the Daughter of Trigon.

arts.name: Empathic Bolt
arts.text: a bolt of someone's pain, 2d10 · hold to pour 2 CE more for 1d8 more (once)

quick.name: Soul-Self
quick.text: 10 minutes: your soul-self, a raven of shadow, flies out beside you (120 ft; 300 ft from 18th) · from 6th it strikes foes for 2d10

maximum.name: Maximum: Daughter of Trigon
maximum.text: stop filtering, for 1 minute: four arms, you fly, blows barely touch you, your bolts hit 4d10, and every foe within 60 ft that sees you is afraid (its blows land weaker) · once per round, Technique Key 1 is a hellfire wave, 6d10 in 30 ft

passives.name: Empathic Sense
passives.text: You feel every creature near you (foes are shown).

passives.name: Shared Pain
passives.text: Once per round (2 CE), a foe that hurts you takes half of it back.

passives.name: Azarath Ascendant
passives.text: Your arts cost 1 CE less, and Technique Key 2 is White Raven (1 CE, 1 minute): your empathic arts deal 1d8 more.

feats.name: Trigon's Bargain
feats.text: Once a round, an art costing 2+ CE may take its price in pain instead: 1d8 life (never below a quarter), for 2 CE less.

feats.name: Nevermore
feats.text: Projecting your soul-self unfurls the dread: foes within 30 ft hit softer for a minute (a strong will holds).

techniques.name: Kryptonian
techniques.summary: Solar Body, heat vision, flight and super breath, Man of Steel, Solar Flare, Sun-Dipped and World of Cardboard.

arts.name: Super Strength
arts.text: a fist toward the cursor: 1d8 (1d10 in Solar Body; +2d10 with World of Cardboard; +3d10 Sun-Dipped)

arts.name: Heat Vision
arts.text: 1 CE + 1 Charge: a 90-ft line of heat from your eyes, 3d10

arts.name: Flight
arts.text: 1 CE + 1 Charge: 10 minutes of flight (hold Jump) · while flying, Technique Key 1 is Super Breath (2 CE): a 30-ft cone that blows foes 30 ft away or freezes them for 3d8

arts.name: Solar Flare
arts.text: spend all your Charge (at least 5): everything within 30 ft takes 2d10 per Charge spent · your Solar features go dark until you recharge

arts.name: World of Cardboard
arts.text: 1 CE + 2 Charge, 1 minute: your fists hit 2d10 harder

arts.name: Sun-Dipped
arts.text: +5 Charge, 1 minute: fast flight, blows barely touch you, your attacks deal 3d10 more, and you heal PB every round

quick.name: Solar Body
quick.text: 1 CE + 1 Charge, 1 minute: you drink the sunlight into your cells — blows land far softer on you, your fists hit 1d10, and you jump four times as far

maximum.name: Maximum: World of Cardboard
maximum.text: the day he stops holding back: one blow toward the cursor and a 30-ft shockwave, 2d12 per Charge you pour in (all of it)

passives.name: Solar Charge
passives.text: Up to 10 Charge (15 at 20th). You gain 1 every 10 s under the open daytime sky; each morning you start with at least 5.

passives.name: Man of Steel
passives.text: Once per round (1 CE + 1 Charge), a heavy blow is halved.

passives.name: Last Son
passives.text: Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 life instead (2 CE).

feats.name: Sun-Drinker
feats.text: Fire is income, not harm: burning can't take hold of you, and lava scorches you less.

feats.name: Freeze Breath
feats.text: Super Breath learns winter: foes in the heart of the gust are frozen in place for a round and frostbitten (a hardy one resists).

techniques.name: Living Lightning
techniques.summary: The Word, the wisdom of Solomon, the strength of Hercules, the power of Zeus, the speed of Mercury and the courage of Achilles.

arts.name: Champion's Fist
arts.text: Champion only: a lightning fist toward the cursor, 1d8 + CE mod (1d8 more from 6th; 4d10 as the Living Lightning)

arts.name: Power of Zeus
arts.text: Champion only, once per transformation: lightning down a 90-ft line, 6d10

quick.name: The Word
quick.text: "SHAZAM!" — lightning strikes you and you're the Champion for 10 minutes: far stronger, lightning can't hurt you, and your fists crackle · speak it again (free) to turn back

maximum.name: Maximum: The Living Lightning
maximum.text: 1 minute: you are the bolt, not the boy — Technique Key 1 crosses up to 300 ft toward the cursor in a flash, your fists hit 4d10, and once per round Technique Key 2 calls lightning down on the cursor, 6d10 in 20 ft

passives.name: Wisdom of Solomon
passives.text: Once per long rest, a mind-affecting effect on you breaks at once.

passives.name: Strength of Hercules, Stamina of Atlas
passives.text: Champion only: your fists deal 1d8 more, and becoming the Champion heals you your level + PB.

passives.name: Speed of Mercury
passives.text: Champion only: you fly (hold Jump), and you're much faster.

passives.name: Courage of Achilles
passives.text: Champion only: fear can't touch you, and once per long rest a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 life, still the Champion.

feats.name: Lightning Rod
feats.text: As the Champion, once a round you may catch a shot that would hit you (1 CE, about a third of the time) and hurl it back as lightning: 2d10 to the nearest foe within 120 ft.

techniques.name: Martian
techniques.summary: Shapeshifting, Solid and Light density, phasing, telepathy, the True Martian form and Psychic Communion.

arts.name: Martian Strike
arts.text: a blow toward the cursor: 1d8 + CE mod in Solid form (1d12 from 11th, and once per round 1d8 more), 1d4 + CE mod in Light

arts.name: Phase
arts.text: for a round, nothing solid can touch you — and you can't attack

arts.name: Mind Link
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: you read the foe at your cursor's surface thoughts (a resolve check) — you see every blow coming, and its blows land a quarter softer

arts.name: Deep Telepathy
arts.text: psychic intrusion: the foe at your cursor is stunned for a round (a resolve check)

arts.name: True Martian
arts.text: 1 minute: your true shape — you fly fast, your blows deal 2d10 more, and density changes cost nothing

maximum.name: Maximum: Psychic Communion
maximum.text: every foe within 60 ft is linked to your mind: 10d10 (a resolve check halves it), and for a round you know everything each one intends — its blows land softer

passives.name: Shapeshift
passives.text: Solid form: heavy fists and you can't be knocked back.

passives.name: Light Density
passives.text: Technique Key 1: Light form — you fly (hold Jump) and move faster, but hit lighter.

passives.name: Selective Phasing
passives.text: Once per round (2 CE): a blow that would land passes through you.

feats.name: Ghost
feats.text: While Phased, one hand can solidify for a single Martian Strike without ending the Phase.

feats.name: Detective Mind
feats.text: While you hold a foe's thoughts through Mind Link, you read its intent: once a round, its blow on you is sidestepped.

techniques.name: Belief
techniques.summary: Power is given, one believer at a time: ride the wind, pelt foes with winter, and bury the field in a snow day.

arts.name: Snowball Barrage
arts.text: three snowballs at your cursor (60 ft): 1d6 + CE mod cold each, and what they hit is chilled and slowed

arts.name: Whiteout
arts.text: snow swallows 60 ft around you for a minute: foes inside are blinded now and then and slowed

quick.name: Wind-Rider
quick.text: the wind carries you: flight for a round — a full minute while your Belief is 3 or more

maximum.name: Maximum: Eternal Snow Day
maximum.text: a blizzard over the whole area for five minutes: every foe near you is slowed and chilled, and you ride the wind freely through it

passives.name: Belief
passives.text: Belief (up to PB + CE mod) grows when your snow hits and with every player near you; it fades slowly out of a fight.

passives.name: The Wind Remembers
passives.text: Once a round (2 CE), a blow on you blows you aside — it lands softer and you're carried away from it.

techniques.name: Death's Due
techniques.summary: Twin sickles that join into one, a whistle that freezes the blood, and a mark no one outruns — Death has come for his due.

arts.name: Reaper's Sickles
arts.text: split: two cuts at the foe at your cursor (10 ft), 1d6 each · joined: one greatsickle sweep (15 ft), 2d6 to everything in the arc

arts.name: The Whistle
arts.text: every foe within 60 ft hears it: frightened for a minute — they hit softer (a steady mind resists) · a foe already afraid takes 2d8

arts.name: Why Did You Run?
arts.text: step through the dark to your due — or the foe at your cursor (120 ft)

arts.name: The Circle Closes
arts.text: a ring of black-red flame 30 ft around you for a minute: foes inside can't leave it, and the flame burns those who try (2d8)

quick.name: Death's Mark
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (120 ft) is your due: your sickles bite it 1d6 deeper, and you always see it

passives.name: Wounds That Do Not Close
passives.text: Your sickle wounds bleed, and your due's armor gives way.

domain.name: The Last Whistle
domain.sureHit: No Running: a chosen foe that moved since the last whistle takes 6d8 — the rest are frightened

techniques.name: Discord
techniques.summary: The goddess of chaos with a golden apple: bind foes in spite, sting them for it, and turn them on each other.

arts.name: The Apple of Discord
arts.text: roll the apple to your cursor (60 ft): foes within 10 ft are spite-bound for a minute — confused now and then — and each gives you a Spite (a steady mind resists)

arts.name: Sow Discord
arts.text: 1 Spite: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) turns on its own kind for a while (a steady mind resists; a great foe only hits softer)

quick.name: Spite
quick.text: 1 Spite: every spite-bound foe you can see, and the foe at your cursor, takes 1d6

maximum.name: Maximum: The Apple, Perfected
maximum.text: the true apple at your cursor (120 ft): every foe within 30 ft takes 6d8, is spite-bound, and turns on the others for a while · your Spite fills

passives.name: Petty Spite
passives.text: Once a round, 2 Spite makes a blow on you go wrong.

passives.name: Goddess of Chaos
passives.text: Nothing confuses you, and you never start a fight without Spite.

techniques.name: Golden Slumber
techniques.summary: Golden dreamsand that whips, guards and soothes — and puts every nightmare on the field to sleep.

arts.name: Dreamsand Whip
arts.text: a whip of golden sand at your cursor (30 ft): 2d6 to everything along it · the sand lights the dark around you for a minute

arts.name: Good Dreams
arts.text: a good dream wraps you: a golden ward of 1d8 + CE mod (2d8 from 11th), and fear and confusion lift

arts.name: Dreamcraft
arts.text: a manta of golden sand glides beside you for a minute and lashes your foes

quick.name: Lullaby Sand
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft) falls into a deep sleep for a minute — any blow wakes it (a steady mind resists; a great foe only drowses)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Golden Dawn
maximum.text: golden sand rises like sunrise: every foe within 60 ft falls asleep for a minute (a steady mind drowses instead), and you're warded

techniques.name: Inner Peace
techniques.summary: There is no secret ingredient: a pool of Stillness that turns blows aside, chi that blasts in a cone, and the legendary Wuxi Finger Hold.

arts.name: Skadoosh
arts.text: 1 Stillness: a chi shockwave down a 15-ft cone — 2d8 + CE mod, and foes are thrown 10 ft (a nimble foe takes half and keeps its feet)

quick.name: Dumpling-Fueled Recovery
quick.text: 1 Stillness: regain 1d8 + CE mod + your level, and shake off poison

maximum.name: Maximum: Wuxi Finger Hold
maximum.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): the pinky hold — 8d10 and stunned for a round (a hardy foe takes half; a great foe is only staggered)

passives.name: Inner Peace
passives.text: Stillness (2×PB; 3×PB from 18th) refills one every few seconds out of a fight. A blow on you spends one and lands a fifth softer.

passives.name: Panda Style
passives.text: Your weapon blows land 1d8 harder (once a second), and blunt blows on you land a little softer.

passives.name: The Scroll Is Blank
passives.text: Nothing frightens you.

techniques.name: Jade Slayer
techniques.summary: Rip the chi out of every foe you strike, forge it into jade amulets, and send the masters you've taken back at the world as jade warriors.

arts.name: Summon Jombie
arts.text: 4 Stolen Chi: a jade warrior steps out of an amulet beside you for a minute (up to your PB)

quick.name: Spirit Realm Chains
quick.text: bladed chains lash up to three foes within 60 ft: 2d6, a free chi rip on each, and they're dragged toward you

maximum.name: Maximum: The Oogway Theft
maximum.text: up to three foes within 60 ft have their chi torn out whole: 6d10 each, stunned for a round (a strong spirit takes half and stands), and your Stolen Chi fills

passives.name: Chi Rip
passives.text: Your weapon blows rip chi (2 CE, once a second): 1d8 more, and 2 Stolen Chi banked (3 from 11th).

passives.name: Jade Tomb
passives.text: A foe you kill fills an amulet: 3 Stolen Chi.

domain.name: The Jade Court — Every Master Kneels
domain.sureHit: jade creeps over every chosen foe: 3d10, held fast for a moment, and its chi flows to you

techniques.name: King of New York
techniques.summary: The star of the show and the lion underneath: spend the Spotlight on every blow, roar the house down, and let the predator take the stage.

arts.name: Showstopper
arts.text: 1 Spotlight: every foe within 15 ft is dazzled by the act for a round (a steady mind isn't)

arts.name: The Triumphant Roar
arts.text: a 30-ft cone: 3d8 thunder, and foes are shaken for a minute — they hit softer (a steady mind takes the damage only)

quick.name: Give In to the Hunger
quick.text: a minute of Predator: Spotlight adds 2d6 a blow instead of 1d6, and you're faster

maximum.name: Maximum: The Wild Takes the Stage
maximum.text: every foe within 30 ft: 8d10, and shaken (a steady mind takes half) · your Spotlight refills

passives.name: Center Stage
passives.text: Spotlight (2×PB; 3×PB from 18th): each hit you land adds one, and it refills between fights. A weapon blow spends one for 1d6 more (once a second).

techniques.name: Nerve Strike
techniques.summary: Twenty years denied, now unstoppable: claws that lock the nerves, a leopard's blitz, and fury fed by every refusal.

arts.name: Nerve Strike
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2d6, and its nerves lock — stunned for a moment (a hardy foe shrugs it off; a great foe only staggers) · spends all your Fury for 1d6 more each

quick.name: Leopard Blitz
quick.text: a 30-ft pounce along your aim — your next Nerve Strike lands surer

maximum.name: Maximum: Seven-Point Shutdown
maximum.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 6d10, and it's paralyzed for 3 rounds (a hardy foe for one; a great foe is badly slowed)

passives.name: Leopard Blitz
passives.text: You run faster.

passives.name: Scroll-Denied Fury
passives.text: A foe shrugging off your strike builds Fury (up to your PB).

passives.name: Nerve Cascade
passives.text: When a Nerve Strike locks a foe, the next foe beside it is struck too.

passives.name: "You Don't Know"
passives.text: Once a day, a blow that would fell you leaves you at 1 life and full of Fury.

techniques.name: Night Fury
techniques.summary: The unholy offspring of lightning and death itself: plasma blasts from the dark, echolocation, and a storm worn like armor.

arts.name: Plasma Blast
arts.text: a concussive blast at your cursor (120 ft): 2d10 and knocked back · hold to charge an explosive blast (3 CE): 4d10 to everything within 10 ft of where it lands

arts.name: Stormcall
arts.text: while riding the lightning or under a storm: a bolt from the sky at your cursor (120 ft) — 5d10 to everything within 20 ft (a nimble foe takes half)

quick.name: Lightning-Rider
quick.text: a minute wreathed in lightning: you fly, your blasts deal 1d8 more, and whoever strikes you in melee takes 2d8 · the first each long rest is free

maximum.name: Maximum: Lightning's Heir
maximum.text: a minute as the storm's heir: you ride the lightning, blasts deal 2d8 more and explode wider, Stormcall is free — and once, the Plasma Blast is a full thunderhead (10d10)

passives.name: Echolocation
passives.text: You sense every creature around you and see through the dark.

passives.name: He Who Drinks the Sky
passives.text: Lightning heals you instead of hurting you.

techniques.name: Nightmare King
techniques.summary: Black sand that learned patience instead of gentleness: plant fear, feed on it, and loose nightmares shaped like horses.

arts.name: Nightmare Touch
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 2d8, and it's frightened for a minute — it hits you softer (a steady mind resists)

arts.name: Nightmare Steeds
arts.text: a horse of black sand with ember eyes gallops out for a minute and tramples your foes (up to 2)

quick.name: Fear Sand
quick.text: a scythe of black sand sweeps toward your cursor (30 ft): 2d6 to all it passes, more to the frightened

maximum.name: Maximum: Eternal Nightmare
maximum.text: every foe within 60 ft: 6d8 and frightened for a minute (a steady mind takes half and isn't)

passives.name: Feed on Fear
passives.text: Hurting a frightened foe heals you for half of it (once a round), and your sand bites them harder.

passives.name: One with the Dark
passives.text: In darkness, foes have a hard time keeping track of you.

passives.name: The Fear Grows Teeth
passives.text: Frightened foes take 2d8 more from your arts.

domain.name: The Long Dark: Every Dream Ends Here
domain.sureHit: every shadow stands up wearing a face: each chosen foe takes 4d8 and is frightened

techniques.name: Nine Lives
techniques.summary: A ledger of nine lives, a riposte that punishes every miss, and the courage to burn three lives for one perfect cut.

arts.name: The Legend's Blade
arts.text: a rapier thrust at the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 1d8 + CE mod — twice that right after a blow on you was turned aside

arts.name: The Duelist's Challenge
arts.text: challenge the foe at your cursor to single combat for a minute: your blows on it land a third harder and its blows on you a third softer

quick.name: Fear Me, If You Dare
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft) is frightened of you for a minute — it hits you softer (a steady mind resists)

maximum.name: Maximum: Nine Lives, One Cut
maximum.text: burn up to three lives (leaving at least one): a cut for each on the foe at your cursor — 1d8 + 3d8 each, and 4d8 more if all three land

passives.name: Nine Lives
passives.text: A blow that would fell you burns a life: you're back at a quarter of your life. One life returns each long rest.

passives.name: Softpaws
passives.text: You land on your feet and climb walls.

passives.name: Lives Behind Him
passives.text: Burning a life makes you much tougher for a round.

passives.name: Death Keeps His Word
passives.text: Once a day a burned life is spared, and with 3 or fewer lives left your blows land harder.

techniques.name: No Brain, No Pain
techniques.summary: A blob with no brain to break and no organs to find: shrug off everything, swallow whoever gets close, and become the disaster movie.

arts.name: Squelch
arts.text: a gooey slam on the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 1d8 + CE mod, and it's slowed for a round

arts.name: Snack Time
arts.text: eat something lying near you (any dropped item within 5 tiles): regain 2d8 + your level · PB times per long rest

quick.name: Engulf
quick.text: swallow the foe at your cursor (10 ft): it's held inside you for up to three rounds, taking 2d6 each round (a strong foe squirms free sooner; a great foe can't be swallowed)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Blob
maximum.text: for a minute you're huge: every foe within 15 ft takes 2d6 every round and is slowed, and blows land on you even softer

passives.name: No Brain to Break
passives.text: Nothing frightens or confuses you.

passives.name: No Vital Organs
passives.text: There's nothing for a blade to find: every blow on you lands a tenth softer.

passives.name: Indestructible
passives.text: Every blow on you is blunted by CE mod + PB.

techniques.name: Presentation
techniques.summary: Presentation is everything: holographic doubles that eat the blows, a dehydration gun that does exactly what it says, and a speech nobody escapes.

arts.name: Dehydration Gun
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft) is dehydrated for a minute: it hits much softer and is slowed (a hardy foe for a round; a great foe only hits softer)

arts.name: The Speech
arts.text: every foe within 60 ft stops to listen: held for a round and hitting softer for a minute (a steady mind only hits softer)

quick.name: Presentation!
quick.text: three holographic doubles flicker around you for a minute (five from 18th): a blow aimed at you may land on one instead, popping it

maximum.name: Maximum: The Grand Presentation
maximum.text: every foe within 120 ft: 8d8 and frozen in awe for a round (a steady mind takes half) · your doubles return in full

passives.name: Misdirection
passives.text: Once a round (1 CE), a blow aimed at you is thrown onto a double for sure.

techniques.name: The List
techniques.summary: Two curved swords, a door in every tattoo, and the List — those written naughty find the Guardian's blows land harder.

arts.name: Dual Curved Swords
arts.text: two cuts at the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 1d8 + CE mod each

arts.name: Portal Tattoos
arts.text: step through a tattoo door to your cursor (60 ft)

arts.name: The Reading of the List
arts.text: every foe within 60 ft is written Naughty · once per long rest

quick.name: The List
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (120 ft) goes on the Naughty List for a minute: your blows on it land a fifth harder (from 11th, once a round, they also stagger it)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Final Judgment
maximum.text: the verdict on the whole field: every foe within 60 ft takes 6d8 and is written Naughty, and you shake off every ailment

passives.name: Center of Wonder
passives.text: Nothing frightens or confuses you.

techniques.name: Warrior of Spring
techniques.summary: Tunnels under every battlefield, boomerangs that always come home, and painted war-eggs that don't hatch anything nice.

arts.name: Twin Boomerangs
arts.text: two boomerangs at your cursor (80 ft): 1d8 + CE mod each, cutting through everything — and they come back

arts.name: Egg Arming
arts.text: switch whether your next war-egg is a sentry (spits 1d8 yolk at a foe within 40 ft each round) or a bomb (bursts for 3d8 in 10 ft when a foe comes near; 5d8 from 15th)

quick.name: The Warren Below
quick.text: dive underground for a moment (untouchable) and burst out at your cursor (30 ft; 60 from 11th): 1d8 to whatever stands there, thrown upward

maximum.name: Maximum: The Great Eruption
maximum.text: you dive and erupt under up to six foes within 120 ft in turn: 4d8 to everything within 10 ft of each, thrown upward

passives.name: War-Eggs
passives.text: Technique Key 1 plants a war-egg at your cursor (3 CE, 30 ft; up to your PB) that lasts five minutes.

passives.name: The Burrow Remembers
passives.text: Once a day, a blow that would fell you dives you to safety at 1 life.

techniques.name: EMETH, the Truth
techniques.summary: Clay given the word: it grows as the fight goes on, swallows blows into itself, and when it finally speaks, nothing false stands before it.

arts.name: Clay Fists
arts.text: a slam on the foe at your cursor (10 ft, longer as you grow): 2d8 + CE mod, +1d8 per growth step · from 6th it knocks the foe down and back (a strong foe holds)

arts.name: Shem of Mending
arts.text: the clay knits closed: regain 4d8 + CE mod · twice per long rest

quick.name: Unstoppable Guardian
quick.text: for a minute nothing moves you, and you trample the foes you walk through (your slam's damage, once a round each)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Golem Speaks
maximum.text: for a minute the clay embodies Truth: you see everything hidden, your slams deal double dice, and foes near you can't hide behind lies — they hit softer · once per long rest

passives.name: The Word on the Brow
passives.text: Nothing charms, frightens, confuses or puts you to sleep.

passives.name: Growing Truth
passives.text: Each round you stay in a fight you grow (up to two steps): +1d8 to your slam, more life, longer reach. It settles back between fights.

passives.name: Swallow the Blow
passives.text: Once a round (1 CE) a blow is swallowed into the clay: halved.

techniques.name: Epic Kingship
techniques.summary: The warrior-king of the Tibetan epic: name the demon, muster the thirty riders of Ling, and endure like the mountain endures the storm.

arts.name: The Thirty Ride
arts.text: two spectral warriors of Ling muster at your side for a minute

arts.name: Demon-Slayer's Grip
arts.text: seize the foe beside you (10 ft): held fast for a round — a Named foe for two (a strong foe slips free)

quick.name: The Naming
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) is Named for a minute: your blows crit it far more often, and it's slowed by your name

maximum.name: Maximum: Lutzen Falls Again
maximum.text: cross up to 60 ft in a single bound to the foe at your cursor: 10d10 — and a Named foe is stunned for a moment · once per long rest

passives.name: Deed Numbered
passives.text: Each foe you fell mends you for CE mod + PB.

passives.name: The Mountain Endures
passives.text: Every blow on you is blunted by PB, and you can't be knocked around.

passives.name: The Straw King
passives.text: PB times a day, a blow that would land finds a straw man instead.

domain.name: Ling Assembled: The Epic Sung Aloud
domain.sureHit: all are Named: every chosen foe is Named, and the host of Ling cuts it (3d8)

techniques.name: Hu-Hu-Hu
techniques.summary: The giantess of the deep woods: she can't be aimed, she won't stop regenerating, and whatever she grabs goes into the basket.

arts.name: Swipe
arts.text: a huge hand swipes the nearest foe (15 ft): 2d8 + CE mod

arts.name: She Eats the Vanguard
arts.text: a bite on the nearest foe (15 ft): 6d12 + CE mod — if it dies, it's devoured and you regain half the damage

arts.name: Into the Basket
arts.text: whoever you're holding goes into the basket: devoured — 8d10, and if that doesn't end it, it's held there for three rounds (a strong foe breaks free)

arts.name: The Basket Is Never Full
arts.text: you shake the basket: every foe within 60 ft is frightened for a minute (more so for each one devoured)

quick.name: The Woods Close
quick.text: for a minute the ground within 30 ft of you is deadfall: foes in it are slowed

maximum.name: Maximum: Winter's Mother
maximum.text: for a minute you are famine itself: nothing moves you, your regeneration doubles, and every foe within 60 ft starves (3d6 a round, slowed) · once per long rest

passives.name: The Cry
passives.text: Your arts always take the nearest foe.

passives.name: The Forest Outlasts
passives.text: You regenerate steadily — not in the round after fire. The first heavy blow each round is dulled.

passives.name: Snatch
passives.text: Once a round (3 CE), a foe that strikes you within 15 ft is grabbed and held.

domain.name: Hu-Hu-Hu — The Basket of the Wild Woman
domain.sureHit: everywhere, hu-hu-hu: every chosen foe is snatched toward you, slowed, and takes 4d6

techniques.name: Hundred Seals Physique
techniques.summary: The peerless rikishi moves his strength around his body like weights on a scale: all arms, all legs, or all frame — never more than he has.

arts.name: Harite
arts.text: an open-palm slap on the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 1d8 + Arms · with Arms 5+ it stuns for a moment (a hardy foe shrugs)

arts.name: Hundred Seals Release
arts.text: for a minute a region holds up to 8 Bands

quick.name: Sabaori
quick.text: crush the foe beside you (10 ft): 2d8 + Arms, knocked down · with Arms 7+ and Frame 3+ it's pinned for a round (a strong foe holds)

maximum.name: Maximum: Yatagarasu
maximum.text: every Band in your Legs rushes into your Arms as you charge the foe at your cursor (40 ft): 6d10 + 3 per Band in your Arms, thrown far

passives.name: The Muscle Map
passives.text: Twelve Bands: each in Arms adds to your blows, each in Legs to your speed and jump, each in Frame to your toughness. Technique Key 1 migrates PB Bands; Key 2 evens them out.

passives.name: Full Muscle Control
passives.text: A region holds 6. Using a region past 5 strains you a little afterward.

techniques.name: Malicious Blessing
techniques.summary: Gentleman's gloves that bless any object into a murder weapon: thrown, left waiting, or turned loose as the whole street.

arts.name: Malicious Blessing
arts.text: throw a blessed object at your cursor (60 ft): a Murder Die + CE mod · from 3rd it ricochets to a second foe on a hit

arts.name: Grand Blessing
arts.text: bless the ground at your cursor (60 ft): everything within 20 ft turns on the foes there — 4 Murder Dice + CE mod (a nimble foe half)

quick.name: Prepared Murder
quick.text: a blessed trap at your cursor (60 ft) springs on the first foe within 10 ft: 2 Murder Dice + CE mod (up to PB traps; they last ten minutes)

maximum.name: Maximum: Dear God
maximum.text: for a minute everything you throw or strike with carries every Murder: your blows bleed foes and land 2 Murder Dice harder, and your thrown blessings pierce

passives.name: London Bridge
passives.text: Once a round, a blow on you finds you a step away — you slip 5 ft clear and it lands softer.

techniques.name: Mandate of the First Emperor
techniques.summary: The First Emperor reads the Crux Stars where power converges, breaks its flow, takes tribute from every failed blow — and raises the terracotta legions.

arts.name: Drifting Tortoise
arts.text: a Crux strike at the foe at your cursor (60 ft): it's Flow-Broken for a minute — it hits softer, and your blows land a fifth harder

arts.name: White Tiger Crescent Moon
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2 Imperial Dice + CE mod, and it's thrown 15 ft (a strong foe holds)

arts.name: Swallow Slash
arts.text: a cut on the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 3 Imperial Dice, plus one per Tribute you spend (up to 3)

arts.name: Terracotta Legions
arts.text: your PB terracotta soldiers rise and fight for a minute

quick.name: Mount Tai Dragon Claw
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 2 Imperial Dice + CE mod · 1 Tribute also slows it

maximum.name: Maximum: King of All Beginnings
maximum.text: needs full Tribute: every foe within 60 ft is Flow-Broken, Heavenly Phoenix is free for a minute, and your Tribute refills

passives.name: Heavenly Phoenix
passives.text: Once a round (2 CE), a blow on you loses 2 Imperial Dice + CE mod (3 dice from a Flow-Broken attacker); a big save earns Tribute.

passives.name: Tribute
passives.text: Up to PB (PB + CE mod from 18th): earned by Phoenix saves and by Flow-Broken foes failing against you.

domain.name: All Under Heaven — Throne of the First Emperor
domain.sureHit: the Imperial Meridian Flow-Breaks every chosen foe and takes tribute: 3 Imperial Dice each, and a Tribute

techniques.name: Nine Shadows of the Court
techniques.summary: The nine-tailed fox of the Heian court: foxfire that burns the idea of you, shadows that take your place, and a smile that turns kingdoms.

arts.name: Foxfire
arts.text: foxfire at your cursor (120 ft): 2d10 fire + 1d6 (double dice under the Ninth Tail)

arts.name: The Court Wants
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) sees what it most desires: it fights for you for a minute (a steady mind resists; a great foe only hits softer)

arts.name: Sesshō-seki's Breath
arts.text: the Killing Stone's vapor down a 30-ft cone: 6d8 poison and poisoned for a minute (a hardy foe takes half)

arts.name: The Smile That Ruins Kingdoms
arts.text: every foe within 60 ft that sees you may be turned to your side for a minute

quick.name: Nine Shadows
quick.text: a fox shadow of your court fights beside you for a minute, throwing its own foxfire (up to nine; 1 CE under the Ninth Tail)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Ninth Tail
maximum.text: for a minute all nine tails show: foxfire deals double dice, shadows cost 1 CE, and every foe near you hits softer

passives.name: Never Where You Think
passives.text: Once a round (2 CE), a blow meant for you lands on one of your Shadows — you swap places.

passives.name: Tails as Lives
passives.text: Once a day, a blow that would fell you severs a tail instead: your shadows vanish, you're back at half life, and you vanish in foxfire.

domain.name: The Gilded Cage of Nine Tails
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe sees its most trusted beloved: it's charmed to your side for a moment and burns in foxfire (3d10)

techniques.name: No Way as Way
techniques.summary: Be water: intercept every blow and complete it into your own fist, then compress the whole art into one inch.

arts.name: Straight Lead
arts.text: a straight lead at the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 1d8 + CE mod, faster than it can answer

arts.name: Dragon's Answer
arts.text: for a minute, shots reaching you are caught out of the air (two a round)

arts.name: The Dojo Floor
arts.text: for a minute every blow on you is intercepted, without cost

quick.name: One-Inch Punch
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (5 ft): 6d8, and it's thrown far back (a heavy foe only staggers)

passives.name: The Intercepting Fist
passives.text: Once a round (1 CE) a blow on you is intercepted: it lands 1d10 + CE mod + PB softer (2d10 from 6th, 3d10 from 11th), and the attacker eats a counter.

passives.name: Be Water
passives.text: You move faster and can't be knocked around.

techniques.name: Scourge of God
techniques.summary: The great charge of the steppe: trample through the line, curse the ground behind you, and ride the horde's momentum.

arts.name: Charge
arts.text: charge 30 ft along your aim, trampling every foe you pass: 2d6 and knocked down (a strong foe takes half and stands) · 2d8 more with the Horde

arts.name: Break the Walls
arts.text: the shock charge: 45 ft along your aim, 4d6 to every foe you pass, and they're thrown 10 ft off your path (a nimble foe takes half)

arts.name: The Horde Answers
arts.text: a minute of the horde's momentum: you're faster, your blows land harder, and your charges trample 2d8 deeper

quick.name: Scourge's Wake
quick.text: 15 ft around you becomes cursed ground for a minute: foes wade through it, slowed

maximum.name: Maximum: Flagellum Dei
maximum.text: the great charge: 60 ft, 8d6 to every foe within 10 ft of your path, knocked down — and the ground behind you is cursed

techniques.name: Super Automaton β
techniques.summary: Movement as current: straight-line Vectors that hit harder the longer they run, right-angle Tesla Steps, coils to warp between — and a Zone where every experiment makes you faster.

arts.name: Vector-Locked Armor
arts.text: ten minutes in the armor: tougher, unshakeable, and every Vector is free

quick.name: Vector
quick.text: shoot in a straight line toward your cursor (30 ft, +10 per Acceleration Stage), ramming what you pass: Push at 10 ft (1d6 + CE mod), Jolt at 20 (2d8, staggers), Break at 30 (3d10, thrown back), Maximum Velocity at 50 (6d10, stunned) · free in the armor · a right-angle Vector within half a second keeps the length counting

passives.name: Broken Equation
passives.text: Slam into a wall before a Vector reaches 10 ft and you stall for a moment (and lose a Stage inside your Zone).

passives.name: Ground Fault
passives.text: PB times a day, a broken Equation discharges: 2d8 lightning to everything within 10 ft (a nimble foe half).

passives.name: Tesla Step
passives.text: A Vector fired at a right angle within half a second of the last continues it (one turn; more with each Stage).

passives.name: Super Tesla Coils
passives.text: Three coils a day: Technique Key 1 plants one where you stand; Technique Key 2 (4 CE) warps you to the newest — the warp is a Vector, ramming everything on the line.

passives.name: Acceleration Stage V
passives.text: Stages climb to V, and you may turn PB times in one chain.

domain.name: Gematria Zone — Prison of the Gods
domain.sureHit: the Protocol speaks: each pulse poses an Experiment (a long wire to a far terminal, a true right-angle bend, a hammer blow at the end of a Vector, a closed loop) · pass it and your Acceleration Stage rises (+10 ft to every Vector, more turns); break an Equation inside and you lose one

techniques.name: Tenka Fubu
techniques.summary: The Demon King of the Sixth Heaven: claim the ground, fire the rotating volleys, and burn the mountain when they shelter on it.

arts.name: Nagashino's Thunder
arts.text: a matchlock volley at your cursor (120 ft): 2d8 · from 3rd, three rotating shots (3 CE)

arts.name: The Burning of Mount Hiei
arts.text: every foe in your claimed ground: 3d8 fire (a nimble foe takes half) · if none stands on it, the ground at your cursor is claimed and burned

quick.name: Claimed Ground
quick.text: claim 15 ft at your cursor (60 ft) for a minute (20 ft from 6th, 30 from 18th; up to PB claims): standing in it, your weapon blows land PB harder (twice that from 6th)

maximum.name: Maximum: Honnō-ji — The Temple Burns Again
maximum.text: every claim erupts: 8d8 fire to every foe inside (a nimble foe takes half), and your claims last another minute

passives.name: The Demon King's Banner
passives.text: Foes in your ground can't hide from you.

passives.name: Demon King Ascendant
passives.text: In your ground fire can't touch you and you crit more.

passives.name: The Realm Is Mine
passives.text: Your ground burns and drags at foes who stand in it.

domain.name: Tenka Fubu: The Realm Under Heaven
domain.sureHit: there is no land beyond: every chosen foe burns for 4d8 and is dragged back toward the castle

techniques.name: The Bronze Head
techniques.summary: The one-eyed Kandake of Kush: every victory is a transfer, and she fights with what she has taken.

arts.name: Kandake's Spear
arts.text: a spear thrust at the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 1d8 + CE mod + your Trophies

arts.name: The Threshold
arts.text: for a minute a Trophy lies beneath your feet: nothing moves you, nothing frightens you, and foes within 15 ft hit softer

quick.name: Wear the Taken
quick.text: for a minute you wear a Trophy's aspect: faster, steadier and tougher (needs a Trophy)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Head Under the Throne
maximum.text: spend every Trophy (at least 3) on one blow at the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 2d10 per Trophy

passives.name: Claim the Fallen
passives.text: Every foe you fell leaves a Trophy (up to 6; a long rest clears them). Your weapon blows land 1 harder per Trophy.

passives.name: Tithe of the Dying
passives.text: Any foe that falls within 60 ft of you leaves a Trophy.

domain.name: Meroë: The Palace of Taken Things
domain.sureHit: everything breaks into her hands: every chosen foe is disarmed (hits much softer for a moment) and takes 3d8

techniques.name: The Burning Lyre
techniques.summary: The emperor plays while the city burns: a dirge that sets the audience alight and an anthem that wards the player.

arts.name: The Audience Gathers
arts.text: a minute of performance: each round the Dirge burns every foe within 60 ft (1d6 fire) and the Anthem wards you (1d6)

arts.name: Encore of Embers
arts.text: up to three foes nearest your cursor (60 ft): 5d6 fire, and they keep burning (a nimble foe takes half and doesn't catch)

arts.name: Symphony of Ash
arts.text: for a round the audience is everything within 120 ft, the Dirge burns 3d6, and those it burns are frightened · once per long rest

quick.name: Crescendo
quick.text: for a round the Dirge burns 2d6 and the Anthem wards 2d6 · you hear every foe in the audience

maximum.name: Maximum: The Eternal City Aflame
maximum.text: for a minute burning Rome moves with you: foes within 120 ft take 4d6 fire each round (a nimble foe half), and the flames part for you

techniques.name: The Chivalric Siege
techniques.summary: The Code is declared and Heaven enforces it: strike the shielded and the field punishes you — and the walls always hold.

arts.name: The Siege Laws
arts.text: for a minute, the Law holds within 30 ft of you (60 from 18th): foes inside are slowed and hit softer

arts.name: Richard's Horses
arts.text: regain 2d8 + CE mod — so that the battle can continue properly

quick.name: The Code Spoken
quick.text: for a round you're Shielded: blows on you land a quarter softer (from 18th, the first is halved)

maximum.name: Maximum: Hattin — The Horns Encircled
maximum.text: every foe within 30 ft: 4d10, held fast for a round and hitting softer for a minute (a steady mind takes the damage only)

passives.name: Fearless
passives.text: Nothing frightens you.

passives.name: Retribution of the Code
passives.text: Once a round, a foe that strikes you while Shielded takes PB + CE mod.

passives.name: The Walls of Jerusalem
passives.text: Once a round (4 CE), the heaviest kind of blow is halved — any blow worth a fifth of your life.

passives.name: One Enemy, One Honor
passives.text: The Code's punishment is also a cut (1d8 + CE mod).

techniques.name: The Crimson Bath
techniques.summary: Years flow toward the Countess: every blow sips life, every death fills the bath, and the last bath drinks the whole room.

arts.name: The Bath Overflows
arts.text: every living foe within 15 ft: 3d6 as its years flow to you (a hardy foe half), and you regain half of it all

quick.name: Drink Deep
quick.text: your next blow on a living foe also wards you for the damage it deals

maximum.name: Maximum: The Last Bath
maximum.text: every living foe within 30 ft: 8d6 (a hardy foe half), and you regain all of it

passives.name: First Sip
passives.text: A weapon blow on a living foe sips (once a second): you mend 1 + a Year per Year Drunk. Each foe you fell adds a Year (up to PB).

passives.name: The Countess's Due
passives.text: Once a round (5 CE), a living foe dying within 30 ft wards you for 2d8 + CE mod and adds a Year.

techniques.name: The Dread I Cast Off
techniques.summary: The prince sets his own legend down as a shadow of dread: those inside it fear, those he strikes are pinned — and at the last, the legend flies on its own.

arts.name: Cast Off Dread
arts.text: for a minute your Dread Shadow stands at your cursor (30 ft): foes inside are Dreaded — they hit softer and are slowed

quick.name: Move the Terror
quick.text: the Dread Shadow slides to your cursor (40 ft from you)

maximum.name: Maximum: Dracula Unbound
maximum.text: for a minute the Shadow is the autonomous curse: it hunts the nearest foe on its own, you fly through mist, and your blows drain 2×PB that heals you

passives.name: Impaler's Lesson
passives.text: Once a round (2 CE), a weapon blow on a Dreaded foe pins it in place for a round (a strong foe holds).

passives.name: Separate the Name
passives.text: Once a round (2 CE), a blow meant for you lands softer — the Shadow takes its share.

techniques.name: The Fish-Hook
techniques.summary: The hook that pulled up islands and slowed the sun: snare foes, reel yourself across the field, and haul the whole battle onto the line.

arts.name: Manaiakalani
arts.text: the hook bites the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 1d8 + CE mod, and it's reeled 15 ft toward you (a strong foe only staggers)

arts.name: Slow the Sun
arts.text: hook the foe at your cursor's time (60 ft): it's badly slowed for a minute (a strong foe for a round)

arts.name: Fish Up an Island
arts.text: haul the foe at your cursor (60 ft) 30 ft toward you, cover or no cover

arts.name: The Sun, Snared
arts.text: for a minute 30 ft at your cursor is snared: foes inside can barely move · once per long rest

quick.name: The Snare Remembers
quick.text: set a hook at your cursor (60 ft) for an hour (up to 3) · Technique Key 1 yanks you to the newest one

maximum.name: Maximum: The Island Comes Up
maximum.text: the full haul: every foe within 20 ft of your cursor (60 ft) takes 6d10 and is dragged 20 ft toward you (a strong foe takes half and holds)

passives.name: Through the Goddess
passives.text: Once a day, a blow that would fell you leaves you at 1 life and slips you 30 ft away.

domain.name: Te Ika-a-Māui: The Fish of Māui
domain.sureHit: everything is on the line: every chosen foe is hooked (2d10) and hauled 15 ft toward you

techniques.name: The Gilded Man
techniques.summary: What he gilds becomes valuable, what is valuable can be priced, and what is priced obeys: gold dust that weighs foes down until they can't move.

arts.name: Dust of Guatavita
arts.text: gold dust at your cursor (60 ft): 1d8 + CE mod to foes within 10 ft, and they're Gilded for a minute — your blows on them land 1d6 heavier, and the gold slows them

arts.name: The City
arts.text: for a minute gold leaf covers 30 ft around you: foes in it are Gilded and slowed

quick.name: The Raft
quick.text: ride the market's current to the Gilded foe nearest your cursor (60 ft) — or to any foe there

maximum.name: Maximum: The Lake Returns
maximum.text: gold-dust water floods 40 ft at your cursor (90 ft): 8d8 to every foe inside (a strong will takes half), and they're Gilded at stage III

passives.name: The Highest Bidder
passives.text: Once a second, hitting a Gilded foe deepens it: stage II hits softer, stage III is pinned for a moment.

passives.name: Gild the Wound
passives.text: You always see the Gilded.

domain.name: Guatavita: The Raft at the Center
domain.sureHit: everything shines: every chosen foe is Gilded a stage deeper and takes 3d8

techniques.name: The Hut Turns
techniques.summary: The witch of the deep forest: a fence of bones, a flying mortar, grasping roots — and the hut on chicken legs that comes when called.

arts.name: The Fence of Bones
arts.text: a fence of bone stakes rises at your cursor for a minute — a wall foes must go around

arts.name: Root Grasp
arts.text: roots seize every foe within 15 ft of your cursor (60 ft): 2d6 and held for a round (a strong foe takes the damage only)

arts.name: The Hut Turns
arts.text: the hut on chicken legs stalks your foes for a minute, trampling them (3d6)

arts.name: Eat the Path
arts.text: 60 ft at your cursor turns to hungry forest for a minute: foes inside are slowed, lose sight now and then, and hit softer

quick.name: The Mortar Flies
quick.text: climb into the mortar and fly for two rounds

maximum.name: Maximum: The Wild Takes Back
maximum.text: for a minute 120 ft around you is old-growth forest: foes inside take 4d6 a round from lashing branches (a nimble foe half) and may be held, and you mend for it

domain.name: The Hut Walks at Night
domain.sureHit: the hut walks: every chosen foe is trampled for 4d6 and seized by roots

techniques.name: The Library Burns
techniques.summary: The last librarian of Alexandria: annotate the foe, refute its premises, and hurl the burning catalogue at it.

arts.name: Burning Scroll
arts.text: a scroll that combusts mid-flight at your cursor (120 ft): 4d8 fire, and its armor cracks for a round

arts.name: Theorem of Falling Bodies
arts.text: a 20-ft cube at your cursor (120 ft): 5d8, and foes inside are pinned by the proof for a round (a strong foe takes half and stands)

arts.name: Scrollstorm
arts.text: 40 ft at your cursor fills with burning vellum: 8d6 (a nimble foe half), and the ground is hot ash for a minute

arts.name: Disputation
arts.text: every foe within 60 ft is refuted for a minute: it hits softer and is annotated (a sharp mind resists)

quick.name: Marginalia
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (120 ft) is annotated for a minute: your arts land a fifth harder on it and slip past its armor

maximum.name: Maximum: The Burning of the Library
maximum.text: for a minute you are the Library: ashen wings, fire can't touch you, blows land softer, and every round a burning scroll flies at the nearest foe

domain.name: The Alexandria That Burned
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is perfectly catalogued: annotated, and a burning page strikes it (4d8)

techniques.name: The River Keeps
techniques.summary: The weeping woman's water: a wail that draws the grieving in, black water that slows them, and a sorrow they drown in.

arts.name: The Weeping
arts.text: every foe within 30 ft: 1d6 and shaken for a round (they hit softer) · her water floods 10 ft at your feet for a minute

arts.name: The Riverbed
arts.text: 20 ft at your cursor (60 ft) floods with her water for a minute

arts.name: Drown the Sorrow
arts.text: every foe standing in her water begins drowning in grief: 2d6 a round and slowed hard while it stays (a hardy foe resists) · if no one is in her water, it floods 20 ft at your cursor first

arts.name: The Drowning of Names
arts.text: every foe in her water sinks to its knees, weeping: helpless for a round, then hitting softer for a minute (a great foe only weakens)

quick.name: Come to the Water
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft) is dragged 15 ft toward you — its feet don't care that it doesn't want to (a steady mind resists)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Flood Remembers
maximum.text: for a minute 60 ft at your cursor (120 ft) floods deep and black: foes inside take 3d6 each round and are pulled 10 ft toward you (a steady mind resists)

techniques.name: The River That Walks
techniques.summary: The great serpent of the Amazon: own the crossings, drag what wades into the deep, and become the Cobra Grande itself.

arts.name: Coil and Strike
arts.text: a serpent's lunge at the foe at your cursor (20 ft): 2d8 + CE mod, and it's dragged toward you (6d8 as the Cobra Grande)

arts.name: The Flood Comes Up
arts.text: for a minute 60 ft at your cursor (90 ft) floods: it counts as water for everything you do, and foes in it are slowed

quick.name: The Drowned Rise
quick.text: up to three drowned shades rise under foes in water within 60 ft (or the three nearest, if none): 2d6 each, and they're dragged down

maximum.name: Maximum: The Cobra Grande
maximum.text: for a minute you are the great serpent: nothing holds or moves you, you swim through everything, blows land softer, and your strikes bite three times harder · once per long rest

passives.name: The Deep Place
passives.text: In water you swim freely and blows land a third softer.

passives.name: The River Decides
passives.text: Once a round, a foe within 20 ft of water you're in is pulled under: slowed and knocked down (a strong foe holds).

techniques.name: The Sisters' Rebellion
techniques.summary: Trung Trac and her sister's echo fight as one rebellion: every blow is answered by the other, and the war-elephants ride again.

arts.name: Sister's Blade
arts.text: a cut at the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 1d8 + CE mod (more if your sister just struck it)

arts.name: The Queen's Elephant
arts.text: war-elephants of cursed energy charge a 60-ft line along your aim: 4d8 and trampled flat (a strong foe takes half and stands)

arts.name: Sixty-Five Citadels
arts.text: for a minute you're both tougher, and every blow of yours is answered by hers · once per long rest

quick.name: The Second Blade
quick.text: your sister's echo fights beside you for a minute (1 CE for a minute after she falls)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Queen's Answer
maximum.text: you and your sister strike the foe at your cursor as one: two cuts and 8d8 more, and it's stunned for a moment · once per long rest

passives.name: The Answer
passives.text: Your blow on a foe sharpens your sister's next one on it, and hers sharpens yours (1d8).

passives.name: The Fallen Sister's Share
passives.text: If the echo falls, your blows land harder for a round and calling her back costs 1 CE for a minute.

techniques.name: The Step Pyramid
techniques.summary: Architecture raised from cursed energy, limestone-white and warm: walls, courts with laws, shafts that swallow — and the first pyramid.

arts.name: Foundation
arts.text: a limestone wall rises at your cursor (60 ft) for a minute

arts.name: The Shaft
arts.text: a shaft opens under the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 3d8, held in the pit for a round (a nimble foe takes half and keeps its footing)

arts.name: The Architect's Vow
arts.text: a court with a binding Law: whoever stands in it takes 2d8 each round and is slowed, for a minute

quick.name: The First Court
quick.text: walls rise on both sides of your cursor (60 ft) for a minute, and the Law of Stillness holds between them: foes inside are slowed

maximum.name: Maximum: The Seventh Stage
maximum.text: the whole step pyramid rises at your cursor: every foe on it is slowed and takes 3d8 a round for a minute, and its tiers wall them in · once per long rest

passives.name: The Teeth
passives.text: Foes inside your courts hit softer.

domain.name: Saqqara, the First Stone
domain.sureHit: the ground is his: shafts open under every chosen foe — 3d8, held in the pit

techniques.name: The Unwritten Trail
techniques.summary: The wanderer of a thousand tales: arrive from the unwatched angle, leave a decoy-tale where the blow lands, and flicker through every telling at once.

arts.name: Harpoon
arts.text: a harpoon thrown at your cursor (60 ft): 1d10 + CE mod

arts.name: Where the Story Needs Him
arts.text: you're beside the foe at your cursor, however far — and your next blow is a sure critical

quick.name: The Story Provides
quick.text: step 30 ft to your cursor from an unwatched angle: your next blow is a sure critical

maximum.name: Maximum: Everywhere in the Telling
maximum.text: for a minute you flicker between tellings: every round you blink near the nearest foe, blows land on you half the time, and each flicker is a sure critical

passives.name: The Tale Turns
passives.text: Once a round (3 CE), a blow on you lands on a decoy-tale for half, and you're 15 ft away.

passives.name: The Unmappable
passives.text: Foes lose track of you easily, and nothing slows you.

domain.name: The Trail With No End
domain.sureHit: no fixed point: every chosen foe loses its footing and its sense of you — 3d10, and lost for a moment

techniques.name: Two Heavens as One
techniques.summary: Two swords as one heaven: a stance that answers every blow with a cut, a rhythm read and followed, and a single stroke that ends the duel.

arts.name: Read the Rhythm
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) becomes your Duelist for a minute: your blows on it land 1d8 deeper · Technique Key 1 crosses to it (1 CE)

arts.name: The Duel Already Concluded
arts.text: a minute of a 15-ft circle of cut air around you: every foe that steps inside is cut (2d8, once a round each)

quick.name: Niten Stance
quick.text: a minute in the Two Heavens stance: your weapon blows land PB harder, and once a round a foe that strikes you is answered with a cut

maximum.name: Maximum: Iai — The Single Stroke
maximum.text: cross up to 30 ft to the foe at your cursor and draw: 8d10, a likely critical

passives.name: The Oar Suffices
passives.text: Your blows slip past armor.

passives.name: Ichi-go Ichi-e
passives.text: Felling a foe with a blow gives you a burst of speed.

passives.name: Two Heavens as One, Perfected
passives.text: In the stance your blows crit more often, and the Answering Cut deals 2d8 more.

domain.name: Ganryū Island: Where the Oar Fell
domain.sureHit: the cut cannot miss: every chosen foe is answered — 4d8 + PB

techniques.name: Two-Thirds Divine
techniques.summary: The king of Uruk wields the divine prototypes — the first axe, the first sword, the first spear — and endures as the god he two-thirds is.

arts.name: Prototype's Edge
arts.text: a divine prototype weapon flies at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8 + CE mod (more below half life from 6th; double under the Epic)

arts.name: The Epic Itself
arts.text: for a minute his legend is armor: once a round a blow loses 2d10 + CE mod, and your prototypes deal double dice

quick.name: The Bull of Heaven
quick.text: charge 40 ft along your aim through every foe in your path: 3d8 each, knocked down (a strong foe takes half and stands)

passives.name: Two-Thirds
passives.text: Once a round a blow on you loses PB + CE mod. Below half life your prototypes deal 1d8 more.

passives.name: The First King
passives.text: The first time each foe strikes you in a fight, a prototype answers it.

domain.name: Uruk, the First City
domain.sureHit: every prototype he has ever owned strikes at once: 4d8 + CE mod to every chosen foe

techniques.name: Vitruvian Proportion
techniques.summary: Every figure in its proper place: slide foes where the composition needs them, shape the ground, and project the perfected circle.

arts.name: Recompose
arts.text: up to PB foes near your cursor (60 ft) each slide 15 ft

arts.name: Terrain Study
arts.text: for a minute 20 ft at your cursor drags at foes: they're slowed inside

arts.name: The Ideal Form
arts.text: up to PB foes near your cursor slide 20 ft, and for a round they take a quarter more from you

arts.name: The Grand Composition
arts.text: every foe within 90 ft slides 30 ft

quick.name: The Golden Section
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) slides 10 ft (15 from 11th) — away from you, or toward you (a strong foe holds)

maximum.name: Maximum: Vitruvian Man — The Perfected Field
maximum.text: for a minute, every round every foe within 60 ft is drawn 10 ft toward your cursor and exposed (a quarter more from you)

passives.name: Anatomical Eye
passives.text: You see every creature near you.

passives.name: The Living Diagram
passives.text: A foe you slide is cut along the way (1d8).

techniques.name: White Death
techniques.summary: A rifle loaded with the shooter's own flesh: still, unseen, and paying in organs for the shots that cannot miss.

arts.name: Isänmaalle — Flesh Round
arts.text: a rifle shot at your cursor (300 ft) loaded with a little of your life: 2d10 + CE mod, half again if you haven't moved since your last shot · an organ round, if loaded, fires instead

quick.name: Sniper's Nest
quick.text: make a nest where you stand: while you're within 10 ft of it, foes lose track of you

maximum.name: Maximum: The 543rd Bullet
maximum.text: the heart round — your life drops to 1 until a long rest restores you: one shot at your cursor, 20d10, piercing everything in the line

passives.name: Organ Rounds
passives.text: Technique Key 1 loads Kidney (−10% max life: 6d6, pierces), Liver (−15%: a line through everything, 3d6 more on the first) or from 11th Pancreas (−20%: 8d6 more, ignores armor). A long rest restores the organs.

techniques.name: Antigravity System
techniques.summary: Antigravity, Gravity Field, Antigravity Shield, and Zero Gravity—gravity reversed and turned into control.

arts.name: Antigravity
arts.text: gravity reverses in a 10-ft column around you (not you) until the next round: foes in it fall upward — a nimble one grabs on — and slam back down when it ends (1d6 per 10 ft fallen; d8 from 3rd, d10 from 11th) · from 11th, hold to pour CE: +10 ft and +1 round per CE

maximum.name: Maximum: Zero Gravity
maximum.text: for a minute everything within 60 ft of you weighs nothing — foes drift helplessly — and when it ends, they all fall at once

passives.name: Light Fall
passives.text: Falling fast, you drift down gently instead (1 CE, once per round), and falls never hurt you.

passives.name: Antigravity Shield
passives.text: Once per round (2 CE), a blow is pushed away from you: CE mod + your level less, and the next one may miss.

feats.name: Levitation System
feats.text: One man's share of the sky: Antigravity also lifts the foe at your cursor (within 60 ft) for 2 CE more — it can't grab on.

feats.name: Antigravitational Flight
feats.text: Hold Jump to fly on reversed gravity: 1 CE for every 3 s you're aloft.

feats.name: Inverted Shield
feats.text: When your Shield catches a melee blow, it inverts for 3 CE: the attacker is pulled in and knocked down (a strength check).

feats.name: Dense Antigravity Shield
feats.text: The densest sky: when your Shield catches a blow and you can spare 3 CE more, the blow is halved as well.

domain.name: Inverted Heaven
domain.sureHit: chosen foes simply fall upward, and are dropped from the height: 6d6

techniques.name: Auspicious Beast Summon
techniques.summary: Four discrete beast gifts: a weapon, a burst of movement or defense, temporary endurance, and Ryu.

arts.name: Kaichi
arts.text: summon Kaichi, a yellow drill horn, until dismissed (cast again): once per round, a weapon hit that lands is followed by a horn thrust, 10 ft — 1d6 (1d8 at 3rd, 1d10 at 6th, 1d12 at 11th, 3d6 at 18th)

arts.name: Reiki
arts.text: dark water carries you: twice as fast until the next round · and on its own, once per round (2 CE), a blow that's about to land may be turned aside

arts.name: Kirin
arts.text: hold to pour 1 to PB CE: 5 temporary life per CE — but you can't move until the next round

arts.name: Ryu
arts.text: summon Ryu, the dragon, for an hour: it flies with you and fights · Technique Key 1 commands its lightning breath (once per round), 6d8 down a 60-ft line · if it falls, it's gone until a long rest

maximum.name: Maximum: Kirin's Flames
maximum.text: 1 minute: Kirin's endurance, inverted — every blow that reaches you returns fire, three times what it did

feats.name: Double Up
feats.text: Kaichi grows a second drill-horn: every horn thrust strikes twice.

feats.name: Zero Friction
feats.text: While Reiki carries you, Kaichi strikes with every weapon hit (not once a round), and each thrust throws the foe 10 ft back.

domain.name: Auspicious Beasts' Realm
domain.sureHit: a law, not an event — there is no pulse: inside, every beast answers for 2 CE less, and Kaichi strikes with every hit

techniques.name: Black Bird Manipulation
techniques.summary: A reconnaissance network with fear control and a costly, lethal Bird Strike.

arts.name: Bond a Crow
arts.text: another raven answers and is bound to you for good (up to PB + CE mod crows; at least 3)

arts.name: Omen of Death
arts.text: the crows gather where death is coming: every foe within 30 ft is frightened for a minute (a resolve check) — it fights at three-quarter heart

arts.name: Bird Strike
arts.text: one crow dives at the foe at your cursor: 10d10, and a limb broken (it fights at half its strength) — a nimble foe halves it · the crow dies, hit or miss

maximum.name: Maximum: Kamikaze
maximum.text: a Bird Strike whose death-cry is an Omen: everything within 30 ft of the foe is frightened too

passives.name: Cursed Crows
passives.text: Your bonded crows fly with you and peck at your foes. Three return each long rest if the flock is smaller.

passives.name: Raven's Eye
passives.text: Your crows see for you: foes and dangers are shown.

feats.name: Deathwatch
feats.text: What you've frightened, the crows keep watching: your blows on Omen-struck foes deal 10% more.

feats.name: Murder's Due
feats.text: Strike an Omen-struck foe and the whole flock collects: every crow pecks it at once (once per round, no crow is lost).

feats.name: All Seeing
feats.text: The flock lends you its eyes: you see in the dark, and darkness, blackout and blindness never take your sight.

feats.name: Scavenger
feats.text: Once per round, a blow on an Omen-struck foe feeds you: heal half your level (as a share of your life).

domain.name: Black Mahakala
domain.sureHit: the murder descends: up to three chosen foes suffer a full Bird Strike at no cost (the crows still die)

techniques.name: Black Box
techniques.summary: Dark Cube, Black Box Reinforcement, Perfect Cube, and Primordial Gap—the toughest containment barrier there is, worn as armor at its peak.

arts.name: Dark Cube
arts.text: an opaque cube closes on the foe at your cursor (30 ft): trapped for 2 rounds — it can't move, act, or be reached from outside (a nimble foe slips out) · from 3rd, hold to reinforce: up to CE mod more CE (twice that from 11th), each 3 a round longer · from 6th, a Perfect Cube (Technique Key 1, +5 CE) holds even a boss

arts.name: Midnight Fist
arts.text: wearing Midnight Armor: a fist of the cube, 3d8 + CE mod

maximum.name: Maximum: Midnight Armor
maximum.text: 1 minute wearing the cube: mended for the cube's strength, far tougher, and your fists hit 3d8 + CE mod

feats.name: Offensive Creations
feats.text: The wall learns to hit: a Dark Cube that traps a foe crushes it as it closes (4 CE more: 5d10), and once a round your weapon blows wrapped in cube add PB d4 (2 CE).

feats.name: Instant Manifestation
