feats.text: Reflex, cubed: once every 10 s, a blow on you lands on a cube snapped shut around you instead (2 CE).

feats.name: Sealing Cube
feats.text: A Perfect Cube seals output too: while trapped, the foe's powers are shut off.

domain.name: Primordial Gap
domain.sureHit: three fresh Perfect Cubes rise around three chosen foes, trapping them until the next pulse

techniques.name: Blazing Courage
techniques.summary: Through your beliefs, you set both your weapon and heart alight with your blazing courage.

arts.name: Ignition
arts.text: set your weapon alight for a minute: hold to pour up to your CE modifier — each CE is 1d6 fire on your melee hits (1d8 at 6th, 1d10 at 11th, 1d12 at 18th), at most three times a second

arts.name: Mantle of Courage
arts.text: while the blade burns: a 10-ft aura of tended flame for a minute — you can't be set burning or chilled and take 10% less, and every foe in it takes your Ignition damage each second (or half)

maximum.name: Maximum: Conflagration
maximum.text: swing a 30-ft cone of flame toward the cursor: 10d12, knocked down for a second · some come out of it badly burned: every fire of yours finds them for PB more (level-scaled) until a long rest

passives.name: Eternal Flames
passives.text: With 3 or more CE in the blade: it's a fifth larger, and every swing throws a lick of flame 10 ft ahead for half your Ignition damage — courage that misses still burns.

passives.name: Technique Release
passives.text: Technique Key 1: end Ignition early and spend the flame at once — everything within 10 ft of the foe you last struck takes your Ignition damage.

feats.name: Ferocious Courage
feats.text: Courage is contagious: once a second, a burning blow lets the flame leap to another foe within 15 ft for half your Ignition damage (1 CE).

feats.name: Blazing Heart
feats.text: The hearth, shared: while your Mantle burns, the teammate nearest you within 30 ft wears it too — no burning, no chill, 10% less from blows.

feats.name: Soulfire
feats.text: The fire burns the soul: once a round (3 CE), a burning blow cuts through defense and leaves severe burns.

domain.name: Fire of the Heart
domain.sureHit: inside, your blade always burns at its fullest; every chosen foe takes your Mantle's flame

techniques.name: Blood Manipulation
techniques.summary: A broad martial toolkit that turns HP and outside blood into construction, control, speed, and output.

arts.name: Slicing Exorcism
arts.text: a spinning ring of blood, 60 ft: 1d10 (Convergence: one more die each step)

arts.name: Blood Constructs
arts.text: a wall of congealed blood at your cursor, one 5-ft segment per CE (and some life) — foes can't pass it, shots break on it, it lasts an hour

arts.name: Crimson Binding
arts.text: a net of blood at the foe at your cursor (30 ft): bound for a minute (a strength check; Convergence holds it longer)

arts.name: Piercing Blood
arts.text: 10 CE and some of your life: a 100-ft line of supersonic blood, 10d8 (Convergence: one more die each step)

quick.name: Flowing Red Scale
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: your blood runs at full speed — twice as fast, tougher, faster blows

maximum.name: Maximum: Supernova
maximum.text: up to PB orbs of compressed blood around you (10 CE and some life each beyond the first): they burst together when a foe comes within 10 ft of one, or after a minute — 10d8 each

passives.name: Convergence
passives.text: Hold an art's key to pour more into it: each step is 1 CE and some life for one more die, up to your CE mod.

feats.name: Blood Transfusion
feats.text: Once per round, an ally within 5 tiles who falls below half life is given your blood (1 CE and a little of your life): they heal 2d6 + your CE power.

feats.name: Crimson Clot
feats.text: Your blood arts clot in the wound: a foe they hit is held for a moment as the blood hardens (once per round per foe).

feats.name: Blood Crystallization
feats.text: Flowing Red Scale also crystallizes your blood into armor: 25% less damage taken and +5 defense — but each round there's a 15% chance the brittle flesh beneath gives (Weak for 30 s).

feats.name: Red Current
feats.text: While Flowing Red Scale runs, you run up walls and across water.

feats.name: Blood Edge
feats.text: Your weapon blows are edged in blood: +1d10 each (a sliver of your life per blow).

feats.name: Flowing Red Scale: Stack
feats.text: Use Flowing Red Scale again while it runs (3 CE) and the flood deepens: three times as fast, +10 defense and +50% attack speed for the rest of it.

domain.name: Bloodbath
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe's own blood attacks it from the inside: 4d12

techniques.name: Blood Techniques
techniques.summary: Blood shaped into rings, nets, crystals, rain and beams — every art paid in CE and your own blood. Convergence compresses it to the limit.

arts.name: Slicing Exorcism
arts.text: [1 life] life · a spinning ring of blood, 1d10 + CE mod, 60 ft

arts.name: Crimson Binding
arts.text: [1 life] life · a red net; whatever it catches is restrained (Str)

arts.name: Blood Meteorite
arts.text: [3 life] life · a hurled crystal of blood, 4d4 + CE mod

arts.name: Crimson Rain
arts.text: [2 life] life · blood spikes rain on a 15-ft radius, 3d10 (Convergence: knocks down)

arts.name: Blood Geyser
arts.text: [3 life] life · saturated ground that erupts under the first foe, 5d10 and launches

arts.name: Blood Burst
arts.text: toggle · weapon hits explode once per round for 1 CE + [1 life] life, 4d6

arts.name: Piercing Blood
arts.text: [5 life] life · a 100-ft supersonic beam, 10d8 (Convergence: it lingers a round and sweeps)

quick.name: Flowing Red Scale
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute · double speed, +6 defense, an extra attack (+25% attack speed), no knockback

other.name: Maximum: Wing King Imitation
other.text: 1 minute on veined wings of blood: you fly (hold Jump), and every second a line of blood rains on the foe nearest below you, 1d10 + CE mod · Piercing Blood sleeps while you fly

passives.name: Blood Bags
passives.text: Blood Bags in your inventory pay HP costs before your own body (5 blood each).

passives.name: Convergence
passives.text: Hold the cast key to compress: each second adds a stage (max 2) — each stage hits much harder and reaches +30 ft.

feats.name: Blood Production
feats.text: Cursed energy spun into blood: when a blood cost would come out of your body, 1 CE pays for up to 10 of it instead.

feats.name: Crimson Afterimage
feats.text: Under Flowing Red Scale you leave a red ghost behind: once every 10 s, a blow finds the afterimage instead of you (3 CE).

feats.name: Supernova
feats.text: Piercing Blood seeds three small suns of blood along its line: for a minute they wait, then burst like buckshot (3d8) when a foe comes near.

feats.name: Maximum: Wing King Imitation
feats.text: Gain the Maximum: a minute of flight on wings of blood, raining lines of ruin below.

domain.name: Bloodbath
domain.sureHit: 4d12 every round as their blood attacks them from within; your blood costs are paid from them

techniques.name: Body Manipulation
techniques.summary: Permanent body theft with a growing library of harvested traits and effective immortality.

arts.name: Graverobber
arts.text: once per long rest: move into the freshest body you've killed (within 10 s, 30 ft) — its might becomes yours: more life, toughness and strength, the bigger it was

maximum.name: Maximum: Backup
maximum.text: designate where you stand as your only backup: the next time you die, you wake there instead, at half your life

passives.name: The New Body
passives.text: A taken body keeps its strength until you take another.

passives.name: Skill Theft
passives.text: Every body you take leaves you one trait it had (wings, fireproof hide, gills, thick hide, speed, venom, a predator's bite). You keep 1 (2 at 6th, 3 at 11th, 4 at 18th); the oldest goes first.

passives.name: Immortality
passives.text: Every body is a new age: weakness and slowness from age never touch you.

techniques.name: Boogie Woogie
techniques.summary: Instant positional exchange with escalating range, hostile swaps, multi-swaps, and deceptive tempo.

arts.name: Boogie
arts.text: clap: you trade places with the foe at your cursor (30 ft; 45 ft from 6th, 60 ft from 11th) · from 3rd, with a foe marked (Technique Key 1), the mark trades places with whatever's at your cursor instead · from 6th it costs nothing · from 11th your next blow after a swap strikes true

maximum.name: Maximum: Best Friend
maximum.text: 1 minute: once per round, a blow about to land on you finds the foe nearest your cursor instead — you've already clapped

passives.name: Woogie
passives.text: Technique Key 1 marks a foe; the next clap swaps it with another (an unwilling foe may resist — the CE is still spent).

passives.name: Clapping With Soul
passives.text: 45-ft reach, and clapping costs nothing.

passives.name: Round of Applause
passives.text: 60-ft reach; after a swap, your next blow within 2 s is a critical.

feats.name: Boogie Down
feats.text: Once per round, a blow about to land on you is clapped away: you swap places with a foe and it misses you (1 CE).

feats.name: Beguiling Tactics
feats.text: A foe you swap is stunned for a second — the first time; once it's seen the trick, only half the time.

domain.name: Standing Ovation
domain.sureHit: a rhythm with no downbeat — there is no pulse: inside, you can clap as often as you like

techniques.name: Centipede Shroud
techniques.summary: Cursed Centipede, Insect Storage, Earthquake, and Vermin of Disaster—a living shikigami shroud that fights with you, stores for you, and devours for you.

arts.name: Earthquake
arts.text: the centipede bursts out of the ground under the foes within 20 ft of your cursor: 4d10, knocked down

arts.name: Vermin of Disaster
arts.text: up to three giant centipedes launch at the foes nearest your cursor (120 ft): 8d10 each, and dragged 30 ft toward you and knocked down (a strength check)

quick.name: Cursed Centipede
quick.text: the centipede wraps around you as a shroud (free the first time each long rest, then 3 CE): your weapon hits add 1d10, and you're tougher · press again to send it away

passives.name: Insect Storage
passives.text: The centipede carries for you: you're a little faster under load.

feats.name: Dowsing Vibrations
feats.text: The appetite listens through the floor: shrouded with your feet on the ground, you sense every creature near you and every danger.

feats.name: Wu Gong
feats.text: Concentrated venom: shrouded, once a round a weapon hit envenoms the foe (1 CE).

feats.name: Living Gullet
feats.text: The stomach carries cargo: Earthquake swallows the smallest foe it hits (not the great ones) and holds it inside for 2 rounds.

domain.name: Centipede Nest
domain.sureHit: centipedes coil around every chosen foe: held fast until the next pulse

techniques.name: Clone
techniques.summary: Split yourself into an army — clones that fight, shield, and trade places with you, until Divide and Conquer.

arts.name: One Man Army
arts.text: a clone of you for 10 minutes, 2d8 + CE mod a blow · it takes blows for you until it has soaked a quarter of your life (half from 6th, all of it from 11th) · one at a time; up to PB from 3rd

quick.name: Body Swap
quick.text: you and your farthest clone trade places

maximum.name: Maximum: Four is a Party
maximum.text: your whole roster splits off at once, fresh, and each clone sets on the nearest foe with a 4d8 opening strike

passives.name: Twice the Fun
passives.text: A blow on a foe with one of your clones beside it finds the opening more often.

passives.name: Three is a Crowd
passives.text: When a clone breaks, you regain 1 CE.

feats.name: Long Leash
feats.text: Your clones step out wherever your cursor points (within 30 ft), not just at your side.

feats.name: Shell Game
feats.text: No one can be sure which body is you: Technique Key 1 trades places with the clone nearest your cursor (within 60 ft).

feats.name: Meant to be Expendable
feats.text: Once every 10 s, when a blow is about to land, a clone splits off mid-blow (4 CE): it shoves you aside and takes it.

feats.name: Shared Burden
feats.text: Your duplicates suffer in your place: every few seconds, the poisons, burns and slowing on you pass to a clone instead.

feats.name: Maximum: Conga Line
feats.text: Four is a Party moves as one: every clone also dashes to the foe nearest your cursor and strikes it (2d8 + CE mod each).

domain.name: Divide and Conquer
domain.sureHit: a clone appears beside every chosen foe and strikes: 2d8 per clone you have (up to 6)

techniques.name: Construction
techniques.summary: Permanent matter creation, temporary cursed items, liquid metal, and a devastating insect armor.

arts.name: Construct
arts.text: hold to pour 1 to PB CE into something real (Technique Key 1 chooses): a weapon — your weapon hits deal 1d6 more per CE for a minute — or matter: a block of solid matter at your cursor (10 ft), one 5-ft cube per CE, that stands for 10 minutes

arts.name: Cursed Creation
arts.text: a cursed item, made for the moment: a random blessing (toughness, mending, speed, archery, wrath, endurance, rage or life force) for an hour

arts.name: Liquid Metal
arts.text: your constructed weapon flows: each use (up to 4) adds reach and a harder die, for a minute

arts.name: Insectoid Armor
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: insectoid armor — much tougher, stronger and faster, and blows land lighter

maximum.name: Maximum: Perfect Sphere
maximum.text: a five-foot sphere, perfect and indestructible, moved by a thought for a minute: it follows your cursor (30 ft from you) and crushes everything it touches, 6d10 every half second

feats.name: Subtle Constructs
feats.text: A weapon built so quietly no one saw it made: the first blow after you Construct a weapon is a critical.

domain.name: Threefold Affliction
domain.sureHit: a law, not an event — there is no pulse: inside, every construction costs 2 CE less

techniques.name: Cursed Cannon
techniques.summary: Extremely high, extremely legible ranged output with splitting, guidance, and a charged cone.

arts.name: Granite Blast
arts.text: a beam of cursed energy toward the cursor, 150 ft: 3d8 (6d8 at 3rd, 8d8 at 6th, 10d8 at 11th, 12d8 at 15th, 12d10 at 18th) · once every 2 s · hold Down as you fire: Grape Shot (+1 CE, from 3rd) — the blast splits among up to PB foes near the cursor, the dice shared out · hold the key, then release: Guided Shell (+1 CE, from 6th) — a shell that hunts its target down

maximum.name: Nuclear Shell
maximum.text: hold the Maximum key 1.5 s to build an obvious, roaring charge, then release: a 150-ft cone of Granite Blast with your CE modifier in extra dice · let go early and it fizzles, free · hold Down as you release: Antimatter Bomb — all of it in 100 ft around you instead

passives.name: One-Man Battery
passives.text: Granite Blast has its own 2 s reload on top of the action cooldown. Nothing about it is subtle.

feats.name: Detonate
feats.text: Fired at a foe within 3 tiles, Granite Blast detonates point-blank: 25% more, and the foe is thrown back.

feats.name: Canshot
feats.text: When a Granite Blast hits, 3 CE shrapnels the impact: every other foe within 5 ft of the target takes half of what it dealt.

feats.name: Croquembouche
feats.text: Once per round, a weapon blow also fires a point-blank Granite Blast into the same foe (1 CE).

domain.name: Il Gran Dolce
domain.sureHit: the sweet course, served on schedule: up to three chosen foes take a full Granite Blast, from above

techniques.name: Cursed Circuitry
techniques.summary: Cursed Circuitry, Advanced Circuits, Linked Circuits, and Circuit Mastery—lay invisible patterns and detonate them as traps.

arts.name: Lay Circuit
arts.text: lay the chosen pattern on the ground at your cursor (30 ft); it waits, unseen by foes, until one steps on it · Combustion: a 10-ft blast, 3d6 fire · Lightning Surge: 15 ft, 2d8 and stunned · Stasis Hold: 10 ft, held fast · Burst Leap: throws everything on it (you too) into the air · from 3rd, for 2 CE more: Binding Chains (15 ft, held long), Energy Discharge (20 ft, 4d6), Energy Drain (20 ft, 2d6 and you take back CE), Cursed Detonation (30 ft, 6d10, once per long rest) · up to 2 + PB at a time

quick.name: Activate
quick.text: set off the pattern nearest your cursor (within 30 ft of you; anywhere you can see from 11th)

other.name: Maximum: Living Circuitry
other.text: 1 minute with the circuit drawn into your own body: your weapon blows add 2d6 lightning, and once a round one stuns the foe a moment

passives.name: Linked Circuits
passives.text: A pattern going off sets off every other pattern within 30 ft of it (60 ft at 11th, 120 ft at 18th), one after another.

passives.name: Circuit Mastery
passives.text: Patterns deal 2d6 more. Activate reaches any pattern. Technique Key 2 — Cursed Overclock: spend up to 5 CE; for a minute your patterns deal 1d6 more per CE spent.

feats.name: Closed Circuit
feats.text: Efficiency, internalized: you leave no trace of your energy, and foes are slower to pick you out of a crowd.

feats.name: Dead-Man's Circuit
feats.text: Keyed to your vitals: when a blow drops you below a quarter of your life, every pattern you've laid goes off at once (once a minute).

feats.name: Circuit Chain Reaction
feats.text: A pattern going off can wake the next: for 2 CE, the nearest pattern within 20 ft goes off too (before Linked Circuits does it for free).

feats.name: Maximum: Living Circuitry
feats.text: Gain the Maximum: become the circuit — lightning on every blow for a minute.

domain.name: Deus ex Machina
domain.sureHit: the whole Domain is your circuit: every chosen foe has its cursed energy drained through it — 6d10, and 1 CE back to you for each (up to 5)

techniques.name: Cursed Corpse Creation
techniques.summary: Cores, bodies, mutations, the Prized Creation, and Perfect Creations—Yaga's cursed-corpse construction and command package.

arts.name: Cursed Corpse
arts.text: sew a core into a body of the chosen size (Technique Key 2): Small (1 CE, 1d8) · Medium (2 CE, 2d8) · from 6th Large (4 CE, 3d8) · from 11th Huge (6 CE, 4d8) · from 18th Gargantuan (10 CE, 6d8) · it fights for 10 minutes · up to CE mod + 1 corpses

passives.name: Corpse Tactics
passives.text: Technique Key 1: Cooperative (your corpses strike true more often) · Offensive (a die harder) · Defensive (blows land lighter on you).

passives.name: Cursed Corpse Mutation
passives.text: One corpse in twenty comes out mutated: half again as big and twice as mean.

passives.name: Perfect Creations
passives.text: Your corpses outlast the fight — they stay an hour.

feats.name: Expert Maker
feats.text: A lifetime of tricks: every corpse costs a third less CE.

feats.name: Patchwork Salvage
feats.text: Nothing is wasted: when a corpse falls, a third of its strength is grafted onto another of yours.

feats.name: Mutate Specialist
feats.text: You repeat the good accidents: the first corpse you sew after each long rest always comes out mutated.

techniques.name: Cursed Speech
techniques.summary: A vocal-strain engine ranging from forced movement to limb destruction, maximum-HP collapse, and death.

arts.name: Speak
arts.text: speak the chosen word (Technique Key 1) at the foe at your cursor (60 ft), paying its CE · Sleep (2): it sleeps until struck · Return (1): it comes back to you · Run Away (1): it flees, its heart gone out of the fight · Blast Away (2): thrown 30 ft, 2d6 · Plummet (2): slammed into the ground, 2d8 · Don't Move (2): frozen for a round · from 3rd Get Twisted (3): 4d8 and a limb wrenched · from 6th Get Crushed (4): 6d8 and pinned · from 11th Explode (5): 8d10 · from 18th Die (10): a lesser foe dies (a resolve check), a great one takes 15d10 · hold to pour more: one more d10 per CE (1 at 3rd up to 4 at 18th)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Last Word
maximum.text: the chosen word, spoken to every foe within 60 ft at once, at no strain

passives.name: Vocal Cords
passives.text: Every CE a word costs is taken from your throat too (10 + level, doubled from 6th). It heals slowly; at 0 you can't speak.

passives.name: Interjection
passives.text: Technique Key 2 binds the chosen word, then speaks it instantly at the cursor (once per round).

passives.name: Resounding Voice
passives.text: Technique Key 3: +5 CE, and the word falls on everything in a 35-ft cone.

feats.name: Fighting Words
feats.text: A foe that hears your word also loses its nerve: it hits 15% softer for a minute.

feats.name: Hushed Word
feats.text: Your Interjection is whispered into one ear: it strains your throat only half as much.

feats.name: Megaphone
feats.text: Hold Down while speaking a Resounding word to focus it into a lance: everything in a 70-ft line hears it instead of the cone.

feats.name: Quick Tongue
feats.text: Your Interjection can be spoken twice a round.

domain.name: The Last Word
domain.sureHit: you speak the chosen word; every chosen foe falls under it at no cost

techniques.name: Cursed Spirit Manipulation
techniques.summary: An unlimited stored collection, bounded active roster, sacrificial defense, Uzumaki, and extracted actions.

arts.name: Release Spirit
arts.text: call a stored spirit of the chosen kind (Technique Key 1) — CE by its strength — to fight beside you for 10 minutes; up to CE mod at once · from 6th the summons answer faster

arts.name: Absorb
arts.text: passive: whatever you kill is swallowed into your collection — a boss's orb is hard to keep down (you're weakened a while)

maximum.name: Maximum: Uzumaki
maximum.text: every active spirit spirals into one blast: a 30-ft cone, 2d12 — +1d12 and +5 ft for every spirit beyond the second · the spirits are spent

passives.name: Sacrificial Defense
passives.text: Once per round, a blow that lands on you is thrown onto an active spirit (CE by its strength): reduced by d20s by its grade, and the spirit is destroyed.

passives.name: Perfect Control
passives.text: Summoning is quicker.

feats.name: Defensive Summoning
feats.text: With no spirit out, Sacrificial Defense calls one from your collection to take the blow (5 CE plus its cost; it's spent).

feats.name: Minimum: Uzumaki
feats.text: With fewer than two spirits out, the Maximum spends two stored spirits of the chosen kind instead: a small, hard-to-dodge Uzumaki that hunts the foe nearest your cursor — a d12 per point of their strength.

feats.name: Uzumaki Versatility
feats.text: A Minimum: Uzumaki with no foe near your cursor waits in your hand for up to a minute and fires itself at the first foe that comes within 60 ft.

domain.name: Womb Profusion
domain.sureHit: a procession of curses engulfs every chosen foe: 8d10 · inside, summoning costs nothing

techniques.name: Cursed Transmutation
techniques.summary: Cursed Transmutation, Elemental Manipulation, Alchemy of the Soul, and Cursed Energy Transmutation—reshape matter, elements, and flesh itself.

arts.name: Transmute
arts.text: reshape a 10-ft cube of matter at your cursor (60 ft; 20 ft at 6th, 30 ft at 11th, 40 ft at 18th) into the chosen form (Technique Key 1): a weapon — your weapon hits add 1d8 for a minute · from 3rd fire (3d6 to everything in it) · water (everything in it is swept back 15 ft and slowed) · stone (a wall)

arts.name: Alchemy of the Soul
arts.text: hold to pour CE into your own flesh: 1d8 mended per 2 CE

arts.name: Toxic Alchemy
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft): 4d6 poison and poisoned for a minute (a toughness check halves it, and no poison)

arts.name: Cursed Energy Transmutation
arts.text: hold to pour CE: a 60-ft line of raw force, 1d8 per 2 CE (a nimble foe halves it)

maximum.name: Maximum: Transmutation Sphere
maximum.text: a 20-ft sphere at your cursor (60 ft) is unmade and remade: 6d8 force to everything in it, and it's stunned a moment

feats.name: Soul Alchemy
feats.text: The transmutation of relation: Alchemy of the Soul also mends the most hurt teammate within 30 ft for half as much.

domain.name: Mandala of Dependent Origination
domain.sureHit: the whole Domain is transmuted at once in the chosen form, on every chosen foe — fire, water or stone at full strength

techniques.name: Dark Claw
techniques.summary: Dark Claw, Adaptation, Eight-Handled Sword, Divine Adaptation, and Zenith—Mahoraga's claw, Mahoraga's adaptation, Mahoraga's zenith.

arts.name: Eight-Handled Sword
arts.text: Mahoraga's sword for a minute: the cast key sweeps it — 2d12 + CE mod in a wide arc

arts.name: Sword Arc
arts.text: with the Eight-Handled Sword: a sweeping arc, 2d12 + CE mod (a critical against what you've adapted to... in a sense)

quick.name: Dark Claw
quick.text: 1 minute: a great black claw — your weapon blows add 1d8 + CE mod, and you're tougher

maximum.name: Maximum: Zenith
maximum.text: 1 minute at the wheel's zenith: every blow you land is a critical, and you adapt to everything at once

passives.name: Adaptation
passives.text: The first blow from a kind of foe costs 1 CE to adapt to; then that kind hurts you half as much for a round (a minute from 6th; three-quarters less from 11th).

feats.name: Close Combat Specialist
feats.text: The claw is a hand that doesn't let go: once a round, a claw blow at arm's length grips the foe — held a moment, and torn again a second later (1d8 + CE mod).

feats.name: Wheel of Adaptation
feats.text: The wheel turns for others: each time you adapt, the teammate nearest you within 30 ft takes 15% less from blows for a minute (2 CE).

feats.name: Mahoraga's Fury
feats.text: At half life or less, the fury surfaces: once a round a blow on you slams the claw into the ground (2 CE) — claws erupt within 15 ft, 3d8.

feats.name: Perfect Adaptation
feats.text: Nothing learned is wasted: Technique Key 1 (3 CE) discharges your newest adaptation — a 20-ft burst of what you learned, 4d10.

domain.name: Hall of the Five-Clawed Dragon
domain.sureHit: your claws stab through space at one chosen foe: a critical blow, distance ignored

techniques.name: Deadly Sentencing
techniques.summary: A nonviolent trial Domain that judges an actual offense, confiscates power, and may issue an Executioner's Sword.

arts.name: Judge's Gavel
arts.text: your authority, made solid — swing it toward the cursor: Light Hammer (thrown, 1d4 + PB), Maul (2d6 + PB, a heavy blow), Pole Hammer (1d10 + PB, long reach) · Technique Key 1 changes the weight · first summon after a long rest is free, later ones 1 CE · from 6th: Large doubles the dice, Huge triples them and the maul slams a 10-ft square (Key 2) · after a death sentence it's the Executioner's Sword: it ends the condemned with a touch (bosses: a seventh of their life a blow), a plain longsword to anyone else

arts.name: Order in the Court
arts.text: slam the gavel: every foe within 15 ft that hears it reels — it can't react for a moment

passives.name: Deadly Sentencing
passives.text: Your Domain is a courtroom. Judgeman tries the one nearest your cursor — a monster, or a hostile player — for what it has actually done. A monster answers for whom it has harmed or killed, for its kind (any kind that has ever killed a player in this world), for spreading the corruption (Corruption and Crimson natives), and — if it's a boss — for everything its legend says it did. A player answers for their record: murder, a massacre of innocents (bunnies and other critters), slaying the great (bosses), what those deaths set loose (the Guide sacrificed to the Wall, the Cultist's fall, deicide…), spreading the corruption, smashing demon altars, slaughter. Evidence (stronger the longer the record) and argument decide it; ties go to the accused. Guilty: Confiscation — a monster can't fire and hits at 60%, a player loses their technique — until you dismiss it. A killing, proven by a wide margin, also earns the Executioner's Sword. Then the barrier falls.

passives.name: Judgeman Release
passives.text: Technique Key 4 (5 CE, a minute, uses Focus): Judgeman watches one foe within 60 ft. Every blow it lands on you weighs on it: it hits softer, and your blows land harder, more with each.

passives.name: Better Evidence
passives.text: Judgeman finds two pieces of evidence and you choose the better (three from 18th).

passives.name: Unstopping Justice
passives.text: Your first CE modifier trials each long rest cost nothing.

domain.name: Deadly Sentencing
domain.sureHit: no sure-hit: court is in session — nothing inside can harm anything while Judgeman tries the accused; the verdict lands, then the barrier falls

techniques.name: Disaster Flames
techniques.summary: Reliable fire waves, placed volcanoes, explosive shikigami, and a conspicuous Maximum Meteor.

arts.name: Flames of Disaster
arts.text: a 15-ft cone of flame toward the cursor: 1d8 fire (2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th) and it sets foes burning · hold to keep the stream going, 1 CE per gout

arts.name: Erupting Volcanoes
arts.text: plant a volcano on the ground under your cursor (within 120 ft) for a minute · hold to plant more, 2 CE each, up to your CE modifier · the oldest gives way to the newest

arts.name: Ember Insects
arts.text: a swarm of four ember insects for a minute: they fly at your foes on their own, 1d6 fire each (one swarm at a time)

quick.name: Erupt
quick.text: every volcano erupts at once, each a 30-ft line of magma toward the cursor: 5d10 fire and stuck in the magma for 3 s · hold Up as you call it: the nearest volcano within 30 ft erupts under you instead and throws you 60 ft into the air (+2 CE)

maximum.name: Maximum: Meteor
maximum.text: you are lifted 60 ft and a meteor gathers over you for a second; then you ride it down to the cursor (within 120 ft of where you rose): 10d4 + 10d6 to everything within 120 ft of the impact · if you're knocked out before it falls, it scatters

passives.name: Pyrokinesis
passives.text: Your own fire doesn't take: you can't be set burning.

feats.name: Ashfall
feats.text: Flames of Disaster leaves choking ash where it burned: foes caught in the cone are blinded for 3 s.

feats.name: Hellscape
feats.text: Where Maximum: Meteor lands, the ground within 100 ft melts into lava for a minute: foes standing in it take 4d6 fire every second.

feats.name: Pyrokinesis Refined
feats.text: Training finds more in the old flame: Flames of Disaster reaches half again as far, and your fire arts roll their damage twice and keep the better.

domain.name: Coffin of the Iron Mountain
domain.sureHit: black iron seals around each chosen foe as magma erupts within: 10d10 fire, and it stays entombed until the next sure-hit

techniques.name: Disaster Storms
techniques.summary: Storms of Disaster, Lightning, Storm Creation, Divine Storm Sovereign, and the Heavenly Throne—wind and lightning made into a calamity.

arts.name: Storms of Disaster
arts.text: a 15-ft cone of cutting wind: 2d8 (3d8 at 5th, 4d8 at 11th, 5d8 at 17th; a nimble foe halves it)

arts.name: Lightning
arts.text: a bolt at the foe at your cursor, 60 ft: 3d6 (4d6 at 6th, 6d6 at 11th, 8d6 at 18th) — and half that to another foe within 10 ft of it

arts.name: Storm Creation
arts.text: a 10-ft storm around you for a minute (hold to pour CE for +5 ft each, up to PB): foes in it wade, and each round they may be knocked down

maximum.name: Maximum: Divine Storm Sovereign
maximum.text: a 100-ft storm at any point within 300 ft, for a minute: foes in it can't see through it, wade, may be knocked down every round, and are cut by the wind each round (your Storms dice)

feats.name: Aerokinesis
feats.text: New uses for old storms: foes inside your storms are starved of air and fight weaker, and while a storm stands you feel every body that moves the air (you sense all hostiles).

feats.name: Flying Nimbus
feats.text: Your Storm Creation carries you: while it's up you fly (hold Jump), and a Storm of Disaster thrown in the air drifts you 10 ft with it.

feats.name: Squall
feats.text: The storm is your will: with you and your cursor both inside your storms, a Storm of Disaster steps you to the cursor and bursts all around you there.

domain.name: Heavenly Throne
domain.sureHit: lightning falls from the throne on every chosen foe: 8d6

techniques.name: Disaster Tides
techniques.summary: Hydrokinesis anchored by level-3 Domain access, a sea-shikigami roster, extreme defense, and flooding.

arts.name: Tides of Disaster
arts.text: throw water you make toward the cursor (120 ft): 1d8 cold (2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th) · hold, then release: a high-pressure lance 30 ft long instead (+1 CE): 2d10 + 2d6, and a foe that can't take it ({chance PB 13}) is knocked down and takes it again

arts.name: Death Swarm: Sperm Whale
arts.text: call the largest of the drowned: 6d10 a bite, for a minute (inside your Domain; anywhere from 11th) · the others answer to Technique Keys 1–4

arts.name: Water Defensive Ring
arts.text: a ring of water around you for 10 minutes: CE mod × 15 temporary life that takes blows first, and while it holds you're immune to cold and take 25% less from everything · rises by itself when a heavy hit comes in (8 CE) · one ring at a time

arts.name: Flash Flood
arts.text: the foe nearest your cursor within 30 ft: 10d8 cold and swept 80 ft away · hold Down as you cast: the whole flood instead (+2 CE) — 8d12 to everything within 10 ft of a point 30 ft away

maximum.name: Maximum: Tsunami
maximum.text: the sea itself: a wall of water rises behind you and rolls toward the cursor for 4 s — 6d10 a second to everything it carries · needs your Focus: break it and the sea falls

passives.name: Tide-born
passives.text: You breathe water and swim like you were born in it.

passives.name: Death Swarm
passives.text: Technique Keys 1–4 call sea shikigami: Eel (1 CE), Piranhas (2), River Serpent (4), Killer Whale (6). Up to your CE modifier at once, each for a minute — inside your Domain only, until 11th level.

feats.name: Shoal
feats.text: The school hunts in open water now: Death Swarm answers outside your Domain, before 11th level.

feats.name: Typhoon
feats.text: Your Water Defensive Ring brings weather with it: while it holds, a storm churns 20 ft around you — 2d6 to every foe in it each second, and it's thrown back.

domain.name: Horizon of Captivating Skandha
domain.sureHit: the spectral school engulfs every chosen foe: 8d10, and it's held by the feeding current until the next sure-hit · two free openings a long rest, then 20 CE

techniques.name: Disaster Verdure
techniques.summary: Roots, walls, flying seed platforms, pacifying flowers, CE-draining buds, and a hostile garden.

arts.name: Binding Plants
arts.text: plants seize the foe nearest your cursor within 30 ft: held in place for 6 s

arts.name: Piercing Roots
arts.text: roots tear up in a 50-ft line toward the cursor: 1d12 (2d12 at 5th, 3d12 at 11th, 4d12 at 17th)

arts.name: Root Bundle
arts.text: two wooden balls float at your shoulders for 10 minutes · Technique Key 1 launches them at the foe nearest your cursor (2d10 each) · Technique Key 2 steps onto one: you fly at walking speed while you ride it

arts.name: Flower Field
arts.text: a 30-ft circle of petals on a point within 100 ft: everything in it loses the will to fight for a minute — it stands still and does nothing until something hits it (bosses only soften: half damage for half as long) · the petals keep lulling whatever wanders in for 6 s

arts.name: Cursed Buds
arts.text: launch buds equal to your CE modifier at foes within 30 ft: each that lands takes root and drinks your CE modifier (level-scaled) every 2 s for a minute · hold Down as you cast: plant the bud tree instead (+2 CE) — for a minute it fires a bud (2d6) at every foe within 30 ft of it every 2 s

quick.name: Wall of Roots
quick.text: toggle · while on, when a blow is about to land, a wall of roots rises between you and it (1 CE, every 3 s): the blow is stopped, and shots that reach the wall die in it for 2 s

passives.name: Forests of Disaster
passives.text: The plants answer you: standing on grass, you regenerate faster.

passives.name: Bouquet
passives.text: Technique Key 3 (3 CE): one bloom, hand-delivered — the foe nearest your cursor within 60 ft is lulled as by Flower Field.

passives.name: Stranglehold
passives.text: Technique Key 4: every foe carrying your buds within 60 ft is constricted, held for 1 s (every 3 s).

feats.name: Sapping Roots
feats.text: The roots drink deeper than blood: striking a foe that carries your buds draws 1 CE back to you (once a second).

domain.name: Ceremonial Sea of Light
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe takes 2d4 and falls under Flower Field; you drink half of what it took as CE

techniques.name: Disaster Vermin
techniques.summary: Vermin of Disaster, Earthen Insect Trance, Almighty Swarm, Parthenogenesis, and the Brood Cathedral—a living swarm of horrors.

arts.name: Vermin of Disaster
arts.text: an insect swarm boils out beside you and hunts for 10 minutes, 2d6 a bite (one at a time; PB at once from 3rd)

arts.name: Earthen Insect Trance
arts.text: a pouch shikigami crawls out (up to 2): a heavy beetle, 3d8

arts.name: Parthenogenesis
arts.text: 8 CE, 1 less for every creature your swarms have devoured in the last 8 hours: an egg at your cursor that hatches a swarm every round for a minute

maximum.name: Maximum: Almighty Swarm
maximum.text: every swarm you can hold boils out at once, and the whole cloud falls on the foe at your cursor — 6d8 from each

feats.name: Reinforced Vermin
feats.text: Your swarms come out hardened when you can spare 2 CE: a size larger, with two more dice a bite.

feats.name: Vermin Bulwark
feats.text: Once a round, a swarm within 10 ft of you throws itself in front of a blow: it's spent, and you aren't touched.

feats.name: Festering Life Sword
feats.text: While a swarm hunts for you, your weapon festers: its hits poison, and once a round add 1d8.

feats.name: Vermin Techniques
feats.text: The nest is armor and hand: with a swarm at your side, blows land 10% lighter on you, and the Almighty Swarm drags its prey into the cloud (pulled toward you and held).

domain.name: Brood Cathedral
domain.sureHit: the walls hatch: every chosen foe is swarmed — 6d8, and poisoned

techniques.name: Divergent Fist
techniques.summary: Delayed impact and a disciplined martial package that eventually guarantees Black Flash under strict conditions.

arts.name: Divergent Flow
arts.text: toggle · while on, a weapon hit pays 1 CE and lands again a second later as cursed force: the same damage, through defense, never a critical (once a second per foe; two foes a second from level 6)

arts.name: Manji Kick
arts.text: Martial Prowess · a rising kick at the foe nearest your cursor: 2d8 plus half your melee weapon; a foe that can't take it ({chance PB 13}) takes double and is stunned

arts.name: Stance of the Sparks
arts.text: toggle a stance: you swing far slower, but every weapon hit that lands is a critical — and may become a Black Flash

quick.name: One-Two
quick.text: Martial Prowess · two punches toward the cursor: a light jab, then a cross with triple weight (1d6, then 3d6 plus your melee weapon)

maximum.name: Maximum: Soul Punch
maximum.text: 6 s: your weapon hits strike the soul — through all defense, and each one suppresses the foe's output (−10% damage per hit, down to half) for a minute

passives.name: Divergent Flow
passives.text: Every blow lands twice: once by the body, once by the energy arriving late.

passives.name: Weave
passives.text: Double-tap a direction just as a blow comes in: you read it in the shoulder and are gone (a dodge, every 4 s). One Martial Prowess move every 3 s.

passives.name: Controlled Divergent Flow
passives.text: The echo can follow two different foes a second. A foe the echo lands on is open for 2 s: your hits on it crit 15% more often.

passives.name: Chosen by the Sparks
passives.text: Every critical weapon hit is a Black Flash.

feats.name: Black Belt
feats.text: Your Martial Prowess moves come twice as often, and the Manji Kick becomes a flying drop kick that throws its foe 30 ft.

techniques.name: Dragon Vein
techniques.summary: Your technique forms an unbreakable connection between you and the earth while your feet touch the ground.

arts.name: Ley Line Command
arts.text: on the ground: draw on the earth for a minute — you can't be knocked back, every hit you take is reduced (PB, life-scaled), and a heavy blow is braced against automatically (1 CE: half of it) · from 11th you can't be held, webbed, frozen or stoned · it lapses while your feet are off the ground

arts.name: Ground Control
arts.text: stomp: every foe on the ground within 30 ft is knocked off its feet (held for 1 s) and the earth heaves under them

maximum.name: Maximum: Dragon Pulse
maximum.text: stomp the world: every foe within 120 ft on the ground or high above it takes 10d10, knocked down and stunned for 2 s (a few keep their feet: half, no stun) · 5 temporary life (life-scaled) for each one that falls

passives.name: Flow of the Dragon
passives.text: Feet on the ground: your melee hits add PB (level-scaled; up to three times a second) and nothing knocks you back.

passives.name: Earth Dragon Soul
passives.text: While the Ley Line holds, a melee hit draws 1d8 more from the earth once a second (2d8 at 11th, 3d8 at 18th). Stand still for a second first and it can do so twice — but the earth holds you in place for a second after.

passives.name: World Anchor
passives.text: On the ground, every few seconds the earth gives you temporary life (PB + CE mod, life-scaled; replaced, not stacked). Below half life with the Ley Line up: 3 CE for half damage from everything for 6 s, once every 6 s.

feats.name: Ley Line Extension
feats.text: The mountain lends its footing: while your Ley Line holds, up to CE mod teammates within 30 ft share it — no knockback and 10% less from blows while their feet touch the ground.

domain.name: Of Primordial World
domain.sureHit: the ground is the only law: anything inside that flies more than 10 ft above the ground is crushed down into it for 5d10 (once a second) · you are always under the Ley Line here

techniques.name: Earth Manipulation
techniques.summary: Mold stone into cubes, armor, tremors, walls, and grasping giant arms: the earth itself, shaped at will.

arts.name: Excavation
arts.text: hold to pour CE: one 5-ft cube of stone per CE (up to CE mod), raised in a row on the ground at your cursor (30 ft) · cubes stop shots and foes can't walk through them · anything standing where a cube rises is thrown up out of it · they crumble after half a minute

arts.name: Rock Blast
arts.text: strike the ground: everything within 20 ft takes 3d10 (4d10 at 6th, 5d10 at 11th, 6d10 at 18th; a nimble foe halves it) and is knocked down

arts.name: Wall of Stone
arts.text: a wall of stone rises at your cursor (60 ft): 2 cubes wide, 4 high, for a minute · Technique Key 1 (1 CE): shove it 30 ft along the ground toward the cursor's side, ramming foes in its way for 2d10

maximum.name: Stone Arms
maximum.text: two giant arms of stone close on a foe within 60 ft: 6d12 and held · Focus, 1 CE a round to keep them: each round they crush it for 4d12 more and keep it held

other.name: Rock Burst
other.text: the stone of yours nearest your cursor (60 ft) explodes: everything within 10 ft of it takes 2d12 (a nimble foe halves it)

feats.name: Density Manipulation
feats.text: You set the stone's weight: your cubes and walls are dense as lead — they stand twice as long, and a foe thrown up by a rising cube is held a moment.

feats.name: Rock Burst
feats.text: What was built can be unbuilt, violently: the quick key blows up your stone nearest the cursor (1 CE), 2d12 to everything within 10 ft.

feats.name: Arms of the Giant
feats.text: Interposing Fist: while your Stone Arms hold a foe, they also close around you as a shield — blows land 20% lighter.

domain.name: Trichiliocosm
domain.sureHit: the ground itself shifts against every chosen foe: 6d12, and held in stone until the next sure-hit

techniques.name: Eight Heads
techniques.summary: Eight lives, serpent-fang shikigami, and a sacrificial barrier that feeds the slain back into your life bank.

arts.name: Fangs of Orochi
arts.text: hold to pour up to 8 CE: one serpent fang per CE rises beside you and strikes for 10 minutes, 2d6

maximum.name: Maximum: Sacrifice
maximum.text: with 3 or more fangs out: they coil around the foe at your cursor (40 ft) and bury themselves — a trigram cylinder seals it for 3 rounds, and the fangs are spent

passives.name: Eight Lives
passives.text: When you'd die, 1 CE brings you back at half your life, cleansed (3 times a long rest; 4 at 3rd; 8 at 11th).

feats.name: Snake Scales
feats.text: Like Orochi, you shed: once a round, a blow that lands while you're poisoned, slowed, webbed or bleeding sloughs your outer scales (2 CE) and every such ailment with them.

feats.name: Fang Versatility
feats.text: The fangs are cutlery as well as artillery: Technique Key 1 flings one of your fangs at the foe nearest your cursor — 3d6 poison, and it's spent.

feats.name: Blessing of the Hydra
feats.text: Each death teaches a refusal: when Eight Lives brings you back, whatever felled you hurts you 30% less for 10 minutes.

domain.name: Yamata no Orochi
domain.sureHit: the eight-headed serpent forms from the earth and bites: every chosen foe takes 8d10

techniques.name: Esoteric Art
techniques.summary: Cursed paintings that swallow creatures into painted subspaces stocked with ink shikigami, structures, and traps.

arts.name: Impasto Canvas
arts.text: place the chosen effect (Technique Key 1) at your cursor inside your painting: Ink Wolves (up to CE mod, 1 CE each, 1d8) · Difficult Ground (foes wade) · a Structure (a wall) · a Pit Trap (held and 2d6 when stepped on) · from 6th an Ink Crow (3 CE, flies, 2d6) · the Ink Wave (2 CE, a 30-ft cone of ink, 3d6, shoved back)

arts.name: Panoramic Composition
arts.text: foes near your cursor (60 ft; up to twice CE mod, 2 CE each beyond the first) are sucked into the painting for 2 rounds — gone from the fight (a nimble foe resists)

quick.name: Paint
quick.text: the ground around your cursor becomes your painting (60 ft, 10 minutes)

feats.name: Air Brush
feats.text: The canvas eats the blow: inside your painting, once a round a blow on you has a third of a chance to land on a painting formed in its path instead (1 CE).

feats.name: Diptych
feats.text: The subspaces fold together: standing outside your painting with your cursor inside it, the quick key steps you through to the cursor (4 CE) instead of painting anew.

feats.name: Gradient
feats.text: A travelling exhibition: the 30 ft around you always counts as your painting.

domain.name: Magnum Opus
domain.sureHit: the Domain is your painting: two Impasto effects simply happen to every chosen foe — ink wolves tear at it (3d8) and a pit takes it (held)

techniques.name: Explosive Flesh
techniques.summary: Turn your own body into the bomb: detachable explosive anatomy from tooth to leg, thrown or detonated on the spot.

arts.name: Explosive Flesh
arts.text: tear off the chosen part (Technique Key 1) and throw it (60 ft) — it detonates where it lands: Tooth (1 CE, 2d6, 5 ft) · Finger (2 CE, 3d6, 10 ft) · from 3rd Hand (3 CE, 5d6, 10 ft) · from 6th Arm (5 CE, 8d6, 15 ft) · from 11th Leg (6 CE, 10d6, 20 ft) · each costs some of your life (it grows back) · a nimble foe halves it

maximum.name: Maximum: Full Body Detonation
maximum.text: everything at once — you detonate where you stand: 16d6 to everything within 30 ft, and a third of your life with it

other.name: Payload
other.text: choose what your thrown parts carry: plain · fire (it burns) · cold (it slows) · lightning (the wound jumps to a second foe) — an elemental part costs its CE twice

passives.name: Faster Throws
passives.text: Tearing and throwing is quick.

passives.name: Guerilla Tactics
passives.text: Once per round, when a melee blow lands on you or you land one, the chosen part goes off on your body (its CE and life): everything near you takes its blast.

passives.name: Stronger Explosions
passives.text: Blasts are 5 ft wider, and what they catch is dazed.

feats.name: Reduced Harm
feats.text: Economy of flesh: every part costs you less life (by your CE modifier), though never nothing.

feats.name: Elemental Bomb
feats.text: The payload takes on flavors: the quick key picks fire, cold or lightning for your thrown parts, at twice the part's CE.

domain.name: Detonation Field
domain.sureHit: you choose a limb on every chosen foe — and detonate it: 8d6

techniques.name: Fa Jin
techniques.summary: You can store and release kinetic energy using your cursed technique.

arts.name: Bank a Charge
arts.text: spend CE straight into the bank: 1 Jin charge (2 from 11th)

arts.name: Fist of Explosive Power
arts.text: spend up to PB charges as compressed air shaped by your weapon: a sword or spear fires a 30-ft line (2d10 a charge) · anything else, a 15-ft cone (2d6 a charge) that knocks foes down · with 3+ charges from 11th: 30 ft farther

quick.name: Store and Release
quick.text: hold to commit charges to your next melee blow (up to PB; CE pays when the bank is empty): +1d8 each (level-scaled) if it lands — if the swing finds nothing, they're spent (from 11th you keep up to your CE modifier)

maximum.name: Maximum: Destructive Release
maximum.text: the vault emptied at once: Fist of Explosive Power at three dice a charge, and everything it catches is thrown back

passives.name: Store and Release
passives.text: A melee swing that misses with a foe close by banks a Jin charge (up to PB + level). Charges are lost on a long rest.

passives.name: Kinetic Absorption
passives.text: A heavy blow (a tenth of your life or more) is partly banked: 1 CE takes some of it off and gives you a charge (every 2 s).

passives.name: Instantaneous Movement
passives.text: Stand your ground for 2 s in a fight: +1 charge. Double-tap a direction: spend a charge to blink 10 ft. Hold Down as you double-tap: spend 3 for a 30-ft blink, and your next blow lands with thunder.

domain.name: Hall of Divine Bagua
domain.sureHit: inside, your bank never runs dry; every foe in the hall takes on a negative charge — its blows soften 10% more each time, until the Domain ends

techniques.name: Faceless God
techniques.summary: Infect minds with escalating Madness and Corruption; even the user is not exempt from the madness they spread.

arts.name: Madness Inducement
arts.text: every foe within 120 ft that sees you (a resolve check — one that resists is safe from it for a day): 1d6 Madness (2d6 from 3rd) · at 10 Madness a foe goes berserk: it turns on whatever foe is nearest it each round and wears itself down

maximum.name: Maximum: Rumination
maximum.text: the foes within 30 ft glimpse the Faceless God: 1d6 Corruption each (2d6 at 14th, 3d6 at 17th) — every round, each one either resists or takes 1d10 per 10 Corruption and sinks deeper

passives.name: Obsession and Insanity
passives.text: Madness is contagious: each round, a berserk foe gives 1d6 Madness to the foes within 30 ft of it.

feats.name: Veil of the Faceless God
feats.text: Every infected mind is a borrowed eye: while any foe carries your Madness, you sense every creature around you.

feats.name: Hands of Madness
feats.text: The contagion moves into your fists: once a second, a weapon hit gives 1d6 Madness, and a foe already maddened (5 or more) takes 1d6 more.

feats.name: True Mania
feats.text: You aim the storm: a berserk foe turns on the foe nearest your cursor (if it can reach it) instead of its neighbor.

domain.name: Theia Mania
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe takes 2d6 Madness — and if more than half of them are berserk or corrupted, the whole Domain screams: 10d10 (20d10 to those who break)

techniques.name: Fate
techniques.summary: Seven red-thread Fates—shared wounds, mirrored rolls, destined death—and a Domain whose Destined Foe it never misses.

arts.name: Fate Manipulation
arts.text: tie the foe at your cursor (60 ft) to the foe nearest it (30 ft) with the chosen Fate (Technique Key 1), for a minute (+1 CE for each thread already holding; up to PB) · Shared Wounds: what you do to one, the other takes half of · Tethered: they're dragged back together if they part · Doomed: both take a quarter more from everything

quick.name: Cursed Eyes of Fate
quick.text: read the thread of the foe at your cursor: its life, toughness and strength

other.name: Maximum: Shears of Three Fates
other.text: snip a thread of the foe at your cursor (10 ft): every round it must hold on — three failures and its fate ends (the great ones lose a tenth of their life each failure instead); three holds and it's spared

passives.name: Strong Destiny
passives.text: Threads last 5 minutes.

feats.name: Destined One
feats.text: You tug the threads you tie: once a round, striking a threaded foe drags its partner 10 ft toward it and holds it a moment.

feats.name: Web of Fate
feats.text: The loom widens: a Fate ties the foe at your cursor to every other foe within 30 ft of it (up to PB), and you can keep that many more threads.

feats.name: Maximum: Shears of Three Fates
feats.text: Gain the Maximum: snip a foe's thread of fate and let the slow death follow.

domain.name: Road of Karma
domain.sureHit: the strongest chosen foe is named your Destined Foe; your weapon strikes it on its own, a blow that can't miss

techniques.name: G Warstaff
techniques.summary: A conjured G-pen that marks futures seconds ahead—foresight that becomes guaranteed criticals and a Domain that reads every future at once.

arts.name: Warstaff Strike
arts.text: with the warstaff: a long jab, 10 ft, 1d4 + CE mod — and one more second of the foe's future marked (up to PB)

quick.name: Warstaff
quick.text: conjure the G-pen warstaff until the fight's over

other.name: Maximum: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
other.text: 1 minute editing the panels: a foe read six seconds can't land a blow on you, and every warstaff strike on it is a critical

passives.name: Highlighted Panels
passives.text: A foe marked 2 seconds or more: its blows on you land at half.

passives.name: Predictable Strikes
passives.text: A foe marked 3 seconds or more: once per round, your warstaff strike on it is a critical.

passives.name: Precognition
passives.text: You strike true more often (half your CE mod, in steps).

feats.name: Greater Foresight
feats.text: Foresight shared with the line: while your staff is out and a foe near you is read, teammates within 30 ft strike truer and stand firmer.

feats.name: True Warstaff: Full Spread
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (4 CE): drive the staff into the ground at your cursor (30 ft) — a 15-ft standing panel for a minute that reads one more second of every foe inside it each second.

feats.name: GG True Warstaff
feats.text: The weapon's true form: the warstaff strike reaches 15 ft, hits 1d8 + CE mod, and a critical reads two more seconds.

feats.name: Maximum: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
feats.text: Gain the Maximum: edit what you read — the read can't touch you, and you can't miss what you've read.

domain.name: Storyboard Dominion
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe counts as six seconds read: you see every future at once

techniques.name: Golden Hour
techniques.summary: Stopped time in an instant, purchased extra moments, a six-second rewind—and a Domain that stops time on every pulse.

arts.name: Majestic Pose
arts.text: hold to pour up to twice PB CE: 2 s of stopped time for every 3 CE — afterwards you can't move for a moment

arts.name: Golden Week
arts.text: 1 minute instead of stopping time: twice as fast, tougher, and quicker blows

arts.name: Samsara Rewind
arts.text: six seconds back: you're where you stood and as hurt as you were then

arts.name: Hour Hand
arts.text: with the Clock Hand: a reaching thrust, 1d10 + CE mod (3d8 more against the frozen)

quick.name: Golden Hour
quick.text: time stops for 2 s around you (60 ft): foes freeze where they are, their shots hang in the air, and every blow you land on something frozen is a critical

maximum.name: Maximum: Clock Hand
maximum.text: the Clock Hand in your hands for 10 minutes: the cast key thrusts it (10 ft, 1d10 + CE mod) — and against anything frozen in time, 3d8 more

feats.name: Quick Pose
feats.text: The pose as reflex: once every 10 s, a blow about to land stops time first (5 CE) — it misses, and everything around you freezes for 1 s.

feats.name: Prime Time
feats.text: You carry others through the pause: when you stop time, teammates within 30 ft step into it with you (2 CE) — their next blow is a critical.

domain.name: The World
domain.sureHit: time stops at every pulse, for twice as long, for every chosen foe

techniques.name: Hair Manipulation
techniques.summary: Stingers, explosive drills, and helicopter or jet hair-forms—crowned by a Domain that shreds everything that moves.

arts.name: Hair Stingers
arts.text: three needles of hardened hair at the cursor, 60 ft: 1d6 + CE mod each (1d10 from 11th)

arts.name: Explosive Drill
arts.text: a spiraling drill of hair that bursts where it hits: 4d8 in 10 ft (6d8 from 11th, 8d8 at 18th; a nimble foe halves it)

arts.name: Aircraft Hair
arts.text: 1 minute: your hair becomes a Helicopter (fly and hover) or a Jet (Technique Key 1: fly fast and ram for 2d8)

other.name: Mega-Drill
other.text: one drill made enormous: an 80-ft line of piercing ruin toward the cursor, through walls, 6d10 to everything on it

passives.name: Hair Spray
passives.text: Your hair reaches 5 ft farther and hits like a cursed tool.

feats.name: Scorpion Tactics
feats.text: Barbed Defense: once a round, a foe that strikes you in melee is stung back by your hair (1d6 + CE mod) and the barb is left in — poisoned.

feats.name: Mega-Drill
feats.text: The quick key fires one enormous drill: an 80-ft line, 6d10, through walls (4 CE).

feats.name: Air Bomber
feats.text: The aircraft's destructive rites: as a Helicopter, your blades tear everything within 15 ft every 2 s (1 CE, 3d8); as a Jet, your ram hits twice as hard.

domain.name: Silken Strand Execution Ground
domain.sureHit: a law, not an event — there is no pulse: inside, every foe takes 2d10 for every 5 ft it moves, as hairs too fine to see cut into it

techniques.name: Heart Catch
techniques.summary: A paired set of projected hands that extend unarmed combat, restraint, cover, and compelled attention.

arts.name: Heart Grasp
arts.text: a hand closes on the foe at your cursor within its reach: held for a round (a strength check — the hand has the better grip)

quick.name: Hands of Love
quick.text: two hands for 10 minutes, never more than 15 ft from you (30 ft from 3rd): they strike what's near you, 1d6 (+ CE mod from 3rd) · summoning again replaces the pair

maximum.name: Maximum: Love at First Sight
maximum.text: a foe within a hand's reach is charmed at first sight — no blow needed (a resolve check)

passives.name: Handy
passives.text: The hands are tougher, hit harder, and reach 30 ft from you.

passives.name: Hand Shield
passives.text: Once per round, a hand throws itself between you and a blow: it lands at a quarter.

passives.name: Cutie Honey
passives.text: Technique Key 1 (5 CE): the next blow a hand lands charms its foe for a minute (a resolve check) — it forgets the fight.

feats.name: Thunderous Applause
feats.text: Once per round, when both hands can reach the same foe, they clap around it: 1d8 + CE power, it's dazed, and it's thrown 10 ft.

feats.name: Lover's Embrace
feats.text: A foe caught by Heart Grasp is squeezed while it's held: 1d6 + CE power every second.

domain.name: Lover's Grasp
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is held and charmed until the next pulse — no damage

techniques.name: Ice Formation
techniques.summary: Repeatable restraint and cold zones that escalate into mass targeting and a lethal icefall.

arts.name: Ice Creation
arts.text: a 10-ft cone of cold toward the cursor: 1d10 (rising to 6d10 by 20th) and the ice covers them, holding them for 3 s

arts.name: Frost Calm
arts.text: freezing mist on a spot within 60 ft: 7d8 to everything in 30 ft, held by the ice for 3 s, and the ground stays frozen for 10 s (foes on it move at half speed)

arts.name: Ice Fall
arts.text: you drop to the ground for a second, and ice falls on every foe within 30 ft: held by the ice, then the spikes — 1d10 + 6d8 + 6d8

maximum.name: Maximum: Shatter
maximum.text: every foe your ice is holding (within 120 ft) shatters with it: (PB + 4)d10 through defense, and the ice is gone

passives.name: Born of Winter
passives.text: Cold can't touch you: you can't be chilled, frozen or frostburnt.

passives.name: Extreme Cold
passives.text: A foe held in your ice is worn down: it hits 15% softer while it's held.

feats.name: Iceshape
feats.text: Ice Creation also forms a blade of ice in your hand: for 10 minutes your weapon blows deal 1d6 more and frostbite the foe.

feats.name: Permafrost
feats.text: When your ice would let a foe go, its feet stay frozen: every hold lasts a second longer.

feats.name: Frostbite
feats.text: The cold of your ice goes deeper: a held foe hits 30% softer instead of 15%, and takes 1d6 every second it's held.

domain.name: White Abyss
domain.sureHit: winter declared as law: every chosen foe takes 10d8 cold and is held by the ice until the next sure-hit

techniques.name: Idle Transfiguration
techniques.summary: Direct soul damage, permanent alterations, stored transfigured creatures, a split-body clone, and soul fusion.

arts.name: Idle Transfiguration
arts.text: lay a hand on the foe in reach: its soul is reshaped, 1d10 (2d10 at 5th, 3d10 at 9th, 4d10 at 13th, 5d10 at 17th; a toughness check halves it) · a foe this kills becomes a Transfigured Creature in your stock

arts.name: Body Clone
arts.text: a perfect copy of you for a minute: it fights beside you with your touch (1 at a time)

arts.name: Soul Multiplicity
arts.text: fuse two or more Transfigured Creatures (all of your stock, up to 6) — they're destroyed: Body Repel, a 60-ft bolt of 5d8 + 1d8 for each beyond two · or (Technique Key 1) a Polymorphic Soul Isomer that fights for a minute, stronger for each one fused

quick.name: Release Transfigured
quick.text: a Transfigured Creature from your stock fights for you for 10 minutes (up to CE mod at once)

maximum.name: Maximum: Spirit Body of Distorted Killing
maximum.text: 10 minutes: your body becomes its own final work — blows land far lighter, and elbow blades add 1d12 + CE mod to every weapon hit

passives.name: Idle Touch
passives.text: Every weapon blow you land touches the soul: 1d6 more.

feats.name: Remote Transfiguration
feats.text: A soul you've touched stays marked: with no foe in your hand's reach, Idle Transfiguration reshapes the marked foe nearest your cursor from afar (within 60 tiles).

feats.name: Transfiguration Adept
feats.text: Release Transfigured calls two at a time, when your stock holds them.

domain.name: Self-Embodiment of Perfection
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe's soul is touched twice over: twice your Transfiguration's damage

techniques.name: Illusive Mirage
techniques.summary: Curse creatures and make them see illusions — distorted faces, false bodies, false terrain — until the House of Mirrors makes the lie inescapable.

arts.name: Cursed Illusion
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) sees distorted faces: confused, its blows weakened, and you always know where it is · a strong will shakes it off · from 6th, up to CE mod foes near your cursor at once (2 CE each)

arts.name: Phase Fist
arts.text: your next weapon blow strikes beside a false double: a sure critical

arts.name: Illusive Terrain
arts.text: for a minute, the ground for 150 ft around you lies: every foe in it is slowed to a crawl, and the false walls hide you from its aim

quick.name: Blurring
quick.text: for CE mod rounds your body smears on the eye: blows find you far less often

other.name: Maximum: Absolute Perspective
other.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) is fooled in every sense for a minute: blinded, confused and weakened, and each round a harmful illusion bites it for 4d8

feats.name: Funny Faces
feats.text: Comedy as a weapon: a Cursed Illusion is so absurd that a strong will shakes it off far less often (2 CE more).

feats.name: Maximum: Absolute Perspective
feats.text: Gain the Maximum: one foe fooled in every sense for a minute, its illusions biting every round.

domain.name: House of Mirrors
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe falls under an illusion: it turns on the nearest of its own (non-lethal) · Mirror's Spite: a foe that attacks you may strike another instead

techniques.name: Inverse
techniques.summary: Damage above the threshold inverts down, damage below inverts up—a tank that punishes weak hits and shrugs off strong ones.

quick.name: Inversion
quick.text: 1 minute: every blow that reaches you is mirrored around your threshold — a blow bigger than it lands as far below it as it was above (never less than a quarter of it); a smaller blow lands as far above it

maximum.name: Maximum: Antithesis
maximum.text: 1 minute (while Inverse is on): every blow within your threshold sends half of itself back at whoever struck you

passives.name: Extreme Opposites
passives.text: While inverted, big blows land lighter still.

passives.name: Quick Inversion
passives.text: A blow above your threshold switches Inverse on by itself, before it lands (2 CE).

feats.name: Extreme Inverse
feats.text: Full mastery of the extremes: while inverted, a blow above your threshold lands lighter still by your level, and a blow below it costs its striker your level in return.

feats.name: Inverted Field
feats.text: The lent law: Technique Key 1 (6 CE) inverts the world around you for a minute — teammates within 30 ft take 20% less from blows.

domain.name: Inverted Senses
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe has a sense turned inside out: blinded, numbed, lost or sick — each fights badly in its own way

techniques.name: Limitless
techniques.summary: Infinity, Blue, Red, Hollow Purple and Unlimited Void — the Gojo clan's spatial inheritance, famously half a technique without the Six Eyes to run it.

arts.name: Lapse Blue
arts.text: hold to pour CE in (1 to PB): a sphere of Blue rolls 150 ft toward the cursor, a little faster than Purple and through walls, dragging in everything within 5 ft per CE as it passes and crushing what it holds for (CE + 2)d8 every 1.5 s · keep holding a second past full for Maximum Output: it lingers a minute (Focus), travels with you following your cursor within 30 ft of you, and crushes what it holds every 1.5 s (1d8 per CE over each round)

arts.name: Reversal Red
arts.text: hold to pour (2 CE per step, up to PB steps): a red point flies 60 ft; the first foe it meets takes (steps + 4)d8 and is flung 20 ft per step — into a wall, and the distance it didn't get to travel hits it again (1d6 per 10 ft) · over-hold for Maximum Output: twice as far

quick.name: Infinity
quick.text: raise Infinity: 1 CE every round to keep it · each attack that reaches you has a 50% chance never to arrive (60% at L6, 70% at L11; from L15 every non-boss attack is stopped, a boss's 80–95% of the time) — projectiles slow to a stop at its edge · press again to drop it (L14: press again for Automatic Infinity first)

maximum.name: Hollow Purple
maximum.text: press once to draw Blue and Red apart (free; you're slowed), press again within 6 s to let them meet: a slow sphere of imaginary mass rolls 300 ft toward the cursor over about 8 s, through walls, erasing what it passes — 20d12 every half second to everything inside it, ignoring defense; what it catches is dragged along and left exhausted

passives.name: What Infinity can't stop
passives.text: Poison already inside you, curses and other debuffs, and anything already touching you when it rises.

passives.name: The Filter Completes
passives.text: Infinity stops everything that isn't a boss. A boss's attacks are stopped 80% of the time (90% at L18, 95% at L20).

passives.name: Teleport
passives.text: Technique Key 1: Blue's logic applied to yourself — blink toward the cursor, 10 ft per CE (up to PB CE).

passives.name: Delayed Purple
passives.text: Fire Red into your own Maximum Output Blue: it detonates at the Blue for Red's cost plus 10 CE — one blow to everything within 40 ft, three times the most a Hollow Purple hit can roll, ignoring defense.

passives.name: Automatic Infinity
passives.text: Infinity rises on its own the first time you're hit with it down each round (1 CE). Pressing the quick key while it's up spends 6 CE for Automatic: every attack stops, at 1 CE a second.

feats.name: Offensive Infinity
feats.text: The wall that refuses becomes the wall that crushes: while Infinity is up, a foe that presses against it takes PB d6, is thrown back, and if a wall is behind it, it's pinned there for a second (once per round per foe).

feats.name: Spatial Skirmishing
feats.text: Once per round, a melee blow carries Blue (1 CE): it's a critical and the foe is pulled into place, held for half a second. From 6th, every other one carries Red instead — thrown back.

domain.name: Unlimited Void
domain.sureHit: everything at once, with no filter: each chosen foe not touching you takes 12d8 and stands paralyzed, unable to act, until the next sure-hit (a full minute from the opening one; bosses shake it off sooner)

techniques.name: Love Rendezvous
techniques.summary: Five Southern Cross marks impose a route through space and violently attract matching stars after a violation.

arts.name: Southern Cross
arts.text: mark the foe at your cursor (60 ft) with the chosen star (Technique Key 1) — up to CE mod foes per star (twice that from 11th); you always bear Acrux

maximum.name: Maximum: Rendezvous
maximum.text: every star's bearers are hurled together at once, colliding

passives.name: Route
passives.text: A marked foe that closes on you under a different star commits a violation: held for a round, and every bearer of its star is pulled into the strongest of them — each collision hurts by the size of what hits it.

passives.name: Effective Marking
passives.text: Once per round, a weapon hit marks its target with the chosen star for free.

passives.name: Gravity
passives.text: Collisions ignore armor.

passives.name: Universal Force
passives.text: Collisions become pure force.

feats.name: Lodestar
feats.text: You become the brightest star: after every collision, its bearers are dragged toward you.

feats.name: Comet Reactions
feats.text: Once every 10 s, a blow from a marked foe is slipped for 1 CE.

feats.name: Repelling Forces
feats.text: The tide reverses: when stars collide, every other marked foe within 20 ft of the impact is hurled away from it.

feats.name: Collapsing Stars
feats.text: A foe that has borne all four stars collapses at its next collision: 25d4 force, never critical, and its marks are spent.

domain.name: Star Crossed Lovers
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is marked with the chosen star — and the stars come together

techniques.name: Missile Fist
techniques.summary: Giant cursed-energy fists, grappling barrages, and a crushing Maximum, ranged martial volume turned into calamity artillery.

arts.name: Missile Impact
arts.text: a giant fist of cursed energy hurled at the foe nearest your cursor (20 ft; 30 ft from 3rd, farther at 6th, 11th and 18th): 1d8 + CE mod (2d8 at 6th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 18th) and a second fist with it · from 3rd, hold to pour CE in: one more fist per CE (up to CE mod) — Devastating Barrage

arts.name: Unrelenting Fury
arts.text: a 30-ft cone of fists: every foe in it takes 2d8 for each blow you could throw (a resolve check halves it) and is knocked down

maximum.name: Maximum: Brutal Bombardment
maximum.text: a wave of fists on one foe within 50 ft: 6d8 for each blow you could throw, crushed for 4d10 more and knocked down — everything near it (5 ft, +5 ft a fist) takes the wave too

other.name: Armored Missile Fist
other.text: 1 minute with the fists worn as gauntlets: tougher, your melee reaches farther, and your weapon blows add your fist dice (up to three times a second)

passives.name: Devastating Barrage
passives.text: Hold Missile Impact to pour CE: one more fist per CE (up to CE mod). Technique Key 1: grappling fists — they deal no damage but seize the foe (a strength check), and a seized foe struck again is pinned for longer.

feats.name: Exploding Fighting Spirit
feats.text: Passion made shockwave: a landed fist bursts against everything within 5 ft of it (1d8 + CE mod), up to PB times a round.

feats.name: Armored Missile Fist
feats.text: The quick key wears the fists as gauntlets for a minute (2 CE): +4 defense, longer melee reach, and your fist dice on your weapon blows.

feats.name: Titan's Grasp
feats.text: The fist as shield: once a round, a heavy blow on you meets a fist thrown in its way (3 CE) — it's reduced by your fist damage.

domain.name: Unrelenting Ring of Spirit
domain.sureHit: giant fists fall on every chosen foe: 8d8 and knocked down · inside, your fists cost nothing

techniques.name: Moon Dregs
techniques.summary: A lunar jellyfish shikigami carrying escalating poisons, battlefield cover, and a neurotoxin Maximum.

arts.name: Lunar Jellyfish
arts.text: Moon Dregs drifts beside you for 8 hours, stinging what's near: 2d6 (free the first time each long rest, then 5 CE)

maximum.name: Maximum: Neurotoxin
maximum.text: Moon Dregs bursts a cloud of neurotoxin: everything within 30 ft of it takes 6d6 poison and is paralyzed a round (a toughness check halves it, no paralysis)

other.name: Poison Jar
other.text: milk Moon Dregs' venom onto your weapon: your next 3 weapon hits within a minute add 2d6 poison and envenom

passives.name: Noxious Poison
passives.text: Its stings poison and weaken what they touch.

passives.name: Cleansing of Purity
passives.text: Moon Dregs stings three times as hard.

feats.name: Adorable Poison Jar
feats.text: The quick key milks the jellyfish (2 CE): your next 3 weapon hits within a minute add 2d6 poison and envenom the foe.

domain.name: Lunar Tide
domain.sureHit: the water is full of jellyfish: every chosen foe takes 8d6 poison, and a school of tiny jellyfish (CE mod) joins you

techniques.name: Mythical Beast Amber
techniques.summary: An electric martial engine whose once-ever release grows past human limits and ends in irreversible collapse.

arts.name: Lightning Discharge
arts.text: lightning falls on the foe at your cursor (any distance you can see): 2d10 for every charge on it (at least one's worth), all discharged at once

arts.name: Electric Beam
arts.text: Released only: a huge beam of cursed electricity down a 30-ft line, 10d10, and everything it hits is blinded a moment

maximum.name: Maximum: Mythical Beast Amber Release
maximum.text: ONCE IN THIS CHARACTER'S LIFE: your body fills with electric cursed energy for up to five minutes, growing every minute — stronger, faster, lightning can't hurt you, and each minute brings another extra strike · when it ends, the body collapses (badly weakened for a long while) and it can never be used again

passives.name: Electric Energy
passives.text: A weapon hit that lands spends 1 CE for lightning: 1d10 (2d10 at 3rd, 3d10 at 6th, 4d10 at 11th, 5d10 at 14th, 6d10 at 18th), once per round.

passives.name: Lightning Body
passives.text: Electric Energy twice per round, and every lightning blow you deal adds a d10.

passives.name: Lightning Discharge
passives.text: Electric Energy leaves a charge on its foe (up to twice CE mod, a minute).

feats.name: Defensive Surge
feats.text: The storm bites back: a foe that strikes you in melee is paralyzed for a moment (once a round).

feats.name: Imbued Weapon
feats.text: Electric Energy also charges your weapon (up to twice CE mod). Lightning Discharge spends those too, as a line of lightning from you to the target: 1d12 per charge to everything along it.

feats.name: Final Discharge
feats.text: When the Release ends, the body vents what's left: 2d12 lightning per full minute endured (up to 8d12) to every foe within 30 ft.

domain.name: Lightning God's Realm
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe takes three of your charges, with no cap — only you can discharge them

techniques.name: New Shadow Style
techniques.summary: A learned anti-Domain discipline with rapid draw attacks, a reactive sword stance, and a mobile perfected Simple Domain.

arts.name: Batto Sword Draw
arts.text: one draw: you cross up to 25 ft toward the cursor in an instant and your edge tastes every foe along the way (up to your CE modifier) — one weapon blow each, twice your melee weapon plus 1d8, often a critical

arts.name: Evening Moon: Cut / Guard
arts.text: toggle what the Evening Moon does when a foe steps into your Simple Domain (once a second, holding a melee weapon): Cut — 1 CE, a critical blow on each newcomer · Guard — no CE, the blow lands and you gain +20 defense for 2 s

arts.name: Moonlight Veil
arts.text: 1 minute, uses your Focus: your energy lies along the blade — melee hits add your CE modifier (level-scaled) and crit more often

quick.name: Simple Domain
quick.text: draw a 20-ft circle where you stand for 30 s (free PB times a long rest, then 2 CE): shots that cross its line are cut down (one every half second), you take 15% less inside, and a hostile Domain's sure-hit can't find you there · stepping out of it ends it · from 18th: free, unlimited, it moves with you, and pressing again while it's up widens it by 60 ft for 6 s

passives.name: True New Shadow Style
passives.text: The circle is drawn before thought can intervene: Simple Domain is instant, and free a few times a rest.

passives.name: Perfect Shadow Style
passives.text: The circle costs nothing, has no limit, and walks with you.

feats.name: Instantaneous Attack
feats.text: Each circle you draw holds one prepared draw: the first foe to step inside meets a Batto-strength cut, often a critical.

feats.name: First Strike
feats.text: Even without the circle, the Evening Moon waits: after 5 s with no foe near, the first one to come within 20 ft is cut.

techniques.name: Pachinko Fever
techniques.summary: A playable Idle Death Gamble loop: bank expectation, place the bet, ride the event, spin the reels — and when the machine pays, a stretch of immortality.

arts.name: Green Ball
arts.text: a ball within 30 ft: 1d4 + CE mod · in your Domain, a hit raises expectation 10% (Technique Key 1)

arts.name: Red Rod
arts.text: a rod at arm's length: 1d8 + CE mod · in your Domain, a hit raises expectation 25% (Technique Key 2)

arts.name: Gold Doors
arts.text: train doors slam on a foe within 30 ft: 1d12 + CE mod and held · in your Domain, a hit raises expectation 50% (Technique Key 3)

arts.name: Place Bet
arts.text: in your Domain: spend all expectation on a d20 + 1 per 10% — the result picks the event and its jackpot die (Technique Key 4)

quick.name: Great Luck / Fever
quick.text: Great Luck, once a long rest: your next hit is a critical (never a Black Flash) · during a Jackpot (L11): spend a Fever point instead — a critical next hit and your next action ready at once, once a round

maximum.name: Maximum: Love Train
maximum.text: all three at once on a foe within 30 ft: they raise expectation even outside your Domain, and since all three strike the same foe, the bet is placed on the spot

passives.name: The machine
passives.text: After the bet the event runs 2–8 s. Then d20 + the same bonus sets your rerolls: 1–12 three, 13–15 four, 16–17 five, 18–19 ten, 20 Rainbow (an automatic win). Three jackpot dice are rolled and rerolled, keeping matches; three of a kind pays. A miss wipes the expectation.

passives.name: Jackpot
passives.text: The Domain ends and for 4 rounds: CE refills every round, Reverse Cursed Technique heals you every half second (CE mod × 10% of your life each round), and nothing that touches your life can take you below 1. You get a free Domain back.

passives.name: On a Roll
