passives.text: After a Jackpot, every event and multiplier roll is made twice, keeping the better, until the long rest.

passives.name: The Fever
passives.text: During a Jackpot, every death it refuses earns a Fever point (up to PB) — spend them on the quick key.

passives.name: Luckiest Sorcerer Alive
passives.text: The multiplier rolls three times and keeps the best; the Jackpot lasts CE mod minutes; its healing is doubled and also fires when you're hurt.

feats.name: Contagious Luck
feats.text: Great Luck can be dealt to a teammate: use it with them under your cursor (within 30 ft) and their next blow is a critical instead of yours.

domain.name: Idle Death Gamble
domain.sureHit: the floor plays itself: every round a green ball strikes each chosen foe, raising expectation · free once per long rest (then 25 CE) · it stays open until a running event resolves

techniques.name: Pain Killer
techniques.summary: You cannot heal — but you can stop injuries from getting worse: wards that soak blows, ailments shaken off, and a clinic that never closes.

quick.name: Pain Killer
quick.text: for an hour, CE mod + your level of borrowed life takes blows before you do — and every poison, burn and bleed on you stops (from 6th, one other affliction lifts too)

passives.name: Pain Breaker
passives.text: Pain Killer also lifts one affliction (confusion, slowness, darkness, weakness...).

passives.name: Panacea
passives.text: When a blow would drop you, 4 CE keeps you standing at a little life, numbed.

feats.name: Dull Pain
feats.text: Pain dulled before it lands: while numbed, you can't be confused or silenced.

feats.name: Field Poultice
feats.text: Medicine packed to go: Technique Key 1 (2 CE) presses a poultice on the most hurt teammate within 30 ft — for a minute poisons, burns and bleeds can't take hold of them, and blows land 10% lighter.

domain.name: Medical Clinic
domain.sureHit: the clinic never closes: at every pulse you're numbed again, free

techniques.name: Paralyzing Gaze
techniques.summary: Your technique allows you to paralyze others with a mere gaze.

arts.name: Immobilizing Eyes
arts.text: look at the foe nearest your cursor within 60 ft: while you keep it in sight it moves at half speed, hits softer and is easier to hurt — 1 CE every 3 s per foe to keep it · hold first (from 3rd level): sweep up to your CE modifier in foes near the cursor, 1 CE each beyond the first · a foe that resists wounds your eyes

maximum.name: Maximum: Paralyzing Gaze
maximum.text: one foe you can see within 120 ft is paralyzed — frozen even in mid-air — while you hold your Focus and pay 2 CE every 3 s · each time it strains against you, your eyes take double the wound · bosses are held fast instead

passives.name: Your eyes
passives.text: Your eyes have their own life (a third of yours; half from 11th). Each foe that resists the gaze wounds them; they recover slowly. At zero you're blind, and they won't recover until a long rest.

passives.name: Reactive Eye Movement
passives.text: A foe within 60 ft that strikes at you meets your eyes (2 CE, every 3 s): a held foe always misses; another misses if it can't resist. Technique Key 1: Eye Drops — 1 CE, close your eyes for a moment and they recover.

feats.name: Immobilized Limbs
feats.text: The gaze given anatomy: a foe under your eyes has its torso laid bare — its guard drops entirely, not just by half.

domain.name: Chamber of Fractured Reflections
domain.sureHit: mirrors on every side: your gaze can't be broken inside, and three chosen foes are held by it at every sure-hit, no cost to your eyes

techniques.name: Prayer Song
techniques.summary: A cumulative ten-beat dance that elevates the user while steadily dismantling one opponent's tempo.

arts.name: Prayer
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: dance against the foe at your cursor (60 ft). Each round is a beat, and they add up: 1 you're harder to hit · 2 its guard drops · 3 your blows on it add CE mod · 4 you move faster · 5 it fights weaker · from 11th: 6 harder still to hit · 7 your blows strike true more often · 8 your blows on it add 1d8 · 9 they strike true more often still · 10 it can barely act

maximum.name: Maximum: Fortissimo
maximum.text: the dance leaps to its height: Prayer begins (or jumps) straight to its last beat

passives.name: Marcado
passives.text: Once per round, a blow that lands takes 2 CE for one more die (1d8).

passives.name: Caesura
passives.text: Once per round (2 CE), a blow about to land on you is played over — half the time it misses.

feats.name: Soloist
feats.text: From the 4th beat, the teammate nearest you within 60 ft dances too: +6 defense, 20% faster, +10% critical chance.

feats.name: Cadence
feats.text: The conductor's veto: once every 10 s, a blow your partner lands on you is turned into a miss for 4 CE.

feats.name: Grand Chorus
feats.text: The duet becomes a chorus: your partner's penalties fall on every foe within 60 ft.

domain.name: Dance Dance Revolution
domain.sureHit: a law, not an event — there is no pulse: inside, every beat comes twice as fast

techniques.name: Projection Sorcery
techniques.summary: A declared 24-frame route converts strict movement into accelerating speed, impact dice, and frame-stun vulnerability.

arts.name: Projection
arts.text: start the reel (1 CE, then 1 CE every round): faster, and your weapon swings faster (an extra attack) · every second of movement is committed once you set off — reverse inside it or run into a wall and Projection tears · cast again to stop

arts.name: 24 Frame Rule
arts.text: your next weapon hit deals no damage: instead the foe is stuck in one frame (a resolve check), frozen for a round — and the first blow to reach it is a critical that cuts through its armor, then the frame breaks

arts.name: Air Shatter
arts.text: after a straight run of 20 ft or more: the air you displaced shatters along the 30 ft behind you, CE mod d10 force

maximum.name: Maximum: Sakuga
maximum.text: twelve frames drawn at once: you cross up to 60 ft toward the cursor at blinding speed, untouchable, striking everything on the route for 2 × PB d10 — every foe you pass is left stuck in a frame for a round

passives.name: Acceleration
passives.text: Every full second you move on-route while projecting: +25% speed, up to PB stacks (never past +300% in all) — and your weapon blows, Air Shatter and Sakuga hit harder with it (double damage at +300%). Once per round, a weapon hit after a straight run of 10 ft or more adds 1d6 per 10 ft of the run (up to 2 × PB dice). Losing Projection loses both.

passives.name: White Space
passives.text: While projecting, once per round (2 CE): a blow that would land finds you between frames instead — you slip 15 ft away and it misses.

passives.name: Fastest Sorcerer Alive
passives.text: Projection starts with 3 stacks of Acceleration, each paid round adds 2 more, and the cap doubles (2 × PB).

domain.name: Lunar Palace: Womb of Time
domain.sureHit: a jade palace under a moon too close: every chosen foe that has moved or acted since the last pulse takes 8d10 as its cells rebel against the 24-frame rule

techniques.name: Puppet Manipulation
techniques.summary: A modular construct workshop with remote senses, four chassis grades, spell traits, and a Gargantuan mech.

arts.name: Build Puppet
arts.text: build the chosen chassis beside you for 10 minutes (Technique Key 1): Basic (1 CE, 1d8) · from 3rd Lesser (3 CE, 2d8, and while it stands, blows land a little lighter on you) · from 6th Advanced (6 CE, 3d10, and it fires a bolt each round) · from 11th Absolute (10 CE, 5d10, all of it) · up to 1 puppet (2 at 6th, 3 at 11th)

other.name: Maximum: Ultimate Puppet
other.text: two of your puppets are fused into one Ultimate chassis for 10 minutes: both their dice and every trait (it guards you and fires twice a round), half again the size

feats.name: Puppet Armor
feats.text: A blow that would take a quarter of your life or more is caught by your nearest puppet within 20 ft: it breaks, and the blow lands at half.

feats.name: Maximum: Ultimate Puppet
feats.text: Gain the Maximum: fuse two puppets into one Ultimate chassis carrying both their dice and every trait.

domain.name: Puppet Show
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe dances on your strings for one action: it turns on whatever foe is nearest it

techniques.name: Ratio Technique
techniques.summary: A precise critical-hit engine with a terrain collapse and increasingly reliable 7:3 weak-point rolls.

arts.name: Ratio
arts.text: arm the 7:3: your next weapon hit within 3 s rolls a d10 (two from 11th; hold to pour 1 CE more per extra die, up to CE mod) — any 3 or 7 makes it a critical that ignores armor

arts.name: Collapse
arts.text: strike the ground at your cursor (30 ft): it caves in for 30 ft around — everything there takes your blow, 2d8 + CE mod, and wades through rubble for a minute

maximum.name: Maximum: Overtime
maximum.text: 1 minute past the end of the workday: your blows land half again as hard, and Ratio needs no CE

passives.name: Critical Focus
passives.text: You strike true more often, and a critical carries one more die (1d8).

passives.name: Golden Ratio
passives.text: Every weapon hit is a 7:3 critical, without rolling or spending.

feats.name: Measured Guard
feats.text: You read incoming blows too: once a round, a foe's blow on you rolls your Ratio dice for 1 CE — a 3 or 7 finds its weak ratio and halves it.

feats.name: Fatal Ratio
feats.text: A 7:3 critical takes 2 CE more and cuts at a limb: the foe is crippled — slowed and fighting weaker for 5 s.

techniques.name: Regalia
techniques.summary: Your soul sealed as a weapon: a scaling cursed tool, a damage-eating pool of life, and an armory for a Domain.

arts.name: Soul Bound Treasure
arts.text: your Regalia leaves your hand and fights on its own for a minute, 3d8 a blow

quick.name: Regalia
quick.text: your soul takes the shape of the weapon in your hand for CE mod hours: every blow with it lands harder (more at 6th, 11th, 18th), and once per round it can take 1 CE for 1d8 more

passives.name: Divine Protection
passives.text: The Regalia has life of its own (5 × your level): a blow on you can be thrown onto it (1 CE) until that's spent. It mends on a long rest.

feats.name: Regalia Versatility
feats.text: The soul reshaped at will: Technique Key 1 turns the Regalia between weapon and shield — as a shield it lends +10 defense instead of its blows, and Divine Protection takes blows for free.

feats.name: Celestial Raiment
feats.text: Manifesting the Regalia also drapes a heavenly scarf around you while it lasts (3 CE more): +5 defense and 10% less from blows.

feats.name: Technique Release
feats.text: Maximum output: pressing the quick key while the Regalia stands (2 CE) readies a release — your next blow within 10 s is a critical that knocks the foe down, and the Regalia breaks with it.

domain.name: Cursed Soul Armory
domain.sureHit: lesser regalia hang in the air of the armory and strike every chosen foe: 8d10

techniques.name: Retrograde
techniques.summary: Reroll fate a few seconds at a time — time-reversal defense, regression movement, and an inverted-causality Maximum.

arts.name: Regression
arts.text: you're back where you stood about six seconds ago — only your place changes

maximum.name: Maximum: Inverted Causality
maximum.text: 1 minute: effect before cause — every blow that lands on you lands on whoever threw it too, and you take only half of it

passives.name: Reversion
passives.text: Once per round (1 CE), a blow about to land is played over — about half the time it misses.

passives.name: Enhanced Reversion
passives.text: Reversion PB times a round; Technique Key 1: pay 3 CE more each time for three-in-four odds.

feats.name: Maximum: Sword of Retrograde
feats.text: Inverted Causality also strikes the foe at your cursor along its reversed timeline: 6d8, and it's stunned for 2 s (a foe that holds is only held a moment).

techniques.name: Rockstar
techniques.summary: You can amplify sound and launch it as a blast of energy.

arts.name: Sound Blast
arts.text: play a blast of sound toward the cursor (30 ft; 60 ft from 6th): 2d10 (3d10 at 6th, 4d10 at 11th, 6d10 at 18th), shoving the foe back 10 ft · hold for a longer volley: two blasts from 3rd, three from 11th, 1 CE each

arts.name: Sound Wave
arts.text: a wall of sound, a 15-ft cone (30 ft at 11th): Sound Blast damage + PB d10, shoved 20 ft and deafened (reeling for a second) · hold 1 s first (Musical Climax): throw it from a point near the cursor instead, as a 60-ft line

maximum.name: Maximum: Epic Solo
maximum.text: a minute on stage: your hits add 2d10 (hold to pour up to half PB more CE, +2d10 each) · a foe failing against your technique hits softer for a while · any foe within 15 ft of you takes CE mod + PB (level-scaled) every 2 s

passives.name: Emotional Melodies
passives.text: Technique Key 1 changes the vibe (5 CE, a minute, uses Focus). Your Sound Blasts carry it: Happy charms (it stops fighting), Sad pins it down, Angry turns it berserk against its own side. Bosses shrug most of it off.

feats.name: Rock Squad
feats.text: The band gets back together: during your Epic Solo, teammates within 30 ft carry the rhythm — +6 defense, faster, and truer strikes.

domain.name: Hall of Fame
domain.sureHit: the encore nobody asked for: every chosen foe takes your Sound Blast and is deafened for a minute (it hits softer)

techniques.name: Rot
techniques.summary: Rotten Blood, nine Rot Techniques, Decay, Scarlet Rot, Wing King, and the Mind Palace of Corrupted Ego—the Death Paintings' acid-and-decay striker.

arts.name: Blood Line
arts.text: a line of rotten blood at the cursor, 60 ft: 2d8 acid (it costs a little of your life) — three at once as the Wing King, free

arts.name: Decay
arts.text: everything your technique has hurt in the last minute rots for a minute: your Rotten Blood dice every round

maximum.name: Maximum: Wing King
maximum.text: 1 minute: four times as fast, you fly (hold Jump), and every Blood Line is three, free

passives.name: Rotten Blood
passives.text: Poison and acid barely touch you. Hurt, your weapon blows add 1d8 acid once per round (2d8 at 3rd, 3d8 at 6th, 4d8 at 11th).

passives.name: Scarlet Rot
passives.text: Whatever your rot touches is poisoned; poison and acid can't touch you at all.

feats.name: Blood Production
feats.text: Cursed energy spun into blood: Blood Line takes 1 CE instead of your life when you have it.

feats.name: Condensed Decay
feats.text: Your blood clots around their limbs: once a round, a rot hit costs a little life and slows the foe hard for 2 s.

feats.name: Blackened Blood
feats.text: Your rot marks what it touches: while any foe carries it, you sense every hostile around you.

feats.name: Wingbeat
feats.text: As the Wing King, your veined wings beat on their own every 3 s while foes are within 15 ft: they're thrown 10 ft back and knocked down.

domain.name: Mind Palace of Corrupted Ego
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe decays, and the rot bites deeper at every pulse: twice your Rotten Blood dice

techniques.name: Schrift X
techniques.summary: A cursed-seal marksmanship package: phasing shots that pierce cover, guaranteed hits that never move, and marks that turn the next strike critical.

arts.name: Piercing Schrift
arts.text: a seal-shot at the cursor that passes through walls, 90 ft: 2d8 + CE mod — a sure critical on a foe that's standing still · in Multi-Shot (Technique Key 1, 6th), one shot at each of up to CE mod foes near your cursor

arts.name: Intangibility
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: your body phases — blows pass mostly through you (three-quarters less)

quick.name: Critical Mark
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft): your next hit on it is a sure critical

maximum.name: Maximum: Sacrosanct
maximum.text: the phased body at its height: a minute of Intangibility — and through it, every shot of yours is a sure critical

feats.name: Cursed Seal Expert
feats.text: New signatures: your Critical Mark also blinds and cripples the foe for 10 s (a toughness check resists).

techniques.name: Seance
techniques.summary: Physical and Soul Information, the Ritual of Resurrection, Black Seance, and the Seance Parlor—necromancy that channels the dead through your body.

arts.name: Seance
arts.text: channel the freshest body you've killed within 60 ft (30 s): its Physical information (2 CE) — more life, toughness and strength, the bigger it was — or, with Technique Key 1, Both (4 CE): its soul too, one of its traits · 1 CE a round to keep

quick.name: End Seance
quick.text: let the dead go

passives.name: Blessing of the Grateful Dead
passives.text: When the dead arrive, they mend you: your level + PB.

feats.name: Bestial Seance
feats.text: Body and soul, whole: a Both seance gives you every trait the body had, not just one.

feats.name: Cling to Life
feats.text: Out of CE, you hold the spirit in by force: the seance keeps going, and each round takes 5% of your max life instead (it comes back after a long rest).

domain.name: Seance Parlor
domain.sureHit: a parlor, not an event — there is no pulse: inside, the seance costs nothing to keep, and any body you've killed in the last minute answers

techniques.name: Shadow Killer
techniques.summary: Kill without touching — strike through shadows with awareness-gated automatic hits, bind bodies to their own darkness, and darken the sky itself.

arts.name: Shadow Strike
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) is struck through its own shadow: 2d8 + CE mod — a sure critical on a foe that isn't hunting you, or under the dark sun

quick.name: Shadow Bind
quick.text: the foe at your cursor is bound to its shadow for a round — in darkness there's no escape; in light it may tear free

maximum.name: Maximum: Heavenly Star of Darkness
maximum.text: a dark sun hangs over your cursor for a minute (30 ft): every foe under it takes 4d6 each round, can't see, and is always in shadow

passives.name: Void Steps
passives.text: You see in the dark, and in darkness you can't be seen.

passives.name: Shadows of Mortality
passives.text: Shadow Strike costs 1 CE less (free), and is a sure critical on a foe that hasn't been hurt yet.

feats.name: Shadow User
feats.text: The shadow becomes a vehicle: Technique Key 1 (1 CE) sinks you into the darkness at your cursor (60 ft) and you step out of it there.

feats.name: Lingering Bindings
feats.text: The binding no longer needs a hostage: Shadow Bind holds for 10 s instead of a round (2 CE more).

techniques.name: Shrine
techniques.summary: Long-range invisible cuts, adaptive Cleave, Divine Flame, a four-armed perfect form, and Malevolent Shrine.

arts.name: Dismantle
arts.text: a cut flies 150 ft straight toward your cursor, through walls, into the first foe — invisible to everyone but you · tap for 1 CE (1d8), hold to pour up to PB CE (1d8 each) · hold Down as you release: Spiderweb, a 30-ft cone (+1 CE)

arts.name: Dismantle on the Swing
arts.text: toggle · while on, each weapon swing also sends a Dismantle toward your cursor (1 CE, 1d8), once a second — two with Perfect Form

arts.name: Cleave
arts.text: the adaptive cut: hold to pour 1–10 CE, then (PB + CE)d10 to the foe nearest your cursor within 150 ft · it reads the target's structure for a minute: the next Cleave on it ignores defense

arts.name: Divine Flame: Open
arts.text: the one thing you can see coming: hold to pour 1 to 2 × PB CE, release a fire arrow toward the cursor — it bursts 5 ft wide per CE for 1d12 per CE

maximum.name: Maximum: World Cutter
maximum.text: hold the key through the whole chant (1.5 s); let go early and it breaks, free · a cut through space itself, 200 ft toward the cursor through walls: (PB + 10)d10 to everything on the line, ignoring defense

passives.name: Invisible
passives.text: Only you can see a Dismantle in flight; it passes through anything in the way of where you point.

passives.name: Perfect Form
passives.text: +15% attack speed, +5% damage, +20 max life; pouring CE takes half as long; your swings Dismantle twice.

feats.name: Form of Battle
feats.text: Up close, the cut rides your grip: a Cleave on a foe within 10 ft always cuts clean through, as if its structure were already read.

domain.name: Malevolent Shrine
domain.sureHit: the Domain cuts everything inside every round: every foe takes a full Dismantle (PBd8), and the chosen a full Cleave as well ((PB + 10)d10, its mark honored)

techniques.name: Sky Manipulation
techniques.summary: Space bends into reactive armor, reflected attacks, flight, redirected areas, and a Thin Ice Breaker.

arts.name: Sky Armor
arts.text: 1 minute: the sky hardens around you (much tougher) and carries you — you fly (hold Jump)

arts.name: Thin Ice Breaker
arts.text: a 30-ft line of sky shatters like thin ice: CE mod d10 force to everything on it, and fliers are knocked out of the air

other.name: Maximum: Hurricane
other.text: the sky exhales: every foe within 30 ft that can't hold its ground is hurled straight up, high — and comes down hard

passives.name: Sky Shape
passives.text: Once per round (1 CE), a blow about to land on you may glance off bent sky (about a third of the time).

passives.name: Sky Shape Improvement
passives.text: Once per round (6 CE), a shot that would hit you is bent back the way it came, at whoever fired it.

feats.name: Cloak of Invisibility
feats.text: Still water, unseen: under Sky Armor, after 2 s without attacking you turn invisible and foes lose track of you, until you strike.

feats.name: Spatial Tear
feats.text: Thin Ice Breaker tears rather than breaks (2 CE more): the first foe on the line also takes CE mod d10 and is slammed down.

feats.name: Maximum: Hurricane
feats.text: Gain the Maximum: every foe within 30 ft is launched high into the air.

domain.name: Heaven's Gate
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe that can't fly is falling — slammed into the ground below it

techniques.name: Solo Forbidden Area
techniques.summary: A ritual support zone granting sweeping accuracy, extra damage, border control, maximum output, and a hallowed pulse.

arts.name: Forbidden Area
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: a 20-ft zone around where you stand — inside it you strike true more often and blows land lighter on you

arts.name: Bless
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: you carry the Zone's favor with you wherever you go (instead of a zone)

maximum.name: Maximum: Hallowed Pulse
maximum.text: the sanctuary breathes out: you're mended 4d8, and every foe within 30 ft takes 6d8 radiant

passives.name: Arena
passives.text: Inside the Zone your blows add CE mod; a foe that crosses its edge is struck (once per round each).

passives.name: Maximize Output
passives.text: Inside the Zone, your first technique hit each round lands at half again its force.

feats.name: Blessing Relay
feats.text: The sanctuary is shared: teammates inside your Zone (or, while you're Blessed, within 30 ft of you) strike true more often and take less from blows.

feats.name: Blessing of Combat
feats.text: The threshold evicts: once a round, your hit on a foe inside the Zone shoves it 10 ft toward the edge — across it, the Arena bites.

feats.name: Shrine of the Gods
feats.text: The Zone walks: once raised, it moves with you, its edge and its favor travelling where you go.

domain.name: Hallowed Zone
domain.sureHit: a law, not an event — there is no pulse: inside, your Zone is twice as wide

techniques.name: Star Dictator
techniques.summary: Command star shikigami whose orbits trace a pseudo-domain — from a lone orbiting light to an Army of the Dictator under a Divine Mandate.

arts.name: Minor Star Shikigami
arts.text: hold to pour up to PB CE: a minor star shikigami per CE, for 10 minutes, 1d6 each (up to PB at once; 3 × PB from 11th)

arts.name: Major Star Shikigami
arts.text: a major star shikigami for 10 minutes, 4d8 a blow (one at a time; two from 11th)

quick.name: Pseudo-Domain Constitution
quick.text: for a minute your stars orbit the point at your cursor: every round, each foe inside the orbit (20 ft) is cut 1d6 per orbiting star (1d10 from 11th; a nimble foe halves it) · press again to release them

maximum.name: Maximum: Divine Mandate
maximum.text: the Army of the Dictator: your star roster fills at once, and for a minute the orbit cuts twice as deep

feats.name: Constellation Network
feats.text: Your stars become a nervous system: while any are out, you sense every creature around you.

feats.name: Keystone Star
feats.text: Your Major Star holds the center: while it stands, your orbit follows it and doesn't break.

feats.name: Judicial Amputation
feats.text: The mandate grows teeth: a foe that fails badly against your orbit loses a limb — slowed hard and fighting weaker for a minute.

techniques.name: Star Rage
techniques.summary: Virtual mass translates direct CE investment into larger unarmed dice, flat damage, grappling scale, and critical shockwaves.

arts.name: Shooting Star
arts.text: while mass is up: kick the ground's loose stone down a 50-ft line toward the cursor — twice your mass die, to everything on it

quick.name: Virtual Mass Increase
quick.text: hold to pour mass in, a CE a point (up to your CE modifier; ×2 at 6th, ×4 at 11th): for your CE modifier in rounds (twice that from 3rd) your melee blows add the mass die (a step up the ladder per 2 mass, to 2d8) and +1 per mass, and hit far harder — it can't be ended or renewed early

maximum.name: Maximum: Black Hole
maximum.text: hold the key for 2 s to commit (let go early and nothing happens): you become the singularity — every foe within 100 ft that can't hold its ground is destroyed outright; the rest (and bosses) take 40d10 plus a fifth of their life, through all defense, and are dragged 30 ft in · two seconds later, you die

passives.name: Mass Impact
passives.text: A critical melee blow with mass up detonates (a foe that can't take it): 1+ mass knocks it down · 2+ a cone of the same damage tears out behind it · 3+ it's slowed · 4+ it can't move for 2 s. It's also shoved 15 ft.

passives.name: Improved Duration
passives.text: Virtual mass lasts twice as long.

domain.name: Event Horizon
domain.sureHit: everything inside is crushed by mass — every step costs four · each chosen foe is knocked flat and takes 8d8

techniques.name: Starlight Symphony
techniques.summary: Mold shining cursed fog, raise fox shikigami, and become the mist itself — a control package crowned by Heaven and Earth.

arts.name: Cursed Fog
arts.text: hold to pour CE (up to CE mod; twice at 6th, three times at 11th): shining fog 10 ft around you per CE, for a minute, following you — foes inside can't see

arts.name: Kitsune Creation
arts.text: a fox shikigami for a day, 2d6 a bite (up to PB)

arts.name: Living Fog
arts.text: Focus, up to an hour: you become a drifting cloud — you fly slowly, can't be seen, and blows pass mostly through you — but you can't strike

arts.name: Inari
arts.text: the great fox Inari for a minute, 6d8 a blow

maximum.name: Maximum: Fog of Exorcism
maximum.text: the fog detonates down a 60-ft cone: twice CE mod d10 + 6d10 cold (a toughness check halves it)

other.name: Fox Fire
other.text: the fog around you erupts in a vapor explosion: twice CE mod d8 cold to every foe in it, chilled, and the fog is spent

feats.name: Fox in the Mist
feats.text: A fox folds into a mote of your fog: while the fog stands, you can keep one more Kitsune out.

feats.name: Fox Fire
feats.text: Dense enough to detonate: the quick key erupts your fog (3 CE) — twice CE mod d8 cold to every foe inside it.

techniques.name: Straw Doll Technique
techniques.summary: Nail volleys, body-fragment Resonance, planted Hairpins, and direct technique disruption through the target's body.

arts.name: Nail Projectile
arts.text: two nails hammered at the cursor, 60 ft, 1d6 + CE mod each (2 nails) · hold for two more (4 CE more, 2 more nails)

arts.name: Resonance
arts.text: strike the straw doll: the foe bound to it takes 4d8 + CE mod, wherever it is (from 18th it also fights weaker for a long while)

arts.name: Hairpin
arts.text: plant up to PB nails at your cursor (1 CE each beyond the first, a nail each) · Technique Key 1 detonates every planted hairpin: 10 ft, 2d6 per nail (a nimble foe halves it)

arts.name: Improved Resonance
arts.text: the foe at your cursor that's held, stunned or frozen: knocked down, 6d8, and its cursed energy suppressed (it fights weaker) for a minute

other.name: Maximum: Last Nail in the Coffin
other.text: while a foe is bound to the doll: every planted hairpin tears loose, streaks to it wherever it is, and detonates as one — 2d6 per nail, and it's held

passives.name: Nail Pouch
passives.text: 20 nails; one comes back every 3 s.

passives.name: Resonance Link
passives.text: A nail that wounds a foe binds it to your doll for a minute (3 CE, if no link stands).

feats.name: Nail Volley
feats.text: Hold Nail Projectile past its second step and the nails scatter: up to CE mod nails and CE, a cone 10 ft long per nail, 1d4 per nail to everything in it.

feats.name: 1000 Needles
feats.text: Hairpins go in barbed (1 CE more per nail): a foe caught by their detonation is held and takes 1d8 every second for 5 s.

feats.name: Maximum: Last Nail in the Coffin
feats.text: Gain the Maximum: every planted hairpin streaks to the foe bound to your doll and detonates there as one.

domain.name: Grand Effigy Rite
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is nailed: 8d10, and bound to an effigy until the next pulse

techniques.name: Technique Extermination
techniques.summary: Radiant extinguishment suppresses spellcasting, CE, items, barriers, curses, and eventually entire areas through Jacob's Ladder.

arts.name: Extinguishment
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d12 radiant (5d12 from 6th), and its powers go out for a round — it can't fire, and fights weaker (a resolve check)

arts.name: Angel's Blessing
arts.text: 1 minute: wings of light and a halo — you fly (hold Jump) and radiance can't hurt you

maximum.name: Maximum: Jacob's Ladder
maximum.text: a pillar of light at your cursor, 20 ft wide (30 ft from 13th): everything inside takes 8d12 radiant, every hostile shot in it is unmade, and every foe in it is extinguished

passives.name: Improved Extinguishment
passives.text: Extinguishment deals 5d12.

feats.name: Blessed Blow
feats.text: The refusal, delivered by hand: once a round, a weapon hit also puts the foe's powers out for a round (1 CE, a resolve check).

feats.name: Sword of Michael
feats.text: The trumpet narrowed to a blade: cast Jacob's Ladder with your cursor on a foe within 15 ft and 5 CE more, and that foe alone takes 10d12 radiant and is extinguished, no check.

techniques.name: Teleportation
techniques.summary: Mark the world, blink across it, dodge by vanishing, send your enemies where you please, and at the peak swap souls.

arts.name: Teleport
arts.text: you vanish and reappear at your cursor (anywhere on screen, never inside a wall)

arts.name: Mastered Teleport
arts.text: (Technique Key 2) to the chosen mark at any distance — or, with a foe at your cursor (30 ft), it's sent there instead (a strong will may resist)

quick.name: Teleport Mark
quick.text: a mark at your feet to return to (up to twice CE mod; three times from 11th, and free) — the oldest fades when you place too many

maximum.name: Maximum: Soul Swap
maximum.text: you and the foe at your cursor trade places, soul-first: it reels for a round and takes 8d10 as its soul tears loose

passives.name: Improved Teleport
passives.text: Once a round, a blow that would land on you is dodged — you blink out of the way (1 CE).

passives.name: Improved Marking
passives.text: Marks cost nothing, and you can hold three times CE mod.

feats.name: Warded Marks
feats.text: Your marks watch as well as carry: you're told when a foe comes within 10 ft of one, and it's revealed.

techniques.name: Ten Shadows
techniques.summary: One shadow given ten bodies. Begin with the Divine Dogs; tame the rest in trials you must win alone. A fallen shadow does not return — but its strength can pass on.

arts.name: Manifest
arts.text: call the selected shadow (quick key selects) · costs its listed CE

arts.name: Dismiss
arts.text: return every manifested shadow to your shadow

arts.name: Shadow Storage
arts.text: sink your held item into your shadow, or draw the stored one out

arts.name: Taming Trial
arts.text: challenge the selected untamed shadow — defeat it alone to tame it · costs its CE, win or lose

arts.name: Shadow Wearing
arts.text: wear the selected tamed shadow's function for 1 minute (half its cost): its passive gift, and its signature move on Technique Key 2 · it can't be manifested meanwhile

arts.name: Worn Ability
arts.text: while wearing a shadow (Technique Key 2): its move, as yours · Dogs pounce · Totality's Black Fang · Gama's tongue drags a foe to you · Rabbits scatter you away · Nue calls lightning · Serpent erupts under a foe · Deer purifies · Ox charges · Tiger roars · Elephant floods · Mahoraga's blade

arts.name: Wells Unknown Abyss
arts.text: fuse the selected manifested shadow with your other one: the base gains the donor's gift; they share one fate

quick.name: Select Shadow
quick.text: next shadow on the roster bar (Technique Key 4 goes back)

passives.name: Shadow keys
passives.text: Technique Key 1 calls or dismisses the selected shadow · Key 2 uses the worn shadow's move · Key 4 selects the previous shadow. Mark a target with any summon weapon and every shadow goes for it.

passives.name: They fight on their own
passives.text: Every manifested shadow hunts what's near you and uses its signature move whenever it's ready: Dogs pounce · Gama tongues (and swallows the small) · Rabbits scatter when you're hurt · Nue dives and shocks · Serpent erupts under its prey · Deer: Purifying Field when you're hurt · Ox charges · Tiger roars at a crowd · Elephant floods · Mahoraga: Executioner's Blade.

passives.name: Divine Dogs
passives.text: Begin with the paired Dogs tamed (1 CE each, one manifestation).

passives.name: Death is permanent
passives.text: A shadow at 0 HP is gone. If one Dog falls, the survivor can be called as Divine Dog Totality (call it with the survivor out and it melts into Totality). Every shadow mends a little every 3 s, even mid-fight, and steadily once it's out of harm's way; badly hurt, it falls back to your side to mend. Round Deer's aura also mends the shadows around it. (Config: Kinder Shadows returns the fallen after a long rest.)

passives.name: Manifestation capacity
passives.text: Two manifestations at once (one before level 3); three from level 11, four from level 15. The Divine Dogs, all your Gama, and a fusion each count as one. Mahoraga takes two.

passives.name: Wheel Wearing
passives.text: With Mahoraga tamed: Shadow Wearing on Mahoraga (10 CE, once per long rest) — you adapt to whatever keeps hurting you.

feats.name: Shadow Skulker
feats.text: Hold Down on solid ground for half a second to sink into your own shadow (2 CE, then 2 CE a round): unseen and untouchable, you can't attack, and your shadows fight on. Let go of Down to emerge.

domain.name: Chimera Shadow Garden
domain.sureHit: the field becomes living shadow: chosen foes sink (restrained) and take PB d8 each round; inside, +1 manifestation and shadows rise at your cursor

techniques.name: Tool Manipulation
techniques.summary: Imbue cursed energy into tools, fly them as weapons, and turn the battlefield into the Tsukumogami Spirit World.

arts.name: Floating Tool
arts.text: a cursed copy of your weapon flies from your hand and fights on its own for 10 minutes, 2d8 + CE mod a blow (one; two from 6th; 1 CE from 6th)

arts.name: Wind Scythe
arts.text: your tool cuts a 60-ft, 10-ft-wide gale: 3d10, and everything it catches is thrown 20 ft and knocked down (a strength check halves it, no throw)

quick.name: Guided Control
quick.text: hold to pour up to CE mod CE into the weapon you hold, an hour per CE: it strikes truer and 1d6 harder per CE

passives.name: Tool Mastery
passives.text: Your floating tools strike harder, and you're nimbler.

feats.name: Tools of the Craft
feats.text: The imbuement reaches past weapons: while imbued, your pickaxes, hammers and building hands work far faster and reach farther.

feats.name: Eyes in the Skies
feats.text: A floating tool is a watchtower: while one is out, you sense every creature and every danger around you.

domain.name: Tsukumogami Spirit World
domain.sureHit: every tool in the world wakes and turns on the chosen: 6d8 each

techniques.name: Triple Core
techniques.summary: Three biological cores support extra HP, two chosen combat forms, and a week-long sacrificial return from 0 HP.

arts.name: Energy Blast
arts.text: Energy Blast form: hold to pour 1 to PB CE — a blast of force toward the cursor (120 ft), 1d6 per CE

quick.name: Defensive Ward
quick.text: Defensive Form: hold to pour 1 to PB CE — 5 temporary life per CE (life-scaled), stacking on the ward

maximum.name: Core Maximum
maximum.text: depends on the form that's awake · Unblockable: Crippling Strikes, 10 s of free, doubled Unblockable Blows · Energy Blast: Blast Away — the recoil throws you 20 ft toward the cursor and knocks down everything behind your path · Defensive: Fortress — the ward detonates outward, its remaining life as damage to everything within 10 ft

passives.name: First Core
passives.text: Your body keeps a backup: +1% max life per level.

passives.name: Second Core
passives.text: Technique Key 1–3: claim one combat form as a core, then wake it. Unblockable Blows: after a hit, 1 CE (once a second) — it ignores defense and lands 25% harder.

passives.name: Third Core
passives.text: Claim a second form. One burns at a time; switch with its key.

passives.name: Insurance
passives.text: Struck down: a core seals for 7 days and you rise at half life. With both sealed, nothing catches you.

domain.name: Rule of Three
domain.sureHit: a law, not an event: while it stands, all of your unsealed hearts burn at once

techniques.name: Vengeful Spirit Manipulation
techniques.summary: A bound spirit supplies escalating partial strikes, a dangerous full manifestation, copied base techniques, and mutual love.

arts.name: Partial Manifestation
arts.text: the spirit's arm tears out of the air at the foe at your cursor (30 ft): 4d10 (6d10 from 11th)

arts.name: Borrowed Word
arts.text: the spirit speaks a word it once learned — "Don't move": the foe at your cursor is frozen for a round (a resolve check)

maximum.name: Maximum: Full Manifestation
maximum.text: the spirit in full, for five minutes: it fights beside you, 6d10 a blow, and while it's here you're stronger and your cursed energy runs higher

passives.name: The Ring
passives.text: Your weapon is enhanced by the spirit bound to you.

passives.name: Involuntary Manifestation
passives.text: A blow bigger than a quarter of your life may call the spirit out in full on its own (for a minute) to protect you.

passives.name: Stronger Bond
passives.text: While the spirit is manifested, you're stronger and recover CE faster.

feats.name: Partial Manifestation Versatility
feats.text: The arm seizes as well as wounds: a foe it strikes is held a moment and dragged 10 ft toward you (a strength check).

feats.name: Technique Storage
feats.text: Her library opens to you: while the spirit is manifested in full, your arts cost 1 CE less, and Partial Manifestation tears from two arms — the second at the next foe nearest your cursor.

feats.name: Directed Frenzy
feats.text: Her fury can be pointed: the manifested spirit's blows on the foe nearest your cursor land a third harder.

domain.name: True and Mutual Love
domain.sureHit: copied techniques rain on every chosen foe: 8d10

techniques.name: Voracity
techniques.summary: Devour the fallen to steal their abilities, regurgitate them on demand, and at the peak become the devoured thing itself.

arts.name: Devour
arts.text: your maw opens for a round: every foe you kill in it is devoured and its ability stored (up to CE mod kinds; a new one digests the oldest)

quick.name: Regurgitation
quick.text: for an hour you wear the chosen devoured thing's nature — a flyer's wings (flight), a heavy thing's hide (toughness, no knockback), or anything else's fangs (your blows bite harder by its strength)

maximum.name: Maximum: Body of the Devourer
maximum.text: for a minute you become the chosen devoured thing: wings, hide and fangs all at once, and its strength on every blow twice over

passives.name: Digestion
passives.text: Devouring heals you a little and returns 1 CE.

feats.name: Gourmand
feats.text: A second helping: Regurgitation calls up the devoured kind you had before too — both natures at once for the hour.

techniques.name: Bloodlord
techniques.summary: An old vampire's appetite: drink from every blow, store the blood, and spend it on spawn, sorcery and one exsanguinating feast.

arts.name: Blood Lance
arts.text: a lance of blood at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8 · from 11th it drinks up to PB Blood for a d8 more each

arts.name: Vampire Spawn
arts.text: a blood-born spawn for a minute: 3d8 a bite, and each bite heals you a little · spends 3 Blood if you have it (otherwise it lasts only 20 s)

maximum.name: Maximum: Exsanguinate
maximum.text: every foe within 30 ft: 8d10, and 1d10 more for every 2 Blood spent (all of it) — a tough foe halves it · you drink a share

passives.name: Vampiric Thirst
passives.text: Once a round a weapon blow drinks deep (1 CE + 1 Blood): 1d8 more, and you heal the same.

passives.name: Blood
passives.text: Once a round your blows gather a Blood; a death within 30 ft gives another.

passives.name: Ancient Vampire
passives.text: At 10+ Blood you fly, and blows land softer on you.

feats.name: Sanguine Bond
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 Blood) bonds the foe at your cursor (60 ft) for 12 s: each time Vampiric Thirst heals you on another foe, the bonded one takes PB too.

techniques.name: Compleation
techniques.summary: Glistening oil remakes your body piece by piece while infection spreads through everything you touch — all will be one.

arts.name: Oil Lash
arts.text: a whip of glistening oil at the foe at your cursor (30 ft): 2d8, and it's infected

arts.name: Proliferate
arts.text: every infection within 30 ft spreads a step (the foe at your cursor is infected even if it wasn't), and +1 Oil

arts.name: Corrupted Conversion
arts.text: the foe at your cursor turns on its own kind for a round — surely at 3 Infection, otherwise a strong will resists

quick.name: Self-Modify
quick.text: you graft yourself a little further: +1 Oil

maximum.name: Maximum: March of the Machine
maximum.text: at Oil 10: for a minute every blow infects for free, every infection near you spreads each round, and your plating thickens

passives.name: Oil
passives.text: Oil builds as you're hurt (once a round). At 3 your plating hardens; at 6 your blows bite deeper.

passives.name: Infection
passives.text: Once a round a blow infects its target (1 CE, up to 3): it rots for 1d6 per Infection every round, and hits softer.

feats.name: Steel Thane
feats.text: At 3+ Oil, once a round a creature's blow locks your plating rigid: it lands at half, but you're nearly rooted for a moment.

feats.name: Toxic
feats.text: Past Oil 5 you exude a miasma: each round, foes right beside you gain an Infection (a hardy one resists).

feats.name: Viral Drake
feats.text: Proliferate leaps: each infected foe passes the oil to one uninfected foe within 10 ft (a hardy one resists).

techniques.name: Dreadhorde
techniques.summary: Keep the dead as an account: raise zombies from the graveyard, sell the fallen twice, and spend everything on a single Dreadhorde army.

arts.name: Raise Dead
arts.text: a Zombie: from a Corpse card, 10 minutes and 1d8 + PB a blow · with no cards, a feeble one for a minute (up to PB at once; twice PB from 15th)

arts.name: Mass Reanimation
arts.text: up to PB Zombies at once (Corpse cards make them stronger)

quick.name: Dark Bargain
quick.text: sacrifice your nearest undead: 1 CE back — or, below half life, 2d8 life instead · its corpse bursts for 2d8 on foes beside it

maximum.name: Maximum: Rise of the Dreadhorde
maximum.text: every Corpse card: one great Army for a minute, its blow 3d10 for every 3 cards spent (up to 4 times; at least once)

passives.name: Graveyard
passives.text: Every foe you kill adds a Corpse card (up to level/2 + PB).

passives.name: Death's Majesty
passives.text: Your undead hit harder.

passives.name: Death Cannot Hold Me
passives.text: Once per long rest, 4 Corpse cards keep you at 1 life when you'd die.

feats.name: Liliana's Triumph
feats.text: When one of your undead is destroyed or crumbles (not sacrificed), its final moment adds a Corpse card.

techniques.name: Hive Evolution
techniques.summary: A brood of Slivers that share every trait the hive has learned — and a queen who is all of them at once.

arts.name: Sliver Brood
arts.text: two Slivers for a minute (three from 9th; up to twice PB): 1d6 + PB a bite, sharing every hive trait

arts.name: Sliver Queen
arts.text: the Sliver Queen joins the brood for a minute: 3d10 a blow, and she counts as every Sliver

quick.name: Component Mana
quick.text: your nearest Sliver dissolves back into 1 CE, spraying 1d8 on the foes beside it

maximum.name: Maximum: Sliver Legion
maximum.text: for three rounds every trait the hive knows is shared, and five more Slivers hatch

passives.name: Hive Traits
passives.text: Your Slivers share: Venom (1st), Flying (6th), Leech and Double Strike (13th).

feats.name: Necrotic
feats.text: A Sliver that dies (not dissolved) ruptures: the nearest foe beside it takes 1d8.

techniques.name: Mind Sculptor
techniques.summary: Read surface thoughts, fill the field with illusory doubles, send summons home, and mill an enemy's mind until it breaks.

arts.name: Psychic Spike
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8, and its mind is read — its blows on you land softer for a round (a sharp mind isn't read) · +1 Thought when it is

arts.name: Unsummon
arts.text: a lesser foe at your cursor (60 ft; not a great one) is sent away for a minute (a strong will resists)

arts.name: Memory Mill
arts.text: 1 Thought: the foe at your cursor forgets how to use its ranged attacks for a minute (a sharp mind resists)

arts.name: Thoughtseize
arts.text: the foe at your cursor loses its best ideas: it hits far softer for a minute · +1 Thought

quick.name: Illusory Doubles
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: PB illusory doubles — once a round, a blow on you may strike a double instead (it vanishes)

maximum.name: Maximum: Mindbreak
maximum.text: 6 Thought: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) takes 10d10 and is stunned for a round (a sharp mind halves it and keeps its wits)

passives.name: Thought
passives.text: You hold up to PB + 3 Thought, gained whenever a foe's mind fails against you.

passives.name: Mind Palace
passives.text: Your focus is hard to break.

feats.name: Mental Fortress
feats.text: Once a round, a foe whose mind you've read that hurts you gives you 1 Thought.

feats.name: False Memory
feats.text: A mind you've read within the minute resists you only half as well.

techniques.name: Nightmare Weaver
techniques.summary: Plant fear, harvest it, and sculpt it into nightmares shaped like what your enemies dread most.

arts.name: Nightmare Touch
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8, and if its nerve breaks, a Fear Mark (up to 3) — each makes it hit softer

arts.name: Nightmare Shikigami
arts.text: a full nightmare for a minute: 3d8 a blow (one; two from 20th)

quick.name: Dream Token
quick.text: a small nightmare springs up beside the foe at your cursor and hunts for 6 s (1d8 a bite) · if the foe bears a Fear Mark it feeds on one and lasts 20 s

maximum.name: Maximum: Nightmare Incarnate
maximum.text: your fears fuse into one Huge nightmare for a minute: 5d10 a blow

passives.name: Fear Marks
passives.text: A marked foe hits 10% softer per Mark; your nightmares strike it harder.

feats.name: Mill the Mind
feats.text: Once a round, a foe reaching its third Fear Mark has its mind milled: 3d8, and it's stunned for a round.

feats.name: Dream Eater
feats.text: A nightmare biting a foe with 3 Fear Marks devours them all: that bite deals 4d8 more.

techniques.name: Pyromantic Soul
techniques.summary: Ember rises only from self-harm and reckless acts — and the hotter the forge, the more it burns everything, you included.

arts.name: Pyrobolt
arts.text: a bolt of fire (60 ft): 2d8 — a die hotter at 3 Ember, two at 6

arts.name: Ignition
arts.text: you explode: 5d8 to everything within 20 ft — and 1d8 to you (+2 Ember)

arts.name: Elemental Incarnation
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: you become living flame — you fly, fire can't hurt you, and everything near you burns each round

arts.name: Inferno
arts.text: a 30-ft inferno at your cursor (90 ft): 8d10 (a nimble foe halves it) · stand in it yourself for +3 Ember

quick.name: Flame Dash
quick.text: dash 30 ft along your aim, leaving a burning path: 2d8 to everything you pass

maximum.name: Maximum: Incandescent Cataclysm
maximum.text: at Ember 10: the forge empties down a 60-ft cone — 12d12 (a nimble foe halves it) · Ember falls to 0

passives.name: Ember
passives.text: Rises only from reckless acts (taking hits, casting below half life, burning yourself); cools a point every 5 s you play it safe.

passives.name: Regulator Off
passives.text: Taking a hit head-on gives 2 Ember instead of 1.

feats.name: Can't Be Extinguished
feats.text: Once a minute, struck while Ember runs at 5+, you erupt: the attacker takes PB d6 fire and burns, and you gain 1 Ember.

techniques.name: Silver Golem
techniques.summary: A silver body that needs no breath, an unmaking touch, and a workshop of artifacts that wake at your word.

arts.name: Unmaking Touch
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2d8 force as you take it apart

arts.name: Null Rod
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) has its ranged powers suppressed for a minute (a strong presence resists)

arts.name: Creator's Touch
arts.text: 4d10 life to you, and your constructs are renewed

quick.name: Animate Artifact
quick.text: an artifact construct wakes for a minute: 2d8 a blow (one; PB from 11th)

maximum.name: Maximum: Great Creator
maximum.text: twice PB artifacts wake at once for three rounds, past your usual limit

passives.name: Silver Body
passives.text: Tougher skin; poison can't touch you; you need no air.

feats.name: Urza's Legacy
feats.text: Creator's Touch also improves you: for 10 minutes, +6 defense and blows land 5% softer.

techniques.name: Temporal Archmage
techniques.summary: Phase out of blows, delay the enemy, retrace your steps, and finally unhappen a whole round.

arts.name: Chronostrike
arts.text: a mote of stopped time (60 ft): 2d8, and what it hits is slowed

arts.name: Temporal Step
arts.text: 1 Time Counter: you're back where you stood a few seconds ago

arts.name: Temporal Reversal
arts.text: 2 Time Counters: your life returns to what it was a few seconds ago

quick.name: Delay
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) is held a breath out of time (a strong will shrugs it off) · +1 Time Counter

maximum.name: Maximum: Hero's Rewind
maximum.text: 5 Time Counters: the last few seconds unhappen — you return to where you stood with the life you had, and every foe within 60 ft is pulled back to where it was

passives.name: Phase
passives.text: Once a round, a blow on you may find you a moment out of step (2 CE): it misses, and you slip 10 ft aside · +1 Time Counter.

passives.name: Hero of Dominaria
passives.text: You can bank two more Time Counters.

techniques.name: Wildspeaker
techniques.summary: Call the pack, mark the prey, grow primal yourself — and when the forest answers, it answers all at once.

arts.name: Beast Call
arts.text: a beast answers for a minute: 2d8 a bite (one; two from 11th, three from 20th)

arts.name: Primal Might
arts.text: for a minute you're faster, stronger, and your weapon blows bite 1d8 harder

arts.name: Overrun
arts.text: you and the whole pack charge: every beast strikes the nearest foe for 3d8, and you dash 30 ft

quick.name: Hunter's Mark
quick.text: the foe at your cursor becomes your quarry for a minute: your beasts bite it PB harder, and you always know where it is

maximum.name: Maximum: Caller of the Pack
maximum.text: five spectral beasts join the hunt for three rounds, beyond your usual pack: 2d10 a bite

feats.name: Pack Bond
feats.text: Two beasts on one foe combine their attack: each bite deals 1d6 more.

feats.name: Trample
feats.text: A beast that bites at the run throws its foe aside (a strong foe holds).

techniques.name: Worldwaker
techniques.summary: Claim patches of the world as Lands, draw on them, wake them into elementals, and finally make every claim erupt at once.

arts.name: Vine Lash
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8 · on one of your Lands, 3d8 and bound for a round (a strong foe may tear free)

arts.name: Awaken Land
arts.text: the nearest Land (or the ground at your cursor) rises as an elemental for 10 minutes: 2d10 a blow (one; two from 9th)

arts.name: World Shaper
arts.text: a wall of earth rises at your cursor for a minute

quick.name: Claim Land
quick.text: the ground at your cursor (60 ft) becomes your Land for 10 minutes, 20 ft across (up to PB; the oldest returns to the wild)

maximum.name: Maximum: Worldwake
maximum.text: every Land erupts (or, with none, the ground at your cursor): 5d10 to everything within 15 ft of each (a nimble foe halves it)

passives.name: Leyline
passives.text: Standing on one of your Lands, one cast a round costs 1 CE less.

feats.name: Living Terrain
feats.text: Standing on one of your Lands, the ground shelters you: shots land 30% softer.

techniques.name: Carnage
techniques.summary: A red arsenal of blades, shard volleys and tendrils driven by the Kill Chain, ending in the Carnage Storm.

arts.name: Red Weapon
arts.text: Reaper Blade: a red scythe sweep toward the cursor, 1d8 + Chain · from 3rd, Shard Volley (Technique Key 1, 2 CE): three red shards, 60 ft, 2d8 each · from 11th both configurations strike together

arts.name: Autonomous Tendrils
arts.text: 1 minute: tendrils lash anything that comes within 15 ft (once per round), building Chain

arts.name: Carnage Unleashed
arts.text: 1 minute: every configuration at once, tendrils every second, the healing doubled, and a miss never drops the Chain

maximum.name: Maximum: Carnage Storm
maximum.text: you blur through 40 ft around you: everything takes 12d10 and is held — +2 Chain for each one caught

other.name: Red Rain
other.text: symbiote shards at up to two foes within 30 ft: 1d8 each, building Chain

passives.name: Kill Chain
passives.text: Each Red Weapon hit builds 1 Chain (2 on a foe at full health), up to 6 (12 from 15th). A round with no hits drops it to 0.

passives.name: Free Tendrils
passives.text: At Chain 4+, once per round a tendril strikes a foe within 15 ft on its own.

passives.name: Red Feast
passives.text: Once per round, a Red Weapon hit heals you PB.

passives.name: Red Finale
passives.text: At Chain 6+, your next Red Weapon hit spends the whole Chain: 1d10 more per Chain.

feats.name: Red Rain
feats.text: The quick key hurls Red Rain (1 CE): seeking shards at up to two foes within 30 ft, 1d8 each, building Chain.

feats.name: Wall of Teeth
feats.text: Once a round, a creature that hurts you is snared in the symbiote's maw: held for a round (a strong one tears free).

techniques.name: Gamma Rage
techniques.summary: Hulk Out, Thunder Clap, Hulk Leap, regeneration, Gamma Quake, Worldbreaker and the Worldbreaker Smash.

arts.name: Smash
arts.text: a fist toward the cursor: 1d8 (hulked out 1d10, 1d12 at Rage 8 from 13th) + Rage

arts.name: Thunder Clap
arts.text: clap: a 15-ft cone of thunder, 3d10, and everything in it is shoved 15 ft

arts.name: Gamma Quake
arts.text: everything within 30 ft takes 7d10 and is knocked down

arts.name: Worldbreaker
arts.text: at Rage 10: 1 minute — you can't be hurt as easily, every hit lands 2d10 harder, and your Rage can't fall

quick.name: Hulk Out
quick.text: 1 minute: you grow huge and green — your smash hits 1d10, plus your Rage (up to PB), and nothing pushes you around

maximum.name: Maximum: Worldbreaker Smash
maximum.text: at Rage 10: a 60-ft cone of shattered ground, 12d12, everything hurled 60 ft and knocked down · your Rage falls to 5

passives.name: Rage
passives.text: Every blow you take raises Rage by 1 (up to 10). A round without being hurt cools it by 1.

passives.name: Hulk Leap
passives.text: Hulked out, you jump far higher. Land from 30 ft or more and (2 CE) the landing is a 10-ft burst, 3d10.

passives.name: Regeneration
passives.text: At Rage 5 or more you heal PB every round.

passives.name: Rage 8
passives.text: At Rage 8: tougher against blows, and once per round your smash adds 1d10.

passives.name: Strongest One There Is
passives.text: Rage up to 12. Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you puts you into Worldbreaker at 1 life instead.

feats.name: Green Scar
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE + 1 Rage, at Rage 5+): a roar — foes within 15 ft recoil and hit far softer for a round (a strong will holds).

feats.name: Hulk Catch
feats.text: Hulked out, once a round you may catch a shot that would hit you (2 CE): about half the time, it's yours.

techniques.name: Human Torch
techniques.summary: Flame On, jet flight, sculpted fire, plasma bursts, and the Supernova at Heat 10.

arts.name: Fire Bolt
arts.text: while aflame: a bolt of fire, 60 ft, 2d8 (+1 Heat)

arts.name: Fire Sculpting
arts.text: a 15-ft cone or a 60-ft line of flame (Technique Key 1): 4d8 (+1 Heat)

arts.name: Plasma Burst
arts.text: white flame at a point within 90 ft: everything within 20 ft of it takes 6d10 (+2 Heat)

quick.name: Flame On!
quick.text: 1 minute aflame: fire can't hurt you, foes that strike you burn for PB (once per round), and the cast key hurls fire bolts · from 3rd you fly while aflame (hold Jump), leaving a burning trail when you dash

maximum.name: Maximum: Supernova
maximum.text: at Heat 10 only: everything within 40 ft takes 12d10 as you go nova · your Heat drops to 0 and you're exhausted (not at 20th, once per long rest)

passives.name: Heat
passives.text: Every fire technique raises Heat by 1 (Plasma Burst by 2), up to 10. It cools by 1 every few seconds out of combat.

passives.name: Jet Flight
passives.text: While aflame: hold Jump to fly; dashing leaves a burning trail.

passives.name: Living Star
passives.text: While aflame your Heat can't fall below 3, and you fly faster.

feats.name: Hotshot
feats.text: At Heat 5+, Fire Bolt flies as a focused lance: faster, 120 ft, and through everything in its line.

techniques.name: Invisible Force
techniques.summary: Invisibility, force screens, constructs, flight, the Absolute Sphere and the Event Horizon Shell.

arts.name: Force Shapes
arts.text: build at your cursor (60 ft), for a minute: a 10-ft wall of force that stops foes and shots — or a ram (Technique Key 1): 3d10, shoved 15 ft

arts.name: Flight
arts.text: 10 minutes: you fly on a bubble of force (hold Jump to rise)

arts.name: Absolute Sphere
arts.text: enclose the foe at your cursor (60 ft) in a sphere of force: it can't move or act for 3 rounds (a nimble foe may slip it)

quick.name: Invisibility
quick.text: Focus, 10 minutes: light bends around you — foes lose you · attacking shows you only until the next round

maximum.name: Maximum: Event Horizon Shell
maximum.text: a 30-ft sphere around you for a minute: shots from outside can't cross it, foes inside can't leave, and every round it contracts, 5d10 to every foe at its edge

passives.name: Force Screen
passives.text: An Integrity pool of 10 × PB that refills slowly. Once per round (1 CE), a blow that reaches you is caught on a panel: Integrity is spent to stop it.

passives.name: Unseen Architect
passives.text: Integrity pool doubles; the first Force Screen each round costs no CE.

feats.name: Hard-Light Step
feats.text: While you hold Integrity, hard-light footholds catch you: no fall damage, no knockback, and holding Up while falling lets you walk down the air (draining Integrity).

techniques.name: Iron Sorcery
techniques.summary: Doom armor and gauntlet, arcane bolts, counterspells, Doombots, armor modules, the Time Platform and Castle Doom.

arts.name: Gauntlet
arts.text: the armor's integrated gauntlet: a blast of force, 60 ft, 2d8

arts.name: Arcane Bolt
arts.text: a seeking bolt of sorcery at a foe within 60 ft: 2d10

arts.name: Doombot
arts.text: a Doombot decoy for 1 minute: it draws foes and fires its own gauntlet, 2d8 (one at a time; two at 20th)

maximum.name: Maximum: Power Cosmic Theft
maximum.text: 1 minute: the next great blow against you (a tenth of your life or more) is caught and stolen — you take none of it, and it's fired back along a 60-ft beam at twice the force

passives.name: Doom Armor
passives.text: Always worn: much tougher, and sealed against the environment.

passives.name: Counterspell Scheme
passives.text: Once per round (2 CE): a projectile that would hit you is unmade before it lands.

passives.name: Latverian Arsenal
passives.text: Two armor modules (Technique Keys 1 and 2): Flight (hold Jump), Force Shield (once per round a blow is reduced by a third), Tractor Beam and Micro-Missiles (fired with Technique Key 3, 2 CE: a pull to you, or four seeking 1d8 missiles), Mystic Sensor (foes and dangers shown).

passives.name: Time Platform
passives.text: Technique Key 4 (6 CE, once per long rest): you go back six seconds — where you stood and the life you had.

feats.name: Hidden Doombot
feats.text: Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you while a Doombot is out felled the Doombot instead: you were standing where it stood, at a third of your life.

domain.name: Castle Doom
domain.sureHit: each pulse the castle runs one Scheme in turn: a 6d10 gauntlet blast on every chosen foe · binding them until the next pulse · clearing every hostile shot from the air

techniques.name: Kinetic Imbuement
techniques.summary: Convert the potential energy of inorganic matter into a deliberate kinetic release: loaded cards, a bound conduit, laced charges, and Fifty-Two Pickup.

arts.name: Loaded Toss
arts.text: hold to load a card (each step 1 Charge, 1 CE each after the first, up to PB): thrown, it detonates on what it hits — 2 Kinetic Dice per Charge (d6; d8 at 11th, d10 at 18th), 5 ft of blast per Charge

arts.name: Cardsharp Barrage
arts.text: a fan of PB cards, 1 Charge each, thrown as one motion

arts.name: Lace Charge
arts.text: plant a 2-Charge object at your cursor (30 ft; up to PB at once) · Technique Key 1 detonates every laced Charge at once — a blast reaching another Charge sets it off too (Chain Reaction)

quick.name: Bound Conduit
quick.text: charge your weapon as a reusable conduit: once per round a weapon hit discharges for 2 Kinetic Dice in a 5-ft blast (1 CE each) · press again to let it go

maximum.name: Maximum: Fifty-Two Pickup
maximum.text: the whole deck at once: a storm of charged cards falls across a 60-ft zone at your cursor, each one a 4-Kinetic-Dice blast

passives.name: Vector Discharge
passives.text: Double-tap a direction (1 CE): a small blast at your heels throws you 15 ft that way (20 ft per Charge at 11th).

passives.name: Kinetic Footwork
passives.text: Faster on your feet.

feats.name: Kinetic Catch
feats.text: Once a round, a shot about to hit you may be met by a flicked, charged card (2 CE): about half the time it's knocked out of the air.

feats.name: Royal Flush
feats.text: Four cards of one Cardsharp Barrage on the same foe stun it for a round (a hardy one shrugs it off).

domain.name: House of the Loaded World
domain.sureHit: everything inside holds Charge: the ground under every chosen foe detonates for 6 Kinetic Dice

techniques.name: Magnetic Manipulation
techniques.summary: Polarize, Attraction and Repulsion, magnetic flight, induction bolts, field deflection, the railgun and Iron Requiem.

arts.name: Attraction / Repulsion
arts.text: every foe within 20 ft of your cursor is pulled toward it — or, with Repulsion, every foe within 20 ft of you is thrown 30 ft away · polarized foes answer from anywhere within 60 ft, and opposite charges that meet slam together for 2d10 each

arts.name: Induction Bolt
arts.text: a bolt of current, 60 ft: 2d10 (a polarized foe takes 1d10 more)

arts.name: Polarity Field
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: a 15-ft field around you — hostile shots that enter it are torn apart, and every foe in it is polarized

arts.name: Railgun
arts.text: a slug driven down a 120-ft line by the field: 6d10 to everything on it

quick.name: Polarize
quick.text: mark the foe at your cursor (60 ft) with a polarity for 1 minute — + and − in turn (up to PB + 2 marks)

maximum.name: Maximum: Iron Requiem
maximum.text: everything within 120 ft takes the mark at once — and is drawn together at your cursor and crushed, 8d10 each

passives.name: Magnetic Flight
passives.text: You fly on the planet's field: hold Jump to rise, and hover at will.

passives.name: Field Deflection
passives.text: Once per round (1 CE): a projectile that would hit you is turned aside — and, for 1 CE more, sent back.

feats.name: Debris Throne
feats.text: While you're airborne, orbiting scrap shields you: +4 defense, and shots land a quarter softer.

domain.name: The Master's Field
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is polarized and seized by the field: 6d10, and dragged 30 ft toward the heart of the Domain

techniques.name: Mister Fantastic
techniques.summary: A rubber body with 15-ft reach, wraps and holds, reshaped limbs, Colossus Coil and the Infinite Coil.

arts.name: Elastic Strike
arts.text: your fist stretches 15 ft toward the cursor: 1d8 + CE mod (mallet fists 2d8; whip-limbs reach 30 ft and the foe can't react for a moment)

arts.name: Wrap & Hold
arts.text: wrap a foe within reach: held fast (a strength check), and you gain 1 Stretch

arts.name: Colossus Coil
arts.text: coil around up to four foes within reach (six at 20th): held, and each takes 3d8 every round it stays held

maximum.name: Maximum: Infinite Coil
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: your body unfurls into a 60-ft web of bands around a point within 60 ft — foes in it are held each round (a strength check) and squeezed for 3d8

passives.name: Rubber Body
passives.text: Blows from foes land softer, and your weapon reaches farther.

passives.name: Kinetic Soak
passives.text: A blow that lands on you is reduced by PB more, and feeds 1 Stretch (once per round).

passives.name: Malleable Arsenal
passives.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE, 1 minute): mallet fists, whip-limbs, or a parachute (no fall damage, a slow glide).

passives.name: Soak & Rebound
passives.text: The damage a blow did to you is added to your next Elastic Strike (up to your level).

feats.name: Elastic Rebound
feats.text: Once a round, a shot that hits you meets a stretched catching membrane (2 CE): it lands much softer.

techniques.name: Symbiote
techniques.summary: A living suit: tendrils, ablative weave, predatory morphologies, camouflage, recovery and the King in Black's echo.

arts.name: Web & Tendril
arts.text: a tendril lashes out 30 ft (60 ft from 11th) to the foe at your cursor: a light foe is dragged 15 ft to you, a heavy one drags you to it

arts.name: Adaptive Camouflage
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: the suit takes the color of everything behind it — while you hold still you can't be seen; attacking breaks it for a moment

arts.name: Symbiotic Recovery
arts.text: the suit knits you back together: heal 4d10 + CE mod

arts.name: King in Black Echo
arts.text: 1 minute: wing-like tendrils (hold Jump to fly), tougher against blows, and PB fragments of the symbiote fight as one swarm, each lunge 4d10

quick.name: Living Suit
quick.text: the symbiote covers you: tougher, you cling to walls, and once per round a weapon hit can take 1 CE for 1d8 more · Ablative Weave: once per round a blow that lands is reduced by PB + CE mod · press again to pull it back

maximum.name: Maximum: We Are Venom
maximum.text: 3 rounds: every morphology at once, an extra tendril lash at the nearest foe each second, and the Ablative Weave doubled · afterwards you're exhausted

passives.name: Predatory Morphology
passives.text: Technique Key 1 (suit on): Claws (weapon hits harder), Blade Tendrils (longer reach), Rampart (much tougher), Bulk (heavier blows, can't be knocked back).

passives.name: Perfect Bond
passives.text: The suit makes you faster and tougher still, and the Ablative Weave reduces twice your PB + CE mod.

feats.name: Spider-Sense Echo
feats.text: In the suit, the symbiote watches your back: a third of the blows from behind you are slipped.

feats.name: Living Parachute
feats.text: In the suit you never take fall damage, and holding Up while falling snaps out web-wings to glide.

techniques.name: The Thing
techniques.summary: Bedrock body, ripped-up arsenal, bull rush, groundbreak stomp, Living Avalanche and Clobberin' Time.

arts.name: Stone Fist
arts.text: a fist of living stone toward the cursor: 1d8 + CE mod

arts.name: Ripped-Up Arsenal
arts.text: tear up the terrain and hurl it 60 ft: 2d8 + CE mod where it lands

arts.name: Groundbreak Stomp
arts.text: the ground within 20 ft breaks into rubble: every foe in it is knocked down (no damage)

arts.name: Shake It Off
arts.text: slough off holds, poisons and slows like loose sediment

arts.name: Living Avalanche
arts.text: 1 minute: Bedrock doubles, nothing can move you, and anything that strikes you takes PB back

maximum.name: Maximum: Clobberin' Time
maximum.text: 1 minute: Bedrock doubles, foes within 30 ft can't take their eyes off you, and every foe that strikes you is slammed back for 4d8 + CE mod and knocked down

passives.name: Bedrock Body
passives.text: Every blow that reaches you is reduced by PB, and you can't be knocked back.

passives.name: Bull Rush
passives.text: Double-tap a direction (1 CE): charge 20 ft through foes — each takes 2d8 + CE mod and is knocked down.

feats.name: Dead Stick Landing
feats.text: Falls never hurt you, and a hard landing discharges into everything within 10 ft: 2d8.

feats.name: Seismic Sense
feats.text: Standing on the ground, you read the tremors of every creature near you.

feats.name: Yancy Street Rules
feats.text: Ripped-Up Arsenal knocks down what it hits (a strong foe keeps its feet).

techniques.name: Chimeric Night Cry
techniques.summary: Wear one Aspect at a time — Monkey, Tiger, Serpent, Tanuki — and never the same one too long; at the peak, bodies overlap.

arts.name: Night Cry
arts.text: the eerie cry down a 30-ft cone: 2d8, and confusion (a strong will shrugs off the confusion)

quick.name: Shift Aspect
quick.text: become the next Aspect: Monkey (nimble, a third of blows miss you) · Tiger (blows 30% harder) · Serpent (blows poison) · Tanuki (foes lose track of you)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Overlapping Body
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: you wear your current Aspect and the next one at once

feats.name: Tiger's Pounce
feats.text: As the Tiger, once a round a blow landed at a full run bowls the foe over (a strong one keeps its feet).

feats.name: Tanuki Mist
feats.text: As the Tanuki, standing still makes you all but nowhere: foes lose interest far faster.

feats.name: Serpent's Patience
feats.text: As the Serpent, your blows on a poisoned foe deal 1d6 more.

techniques.name: Earth-Spider Loom
techniques.summary: String cursed Anchor Threads between surfaces: movement through the network is taxed and can trigger pulls, restraints and geometric traps.

arts.name: Anchor Thread
arts.text: a thread from you to your cursor (60 ft) for a minute (up to PB): foes that cross it are cut (1d8), slowed, and may be caught fast

quick.name: Draw Taut
quick.text: every thread snaps taut: each foe touching one is yanked to its middle, cut for 2d8, and caught for a moment

feats.name: Tremor Reader
feats.text: Touching one of your threads, you hear through the web: you sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Spider Drop
feats.text: Once a round, a blow landed while dropping onto a foe pins it for a round (a strong one tears free).

feats.name: Eightfold Knot
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): collapse your newest thread and re-string it centered on your cursor.

domain.name: Castle Under Eightfold Silk
domain.sureHit: silk fills the castle: every chosen foe is wrapped fast (held, 3d8)

techniques.name: Gate of the Protective Colossus
techniques.summary: Designate thresholds: hostile crossings generate Vigilance that lets the guardian intercept and, at last, account for every crossing.

arts.name: Raise Threshold
arts.text: a gate stands at your cursor (60 ft) for a minute (up to PB): every foe that crosses it takes 2d8, is slowed, and adds Vigilance

quick.name: Intercept
quick.text: spend all Vigilance: you're beside the foe at your cursor (60 ft) in an instant, guarded for a round, and you strike it for 1d8 per Vigilance spent

maximum.name: Maximum: Gate No Enemy Crosses Uncounted
maximum.text: four great gates rise around you for a minute: crossing one costs a foe 6d8 and a long moment held

feats.name: Palace Watch
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 Vigilance): move your newest Threshold to your cursor (60 ft).

domain.name: Gate No Enemy Crosses Uncounted
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is counted at the gate: 4d8, held a moment, and a Vigilance for you

techniques.name: Grave-Mound Tenacity
techniques.summary: Choose a Grave Anchor. Trespassers, and those who flee your reach, feed Restlessness that fuels resistance and retaliation.

arts.name: Barrow Strike
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 2d8, and a d8 more for every 2 Restlessness you spend (all of it)

quick.name: Grave Anchor
quick.text: your Anchor rises where you stand: 30 ft of guarded ground — on it you're far tougher, and every trespasser feeds Restlessness

passives.name: Restlessness
passives.text: A foe entering your guarded ground, or slipping out of your reach, gives Restlessness (up to 10). Each point hardens you.

feats.name: Corpse Weight
feats.text: At 5+ Restlessness you're swollen with it: nothing can knock you back.

feats.name: Anchor's Pull
feats.text: A foe slipping out of your reach can be escorted back (1 Restlessness): it's hurled toward your Grave Anchor (a strong foe holds).

domain.name: Barrow That Refuses the Dawn
domain.sureHit: the barrow closes: every chosen foe is held by grave-hands (4d8) and feeds Restlessness

techniques.name: Headless Road
techniques.summary: Manifest a black steed and a detachable spectral Head; closing on your quarry builds Gallop for pursuit strikes and control.

arts.name: Spine Whip
arts.text: a whip of spine lashes the foe at your cursor (30 ft): 2d8, and a d8 more per Gallop spent (all of it)

arts.name: The Severed Head
arts.text: your Head floats beside you for 10 minutes, glaring at the nearest foe: 1d8 each glare

quick.name: Black Steed
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: the headless horse carries you — much faster, and Gallop builds as you close on your quarry

feats.name: Unbroken Gallop
feats.text: Riding with any Gallop built, nothing can knock you off course.

feats.name: Lantern Eyes
feats.text: While your severed Head floats beside you, its lantern lets you see in the dark and sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Last Name Spoken
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): speak the name of the foe at your cursor (90 ft) — it's dragged down the road toward you and falters for a round (a strong will refuses).

domain.name: The Road With No Turning
domain.sureHit: the road runs only toward you: every chosen foe is dragged toward you and takes 4d8, and you gain Gallop

techniques.name: House of Bats
techniques.summary: Every Echo is a placed sound on the map — a node you can swap to, hear through, and strike from.

arts.name: Shriek
arts.text: a shriek at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8 to everything within 10 ft of it, and an Echo stays there for a minute (up to PB) — bats boil out of it each round (1d8 to foes near it)

quick.name: Echo Swap
quick.text: you're where the Echo nearest your cursor is

feats.name: Roost Walker
feats.text: You cling to walls and ceilings like a roosting bat.

feats.name: Blood Echo
feats.text: While any Echo stands, the House listens for you: you sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Vanishing Wing
feats.text: Once every 10 s, a blow that would land finds only an Echo (1 CE): you swap to one within 30 ft and it misses.

domain.name: House Where Dawn Was Tested
domain.sureHit: the black cave answers every sound: every chosen foe is swarmed (4d8) and blinded, and an Echo forms at it

techniques.name: Hundred-Demon Revel
techniques.summary: Switch visible Oni Masks — red for force, blue for endurance, black for terror — and let the Revel of takedowns power physical dominance.

arts.name: Oni's Club
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 2d10, and a d10 more for every Revel you spend (all of it)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Hundred-Demon Night Parade
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: all three masks at once — force, endurance and terror together

other.name: Dread Laugh
other.text: behind the Black Mask: the foe at your cursor (30 ft) reels away from your laugh and stands cowed for a few seconds (a strong will holds)

passives.name: Masks (Technique Key 1)
passives.text: Red: blows 25% harder · Blue: blows on you 25% softer, mending each round · Black: foes within 20 ft hit softer. Swap once a round, or anytime for 1 Revel.

passives.name: Revel
passives.text: Each kill: +1 Revel (up to 5).

feats.name: Red Horn
feats.text: Behind the Red Mask, once a round a blow landed at a full run bowls the foe over (a strong one keeps its feet).

feats.name: Dread Laugh
feats.text: The quick key laughs behind the Black Mask (1 CE): the foe at your cursor reels away and stands cowed for a few seconds.

techniques.name: Hundred-Handed Arsenal
techniques.summary: A pool of spectral hands, each committed to offense, defense or grappling — and none available for the others until you change your mind.

arts.name: Hundred Hands
arts.text: Offense: every hand strikes the foe at your cursor (30 ft), 1d6 each · Grapple: the hands pin it — held longer the more hands there are (a strong foe holds a while) · Guard: nothing to throw — the hands are busy guarding

maximum.name: Maximum: Three Hundred Stones
maximum.text: every hand hurls boulders at once: three times PB stones rain on your cursor, 2d8 each in a 10-ft burst

other.name: Briarean Barrage
other.text: every hand fuses into one massive fist: one blow on the foe at your cursor (30 ft), 1d8 per hand

passives.name: Commitment (Technique Key 1)
passives.text: Offense · Guard (each hand turns aside 4% of every blow) · Grapple.

feats.name: Catch the Sky
feats.text: In Guard, once a round the hands may snatch a shot out of the air (about a third of the time).

feats.name: Jailor of Titans
feats.text: Grapple pins two foes at once: the one at your cursor and the next nearest within 30 ft.

feats.name: Briarean Barrage
feats.text: The quick key fuses every hand into one massive fist (3 CE): 1d8 per hand on the foe at your cursor.

techniques.name: Man-Eater's Ballistics
techniques.summary: A finite tail magazine: fire specialised quills at range, then close with the lion's maw to reload — volley, feed, disengage.

arts.name: Quill Volley
arts.text: three spines (or what you have) fly at your cursor (90 ft): 2d6 each, and poison

quick.name: Lion's Maw
quick.text: a bite on the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2d10, you heal a little, and 2 Spines regrow

maximum.name: Maximum: The Sky Black With Quills
maximum.text: every spine at once rains on your cursor (at least six, regrown on the spot): 3d6 each in a 20-ft storm

passives.name: Tail Magazine
