passives.text: Spines regrow one every few seconds; the lion's maw reloads faster.

feats.name: Quill Catcher
feats.text: Once a round, a shot that would hit you may be snatched out of the air (about a third of the time) and loaded as a Spine.

feats.name: Scorpion Tail
feats.text: Lion's Maw spends a Spine to bite with venom: 1d6 more, and the foe is envenomed.

feats.name: Hunter's Mouth
feats.text: Lion's Maw on a foe at death's door regrows a third Spine.

techniques.name: Red Lioness Fever
techniques.summary: Consecutive slaughter builds Heat: speed and damage that, at its height, burns the lioness too — escalate or cool.

arts.name: Lioness Pounce
arts.text: you pounce 30 ft onto the foe at your cursor: 2d8, a d8 more per Heat

quick.name: Vent
quick.text: the fever breaks outward: 2d6 fire per Heat to everything within 15 ft, and Heat falls to 0

maximum.name: Maximum: Lady of Slaughter
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: Heat is locked at 5 and its gifts are doubled — but it burns you only half as much

passives.name: Heat
passives.text: Each round you deal damage, Heat +1 (up to 5); a round without, −1. Per Heat: faster, 6% harder blows. At 4+, you burn each round.

feats.name: Lion's Pursuit
feats.text: At Heat 3+, running flat out or dashing leaves a trail of fire behind you.

feats.name: Fever Claw
feats.text: Once a round, a weapon blow delivers the plague by claw (1 CE): the foe is poisoned, set alight and hits softer for a round.

techniques.name: Serpent Against the Dawn
techniques.summary: Track Night Depth: put out light, blind, and press the dark to deepen it — while the sun, if it overcomes you, drives it back.

arts.name: Devouring Dark
arts.text: the dark swallows the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8, a d8 more per Night Depth, and it's blinded (a tough foe sees through it)

quick.name: Eclipse Coil
quick.text: a coil of shadow wraps the foe at your cursor: held for a round and blinded

passives.name: Night Depth
passives.text: 0–3. Deepens when you blind a foe or land a dark blow; pales in daylight or bright light. Each step: your dark hits harder and blows on you land softer.

feats.name: Endless Coil
feats.text: At Night Depth 3, Eclipse Coil strikes from any darkness: it reaches 120 ft.

feats.name: Chaos Before Creation
feats.text: Once per long rest, when your Night Depth would fade to nothing, its dregs erupt: foes within 30 ft take 4d8 and are blinded for a round.

domain.name: Twelve Gates Before Sunrise
domain.sureHit: the night has twelve gates and no dawn: every chosen foe is blinded and takes 4d8, and Night deepens

techniques.name: Seven Terrors of the Cedar Forest
techniques.summary: Manifest one of seven Terror Faces at a time; cedar groves extend your aura, so the forest itself carries the fear you choose.

arts.name: Cedar Grove
arts.text: a grove of cursed cedar at your cursor (60 ft, 20 ft across) for a minute (up to PB): it carries your Terror Face

maximum.name: Maximum: The Cedar Forest Before the Axe
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: all seven faces at once, in your aura and every grove

other.name: Sevenfold Guardian
other.text: for 2 rounds you wear your Terror Face and the next one together: every pulse carries both fears

passives.name: Terror Faces (Technique Key 1)
passives.text: Each round your aura (20 ft) and groves carry your face's fear, and 1d8 with it: Dread · Stillness · Flame · Blindness · Rot · Flight · Silence.

feats.name: Cedar Warden
feats.text: The forest carries your face farther: each Cedar Grove's fear reaches 30 ft.

feats.name: Sevenfold Guardian
feats.text: The quick key splits the visage (2 CE): for 2 rounds you wear your Face and the next one at once.

domain.name: Cedar Forest Before the Axe
domain.sureHit: the whole forest wears your face: every chosen foe suffers its fear and takes 4d8

techniques.name: Skinless Blight
techniques.summary: Create Blight patches that wither and suppress healing — with fresh running water a hard weakness that cuts safe lanes through your territory.

arts.name: Blight Patch
arts.text: a 20-ft patch of blight at your cursor (60 ft) for a minute (up to PB; never on water): foes in it Wither each round — 1d6 per Wither, and their healing is stifled

quick.name: Blight Breath
quick.text: a 20-ft cone of rotten breath: 3d6 and a Wither

passives.name: Binding Weakness: Fresh Water
passives.text: While you stand in water your blight hits at half.

feats.name: Murrain Wind
feats.text: Running flat out or dashing, you breathe blight behind you: foes crossing the trail begin to Wither.

feats.name: Black Tide
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE): move your newest Blight patch to your cursor (60 ft; never onto water).

domain.name: Shore Where Nothing Grows
domain.sureHit: the whole shore is blight: every chosen foe Withers twice and takes 4d6

techniques.name: Stormfather Catastrophe
techniques.summary: Build Cataclysm by changing disasters — fire, lightning, thunder, venom, gale — layering ruin instead of repeating one best attack.

arts.name: Fire Breath
arts.text: a 30-ft cone of fire: 3d6

arts.name: Lightning
arts.text: a bolt from the sky onto the foe at your cursor (90 ft): 3d8, and it leaps to one more

arts.name: Thunderclap
arts.text: thunder around you (20 ft): 2d8, and everything is thrown back

arts.name: Venom
arts.text: a gout of venom at your cursor (60 ft, 15-ft splash): 2d8 and badly poisoned

arts.name: Gale
arts.text: a 60-ft gale down your aim: 3d8, and it hurls everything

maximum.name: Maximum: Siege of Heaven
maximum.text: every disaster at once on your cursor (30 ft): 10d10, burning, poisoned and thrown

passives.name: Cataclysm
passives.text: A different phenomenon from your last builds Cataclysm (up to 5); the same one twice bleeds a point. Each point: a die more on every phenomenon.

feats.name: Tireless Coils
feats.text: Technique Key 1 drives your serpent limbs into the ground for a round: you can't move or be moved, and blows land 30% softer.

feats.name: Polyphonic Horror
feats.text: A foe struck by two different phenomena within a round may break (1 Cataclysm): it stands frozen in horror for a round (a strong will holds).

feats.name: Last Challenge of Olympus
feats.text: When you fall, the storm spends everything left: foes within 15 ft take 2d10 per Cataclysm.

techniques.name: Sun-Eater Wings
techniques.summary: Earn Pinions through sustained flight and by breaking poison and bindings, then spend them on radiant stoops that devour serpents.

arts.name: Radiant Stoop
arts.text: you dive on the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 2d8 radiant, and a d8 more per Pinion spent (all of them)

quick.name: Sun-Eater Wings
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: great golden wings — you fly, and every few seconds aloft earns a Pinion

maximum.name: Maximum: Wings That Eclipse the Serpent
maximum.text: Focus, 1 minute: your wings blot out the sun — poison and bindings can't take you, and every round radiance falls on the foes beneath you (4d8)

passives.name: Pinions
passives.text: Earned by staying aloft and by breaking free of poison, bindings or slowing (each cleansed on the spot).

feats.name: Venom Breaker
feats.text: You tear free of sickness and corrosion too: bleeding, feral bites, ichor and weakness are cleansed for a Pinion each.

feats.name: Solar Plumage
feats.text: Under the daytime sky, poison, webs and slowing can't take hold of you at all.

techniques.name: White Silence
techniques.summary: Failed cold saves and lingering in your Snowfield add Frost: it slows, numbs, and finally Frostbinds.

arts.name: Snow Woman's Breath
arts.text: a 30-ft cone of killing cold: 2d8, and a Frost on everything in it (a tough foe shrugs off the Frost)

quick.name: Snowfield
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: snow falls 20 ft around you (30 from 11th) — every foe in it gathers Frost each round and takes 1d6 cold

passives.name: Frost
passives.text: 1: slowed · 2: hits softer · 3: Frostbound in place for a moment, then back to 1.

feats.name: Footprints Vanish
feats.text: In snow, or inside your Snowfield, the falling snow hides you: foes are slower to notice you.

feats.name: Snowblind
feats.text: A foe reaching 2 Frost is blinded by driven snow for a round (a hardy one blinks it away).

feats.name: First Flurry
feats.text: When a fight begins, the nearest foe within 30 ft already has winter in its lungs: 1 Frost (a hardy one resists).

domain.name: Village Lost Beneath Snow
domain.sureHit: the village is buried: every chosen foe takes 4d8 cold and gains a Frost

techniques.name: Wind Between Heaven and Earth
techniques.summary: Draw directional Wind Roads: you ride the flow, enemies fight against it.

arts.name: Wind Road
arts.text: a road of wind from you toward your cursor (60 ft) for a minute (up to PB): on it you fly swiftly along it; foes on it are swept along and buffeted (1d6, slowed)

quick.name: Gust
quick.text: everything within 15 ft is blown 20 ft away and takes 1d8

feats.name: Cloud Serpent
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE) paves a 30-ft Wind Road ahead along the way you're moving.

feats.name: Tailwind Archer
feats.text: Standing on a Wind Road, your ranged weapon shots ride it: 1d6 more each.

domain.name: City Beneath the Feathered Sky
domain.sureHit: every road runs through the city: every chosen foe is hurled by the wind (4d8) and slowed

techniques.name: Black Flash Chaining
techniques.summary: Not a technique but a rhythm: chain hit into hit until the distortion answers in red, again and again.

arts.name: Step Inside
arts.text: for a minute you fight inside the distortion: your Chain never breaks, and your first critical each round is a sure Black Flash

quick.name: See the Gap
quick.text: for a minute you see the distortions: foes show, and each blow builds the Chain twice

maximum.name: Maximum: Crimson Distortion
maximum.text: for a minute you are the distortion: every critical you land is a Black Flash, and you land more of them

passives.name: The Chain
passives.text: Every blow you land builds the Chain (up to 5); three seconds without one breaks it. Each link sharpens your blows, and a critical has a chance per link to become a Black Flash.

passives.name: The Spark Remembers
passives.text: Your Chain never breaks, and your blows land critically more often.

feats.name: The Gap Wears You
feats.text: Once a round, a creature's blow slips 2.5 microseconds sideways (2 CE): it lands at half, and the attacker takes 2d8.

feats.name: Spark-Sight
feats.text: Once every 2 minutes, a blow that would land was seen coming in the distortion: it misses.

techniques.name: Cavitation
techniques.summary: The smallest warrior hits twice: a cavitation bubble follows every blow, snapped from the fingers or collapsed on a fist that boils the water around it.

arts.name: Carapace
arts.text: a minute of hardened exoskeleton plates: much tougher

arts.name: Snap Shot
arts.text: snap a bubble at your cursor (60 ft): 3d8 thunder (4d8 at 11th), and the crack staggers the foe for a moment

arts.name: Shellbreaker
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 6d10, and its armor cracks for a round

arts.name: Boiling Strike
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 8d10 + 4d10 thunder, and the boiling water burns everything within 10 ft of it for 4d10

arts.name: Solar Snap
arts.text: a 30-ft cone of flash: 8d10 radiant and blinded for a round (a hardy foe takes half and sees)

quick.name: Jet Propulsion
quick.text: a burst of water throws you 30 ft along your aim

maximum.name: Maximum: Supernova
maximum.text: a Boiling Strike on the foe at your cursor and a Solar Snap bursting 30 ft around it at once

passives.name: Cavitation Strike
passives.text: Your weapon blows collapse a bubble (1 CE, once a second): 1d6 more (2d6 at 6th, 3d6 at 11th), and the foe is shoved 10 ft (a strong foe holds).

passives.name: Mantis Eyes
passives.text: You see every creature around you, hidden or not, and darkness doesn't blind you.

feats.name: Sonic Boom
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (4 CE): both claws snap at once — everything within 20 ft takes 4d8 and is knocked flat for a round (a hardy foe halves it and keeps its feet).

techniques.name: Compound
techniques.summary: Every round you survive accrues interest; every strike is a withdrawal — patience billed by the hour, then liquidated all at once.

arts.name: Principal
arts.text: a strike on the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 1d8 + your accrual (2d8 from 6th) — then the accrual is cashed out (kept from 18th)

arts.name: Maturity
arts.text: once every 5 minutes: for a minute, every round counts twice for your accrual

quick.name: Draw It Out
quick.text: you stop fighting and start billing hours: for a round, blows are far likelier to miss you

maximum.name: Maximum: Total Liquidation
maximum.text: a Principal strike that cashes out three times your accrual at once

passives.name: Accrual
passives.text: Every round with a foe near you adds +1 to your accrual (+2 from 6th, up to 40). A quiet spell with no foes around resets it.

passives.name: The Ledger Never Forgets
passives.text: Your accrual survives a Principal strike.

feats.name: Living Off the Interest
feats.text: Once a round, a blow on you is paid down by your accrual (2 CE): it lands that much softer.

feats.name: Compound Fracture
feats.text: At +5 accrual or more, a Principal strike leaves its foe slowed for a round.

techniques.name: Elder Futhark
techniques.summary: Carve the old alphabet in cursed energy: thorn, ice, torch, journey, ward, birch — and at the end, the Norns' own hand.

arts.name: Carve a Rune
arts.text: carve the chosen rune: Kenaz, fire on a foe (1 CE) · Thurisaz, thorns that bleed it (2) · Isa, ice that pins it (2) · Raidho, swift journey for a minute (1) · Algiz, a ward on you (2) · Berkano, birch-healing (2) · Hagalaz, hail in 15 ft (4) · Sowilo, a sun-ray (4) · Tiwaz, Tyr's spear (6) · Wyrd, anything at all (3)

quick.name: Bindrune
quick.text: carve the chosen rune and the next one as a single sign — both their costs, plus 1

domain.name: Wyrd Written Before Birth
domain.sureHit: the Norns carve a rune on every chosen foe: thorn, ice or hail — whatever was always written

techniques.name: Fermentation
techniques.summary: Patience as a weapon: bottle cursed energy, carry it, and let time do the work — a fresh brew is lunch, an ancient one has a blast radius.

arts.name: Throw Bottle
arts.text: hurl the chosen bottle (60 ft): 1d8 Fresh, 2d8 Young, 3d8 Aged with a 10-ft splash, 4d8 Vintage with a 15-ft splash and fumes, 6d8 Ancient with a 20-ft blast and fumes

arts.name: Flash-Age
arts.text: the chosen bottle ages a step at once

quick.name: Brew
quick.text: a fresh bottle of cursed brew (you carry up to PB; twice that from 18th) · it ages every two minutes you carry it

passives.name: Drink (Technique Key 2)
passives.text: Drink the chosen bottle: it heals and cleanses you, more the older it is.

passives.name: The Palate
passives.text: An Aged or older bottle counts a step older.

passives.name: Ageless Cellar
passives.text: You carry twice as many bottles.

feats.name: Mother Culture
feats.text: Your living starter brews one bottle each long rest for free.

techniques.name: Hemline
techniques.summary: The threaded needle: stitch foes to the floor, pull them where you want them, and dress the whole battlefield to your measurements.

arts.name: Needlework
arts.text: a cursed needle (60 ft; 120 from 6th): 1d8 (2d8 from 6th), and what it hits is Threaded for a minute (until you let go, from 18th)

arts.name: Hemming
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) has its shadow sewn to the floor: it can't move for a while (a strong will tears free sooner)

arts.name: Stitch
arts.text: the foe at your cursor is stitched in place for a round (a strong foe may hold) · a threaded foe can't, and is held twice as long

arts.name: The Full Wardrobe
arts.text: once every 5 minutes: every foe within 60 ft is yanked 30 ft toward you and stitched for a round — no holding out

quick.name: Pull
quick.text: the foe at your cursor is yanked 15 ft toward you (a strong foe may hold) · a threaded foe is caught from anywhere in reach, and can't

passives.name: Master Tailor
passives.text: Needlework is free, and threads hold until the foe dies.

feats.name: Quilted Armor
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE) quilts cursed energy into your clothes: +6 defense for a minute.

domain.name: The Final Fitting
domain.sureHit: the garments dress themselves: every chosen foe is Threaded, taken in (slowed), and pricked for 2d8

techniques.name: Hourglass
techniques.summary: The Domain is the technique. Trap the battlefield inside an hourglass whose conditions judge everyone, then settle the Final Accounting.

arts.name: Sandfall
arts.text: a lash of sand at the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 1d8 (2d8 from 6th)

quick.name: Terms
quick.text: name terms on the foe at your cursor (60 ft): the first time in the next round it charges about or strikes you, the sand judges it — 1d8, no escape

passives.name: Sandsense
passives.text: You feel time's grain: you always know how long your effects and a foe's ailments have left.

passives.name: Turn Again
passives.text: When your Domain's sand runs out, if you have 10 CE the glass flips once: the Final Accounting falls twice.

passives.name: The Glass Remembers
passives.text: Your Domain costs 15 CE instead of 20.

feats.name: Against the Grain
feats.text: Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you is unmade: the sand runs backward and you stand at 1 life.

feats.name: Pocket Glass
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (4 CE) traps the foe at your cursor (60 ft) in a personal hourglass for a minute: it's slowed and the sand grinds it each round (a strong will refuses).

domain.name: The Hourglass
domain.sureHit: the glass tests every chosen foe: one that keeps still earns a Grain; one that doesn't is judged for 2d8 · when the sand runs out, the Final Accounting: the foe with the fewest Grains takes 8d10, and you regain 10 CE and 3d8 life

techniques.name: Kinetic Transmission
techniques.summary: Store motion and impact in a ten-gear transmission, then spend it all at once — braking, accelerating, and finally redlining.

arts.name: Engage Transmission
arts.text: for a minute your body is a gearbox, starting at Gear PB: every round, a Gear for moving 15 ft and a Gear for landing a hit (three for both from 3rd), up to 10

quick.name: Impact Shift
quick.text: your next blow dumps every Gear into it: one Drive Die each (1d6; 1d8 from 6th, 1d10 from 11th)

maximum.name: Maximum: Redline
maximum.text: at Gear 10, all ten Gears at once: a 15-ft impact of 10d12 that throws everything it hits 60 ft (a strong foe halves it)

passives.name: Brake Shift
passives.text: A blow that lands on you while engaged spends a Gear to brake it: one Drive Die + CE mod less damage, and no knockback.

passives.name: Perfect Transmission
passives.text: You're stronger and faster while engaged.

feats.name: Flywheel Counter
feats.text: Engaged, once a round a blow on you is spun into the flywheel (2 CE): it lands PB Drive Dice softer and you gain PB Gears.

feats.name: Vector Skip
feats.text: Acceleration Shift skips instead (1 CE more): you blink 40 ft along your aim, and your next blow is an Impact Shift.

domain.name: Open Circuit
domain.sureHit: Compulsory Gear: every chosen foe is forced to Zero Gear — 10d12 and held still until the next pulse (great foes are only slowed)

techniques.name: Last Rites
techniques.summary: Perform the funeral before the death: wash, dress, close the eyes, speak the words — and the body follows the ceremony.

arts.name: Next Rite
arts.text: the next rite on the foe at your cursor (any skipped rite is performed with it): The Dressing — its armor falls away · The Closing of the Eyes (11th) — it's blinded · The Words (18th) — 10d10, and a foe at a quarter of its life or less dies (5 CE more for the Words)

arts.name: The Pall
arts.text: a funeral pall over 20 ft at your cursor for a minute: foes inside are blinded

quick.name: The Washing
quick.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft; 60 from 6th) is Prepared for a minute: every hit on it takes 1 more (1d4 from 6th)

feats.name: Eulogy
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE): the same hands, turned to keeping — the ally at your cursor (30 ft), or you, mends your level in life.

domain.name: The Wake
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe receives its next rite — and those who have had all three hear the Words

techniques.name: Moonphase
techniques.summary: Attuned to the lunar cycle: every blow carries the current moon's rider — silent at New, swift at Half, hungry at Gibbous, crushing at Full.

arts.name: Moonrest
arts.text: at night, bathe in moonlight: regain 2d8

arts.name: Tidecall
arts.text: tidal force surges in 30 ft at your cursor (60 ft): foes are dragged down and slowed (a strong foe holds firm)

arts.name: Phase Eclipse
arts.text: for a minute the moon counts one step fuller (New → Half → Gibbous → Full) · once per long rest

quick.name: Borrowed Light
quick.text: for a minute your blows carry the chosen phase instead of the real one (not Full) · once per long rest

maximum.name: Maximum: Totality
maximum.text: for a minute your blows carry the Full Moon at 3d8 and the New Moon's silence at once · cast again inside it to call down the dark of the moon: 8d10 to every foe within 120 ft (once)

passives.name: Moon-Touched
passives.text: Your weapon blows carry the current phase (1 CE, once a second): New — the foe loses you; Half — a burst of speed; Gibbous — +1d6 and a little life; Full — +1d8 (2d8 from 6th).

passives.name: Lunar Constant
passives.text: The moon is never less than Half for you.

feats.name: The Dark Side
feats.text: Under a New Moon you are the side no one sees: you're hard to see and foes lose interest.

feats.name: Lunacy
feats.text: Once a round, a Full Moon blow (or one in Totality) makes foes within 30 ft strange: they hit far softer for a round (a strong will holds).

techniques.name: Resonance
techniques.summary: Every structure has a resonant frequency — flesh, stone, cursed energy. Tune your foes blow by blow, then break them all at once.

arts.name: Tuning Pulse
arts.text: a ringing pulse at your cursor (60 ft, 10 ft wide): 1d8 thunder, and everything it touches is tuned once more

arts.name: Breaking Point
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) shatters: 2d8 — 4d8 at 3–4 attunement, 6d8 at 5 or more (a tough foe halves it) · its attunement is spent

quick.name: Listen
quick.text: for a minute you hear every frequency within 60 ft: foes and treasures show, and your blows find the thin spots (more criticals)

maximum.name: Maximum: Perfect Pitch
maximum.text: every tuned foe within 120 ft takes 2d10 per attunement; every untuned one 4d10 (a tough foe halves it) · all attunement is spent

passives.name: Attunement
passives.text: Each blow you land tunes the foe (up to 8). At 2 or more its focus slips; at 3 or more its cursed flow jams (it hits softer).

feats.name: Sympathetic Ear
feats.text: You hear cursed energy flow like footsteps: you sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Dissonance
feats.text: Once a round, a creature that hurts you meets a counter-frequency (2 CE): 2d8, and it hits softer for a round (a hardy one shrugs that off).

techniques.name: Seven Seals
techniques.summary: Your bound power is a sealed scroll. Hold the seals and be warded; break them one by one and unleash judgment — irreversibly, until the dawn.

quick.name: Break a Seal
quick.text: break the next seal, irreversibly until a long rest: 1 White Horse — your blows land critically for a minute · 2 Red Horse — war bursts around you, 3d8 (20 ft) · 3 Black Horse — famine: foes within 30 ft hit softer · 4 Pale Horse — 6d8 to the foe at your cursor · 5 The Martyrs — heal 5 per seal broken · 6 The Great Earthquake — 8d8 and a throw, 30 ft

maximum.name: Maximum: The Seventh Trumpet
maximum.text: once per long rest: every foe within 120 ft takes 2d10 + 2d10 per seal broken (a tough foe halves it)

passives.name: The Sealed Scroll
passives.text: Once a round, a weapon blow spends 1 CE for a sealed strike: 1d8 more, and 1d8 more per seal broken. While every seal holds, blows land on you softer.

feats.name: The Sealed Scroll
feats.text: Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you shatters the next seal instead: you stand at 1 life and its judgment falls.

feats.name: Sound It Again
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (once every 2 minutes) sounds your last broken seal's judgment a second time.

techniques.name: Shattered Mirror
techniques.summary: She doesn't dodge or endure — she angles the shards and lets the attacker meet itself. Every blow that gets through is kept, and paid back.

arts.name: Face the Shards
arts.text: raise (or lower) the shards: a hostile shot reaching you is thrown back at its sender (1 CE; once a round, more with level) · melee blows shatter the glass instead

quick.name: Kept Wounds
quick.text: open the ledger of hurts on the foe at your cursor (60 ft): every wound you've kept, paid back at once

passives.name: Look Away
passives.text: Technique Key 1 switches the shards to Drink: the shot vanishes and you mend half of what it would have done.

passives.name: Crueler Reflection
passives.text: A reflection costs 1 CE more and hits twice as hard.

passives.name: Someone Worth Shielding
passives.text: The shards also catch shots aimed at other players within 30 ft.

passives.name: Kept Wounds
passives.text: Every wound you take is written in a ledger (up to a fair share of your life); it fades on a long rest.

feats.name: Angle the Shard
feats.text: A reflected shot flies at the foe nearest your cursor instead of back at its sender.

feats.name: Nursed Grudges
feats.text: Opening the ledger keeps half of it for the next reckoning.

domain.name: Hall of Broken Mirrors
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe meets its own reflection: it takes twice the blow it would deal

techniques.name: Shutter
techniques.summary: Every attack, every position, every instant can be captured — bottled, labeled, shelved, and developed when it hurts them most.

arts.name: Develop
arts.text: replay your oldest captured moment on the foe at your cursor (60 ft; 90 from 6th): the captured blow lands again, on it · two at once from 6th (Contact Sheet)

arts.name: Exposure
arts.text: for a minute your lens sees the truth: hidden foes and treasures show

quick.name: Flash
quick.text: an overexposed moment: everything within 30 ft is blinded for a round (a tough foe shrugs it off)

passives.name: First Exposure
passives.text: A blow that lands on you is captured as a moment (1 CE): its full force, stored to develop later. You hold two (four from 6th).

feats.name: Negative
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE) develops your newest moment as its negative: instead of the blow, you mend half of it.

domain.name: The Darkroom
domain.sureHit: every moment inside is on your contact sheet: each chosen foe is struck by a developed print of its own last blow (4d10), and a moment is captured for you

techniques.name: Siphon
techniques.summary: Rhythm-gated theft: three clean hits steal the foe's cursed energy, which you pour back into your blows — and the arena narrows to two.

arts.name: Siphon Tap
arts.text: spend half your Temporary CE: for a round, every blow you land deals 1d6 more per 2 spent

maximum.name: Maximum: Grand Spoil
maximum.text: every foe within 30 ft is siphoned at once — PB CE torn from each as Temporary CE, and 4d8 for the wound it leaves

passives.name: Siphon
passives.text: Three hits in a row on one foe (letting a few seconds pass breaks the rhythm) steal its cursed energy: PB Temporary CE, held up to twice PB, to pour back out through Siphon Tap.

passives.name: Single Combat
passives.text: The foe you siphon becomes your chosen opponent: your blows on it land 1d6 harder, and it can't flee you.

passives.name: Perfected Rhythm
passives.text: Siphon needs only two hits in a row.

feats.name: Early Trigger
feats.text: Technique Key 1 cuts the rhythm short: with 2 hits in a row on a foe (1 from 6th), you siphon it at once.

domain.name: Amphitheater of the Living Dead
domain.sureHit: the crowd drains every chosen foe: 3d10 each, and you take the tribute as Temporary CE

techniques.name: Superposition
techniques.summary: Split into instances no one can tell apart, collapse into whichever one survived, and at the peak choose what's real for everyone in the box.

arts.name: Collapse
arts.text: you were the echo all along: you're where your newest echo stood, and it's gone

arts.name: The Observer
arts.text: once every 5 minutes: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) collapses into the state you choose — held still for a round and left half-there (it hits softer) for a minute

quick.name: Superpose
quick.text: an echo of you at your cursor (30 ft; two echoes and 60 ft from 6th) for a minute (until collapse from 18th, and free): a blow on you is as likely to have struck an echo — it collapses, and you take nothing

passives.name: The Uncollapsed
passives.text: Superpose is free and lasts until it collapses.

feats.name: Many Eyes
feats.text: While superposed you see through every instance: you sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Uncertain Blade
feats.text: While superposed, your first blow each round is a sure critical: the foe can't tell which strike is real.

domain.name: Schrödinger's Box
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe is both alive and dead until observed — you observe: half are found wounded (8d10), half are found frozen (held for a round)

techniques.name: The Fifty-Two
techniques.summary: Fifty-two cursed cards, a five-card hand: Spades sharpen, Hearts mend, Clubs bludgeon, Diamonds ward — and the House always wins.

arts.name: Play a Card
arts.text: play the chosen card: ♠ your next blow lands harder by its number · ♥ heal by its number (8+ also cures an ailment) · ♣ the foe at your cursor (60 ft) takes its number and may be bound · ♦ a ward that soaks its number · court cards count 11 to 14

maximum.name: Maximum: Royal Flush
maximum.text: play your whole hand at once — every card doubled if all five share a suit · then draw five fresh

other.name: Marked Cards
other.text: once every 2 minutes: the card you've picked becomes the Ace of its suit

passives.name: Draw Step
passives.text: Every round, your hand refills to five.

passives.name: The Court
passives.text: Court cards carry riders: a Jack's Club binds surely; a Queen's Heart heals twice; a King's Diamond also wards against knockback; an Ace's Spade is a sure critical.

feats.name: Card Counter
feats.text: You've memorized the deck: every card you draw is the better of two.

feats.name: Marked Cards
feats.text: The quick key (1 CE, once every 2 minutes) turns the card you've picked into the Ace of its suit.

domain.name: The House Always Wins
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe gambles with the House: lose and take 6d10 and be bound for a round · win and the House rakes 3 CE off the pot for you

techniques.name: The Immortal Game
techniques.summary: Chess with full-scale shikigami: pawns screen and promote, knights leap the line, rooks own the hallway — and a king who castles out of every blow.

arts.name: Set the Board
arts.text: summon the chosen piece within 30 ft for a minute — pawn 1 CE, knight 2, bishop 2, rook 3, queen 6 · you field up to your PB · the queen's arrival lets every piece strike at once

quick.name: The Move
quick.text: the piece nearest your cursor leaps onto the foe there and strikes · once a round (from 6th, 2 CE buys another)

passives.name: Castling
passives.text: Once a round, a blow meant for you is Castled away (2 CE): you and your nearest piece within 60 ft swap places.

passives.name: Check and Promotion
passives.text: Foes within 15 ft of a piece are in check: they take a fifth more from you. A pawn that takes a foe is promoted to the best piece you can field.

feats.name: Endgame Study
feats.text: With two or fewer pieces on the board, every Move strikes PB harder.

domain.name: Checkmate
domain.sureHit: the board captures every chosen foe: 5d10 + CE mod — half again for a foe in check

techniques.name: The Tithe
techniques.summary: Sacrifice is currency: pay in your own blood to strike harder, and make your enemies pay into the plate so you can take the house cut.

arts.name: The Collection Plate
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) pays: weakened and slowed for a round and 1d8 lost (a strong will pays half) · you take the house cut: 1d8 life, or 1 CE if you're whole

arts.name: The Revival
arts.text: the plate passes to every foe within 60 ft at once · once a minute

quick.name: The Offering
quick.text: pay 1d6 of your own life (2d6 from 6th) — it can't be softened — and your next blow lands 1d8 harder (2d8 from 6th)

maximum.name: Maximum: The Grand Tithe
maximum.text: pay 4d6 of your life: then regain all your life, shed every ailment and refill your CE · and for every foe within 120 ft, the congregation strikes one of them for 2d10

techniques.name: Adaptive Hatred
techniques.summary: Survive something once, record what hurt you, and spend limited Adaptation Slots deciding which threats your body is allowed to stop caring about.

arts.name: Hateful Maul
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): two Adaptation Dice (1d6, growing to 1d12), and one more for every Adaptation you've installed

quick.name: Install Adaptation
quick.text: spend 1 Data of the chosen Tag: that kind of harm lands at half · from 11th, spend 2 to install it Hardened (a quarter) · when your slots are full, the oldest is replaced

maximum.name: Maximum: Total Adaptation
maximum.text: for a minute you grow two extra slots, and every Tag you hold Data in installs itself at once

passives.name: Exposure Record
passives.text: Whatever hurts you is recorded (1 CE): +1 Data in its Tag, up to 3.

passives.name: Reactive Morphology
passives.text: Each installed Adaptation also makes you a little faster and tougher.

passives.name: Termination Failure
passives.text: Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 life, mends you, and fills every Tag.

feats.name: Hostile Evolution
feats.text: Once a round, a creature that hurts you with a kind of harm you've adapted to takes 2 Hatred Dice back.

feats.name: Keter Genome
feats.text: Once a round, being hurt by a kind of harm you hold Data for installs that Adaptation on the spot (1 Data).

feats.name: Consume and Rebuild
feats.text: Each long rest adds 1 Data to every Tag.

techniques.name: Blind Spot
techniques.summary: Tax enemy attention to keep you still, then explode through any lapse in line of sight with impossible movement and a punishing strike.

arts.name: Peripheral Failure
arts.text: up to PB foes within 60 ft blink: they stop Observing you for a round (a tough foe keeps its eyes open)

quick.name: Blind Spot Step
quick.text: only while no foe Observes you: teleport 20 ft toward your cursor (60 ft from 11th) — your next blow within a second snaps for 2d10 more

passives.name: Observation
passives.text: Foes within 60 ft that face you with a clear line of sight Observe you; while any do, you can't Step.

passives.name: Blink Reflex
passives.text: The moment the last Observer looks away, your next Step costs nothing.

feats.name: Concrete Idol
feats.text: Perfect stillness absorbs the blow: once a round, a blow on you while you stand motionless lands 1d10 + your level softer.

feats.name: No Peripheral Vision
feats.text: Against a single Observer you can force a micro-blink: about half the time, you Step anyway.

feats.name: Neck-Line Anatomy
feats.text: Once a round, the snap after a Step paralyzes its foe for a round (a tough one shrugs it off).

domain.name: Containment Breach
domain.sureHit: Biological Blink: every chosen foe's eyes close at once — none can Observe you until the next pulse, and your Steps cost nothing

techniques.name: Corrosive Threshold
techniques.summary: Infect surfaces and prey with Corrosion, turn the stains into doors, and drag degraded targets into a private hunting space.

arts.name: Corroding Touch
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2d6 rot and a Corrosion Mark (up to 3, each slowing it)

arts.name: Slough
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft) rots open: 5 per Corrosion Mark (at least one's worth) and a little more (a tough foe holds together) · its marks are spent

arts.name: Rotting World
arts.text: Focus: the foe at your cursor (10 ft) is dragged into your pocket dimension for up to a minute — each Corrosion Mark makes it surer, and at 3 it can't resist — it rots there, and returns broken

quick.name: Threshold Walk
quick.text: sink through the floor and rise at your cursor (30 ft) — or from your stain nearest it, anywhere in reach (120 ft and once a round free from 18th)

passives.name: Stains (Technique Key 1)
passives.text: Stain the surface at your cursor: up to 5 stains, doors for Threshold Walk.

feats.name: Black Mucus
feats.text: Your stains are sticky ground: foes standing near one are slowed (not a great one).

feats.name: Liquefying Grip
feats.text: The third Corrosion Mark seizes its foe: it's held fast for a round (a strong one tears free).

feats.name: Recall Protocol
feats.text: Once every 2 minutes, a blow that drops you below a quarter of your life pulls you (2 CE) through the farthest stain within 120 ft.

domain.name: House Beneath Every Surface
domain.sureHit: Predigestion Tide: every chosen foe gains a Corrosion Mark and is pulled toward the floor — one already at three sinks and is held until the next pulse

techniques.name: Fateweaver
techniques.summary: Webs restrain. The sense warns. The spider emerges. And beneath it all, threads — every creature connected to its own fate, and the weaver pulling them.

arts.name: Webshot
arts.text: a web at your cursor (60 ft): what it hits is bound in webbing for a round (a strong foe tears free sooner)

arts.name: Pull a Thread
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft) is dragged 30 ft toward you along its fate-thread (a strong foe holds)

arts.name: Web Dominion
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: a 30-ft sphere of webbing at your cursor — every foe in it takes 5d10 poison each round (a tough foe halves it) and is slowed

quick.name: The Spider Emerges
quick.text: for a minute limbs burst from you: you strike far faster and your weapon blows bite 2d6 harder — but you can't slip blows, and the spider feeds on you each round (1d6)

passives.name: Spider Physique
passives.text: You jump far higher and never take fall damage. Your weapon blows grip once a round, slowing the foe.

passives.name: Spider-Sense
passives.text: A blow about to land may be slipped by spending CE (1 CE for a fair chance; 2 and better from 6th; 3 and better still from 11th).

passives.name: Wall-Crawling
passives.text: You climb walls.

passives.name: Thread Sense
passives.text: You sense every creature near you.

feats.name: Venom
feats.text: Your webs bite: Webshot also deals 2d6 poison and may poison the foe for 6 s (a hardy one resists).

feats.name: Fate's Glimpse
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (3 CE): touch the thread of the foe at your cursor (60 ft) — for 2 rounds, every attack it makes on you fails.

domain.name: Web of Destiny
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe's fate-thread is pulled taut: it's bound in webbing and drawn toward the heart of the web

techniques.name: Pestilence Doctrine
techniques.summary: Diagnose a target, accumulate Symptoms, cash them into a brutal Cure — then turn the dead into crude Patients.

arts.name: Palliative Harvest
arts.text: every Symptom on the foe at your cursor (30 ft) is consumed: one Diagnosis Die each (1d6, growing to 1d12) · on a healthy foe, one die and its first Symptom

quick.name: The Cure
quick.text: a touch (10 ft) that consumes every Symptom: 2 + Symptoms Diagnosis Dice + CE mod · from 11th, a foe it kills rises as your Patient (up to PB, 10 minutes)

passives.name: Diagnosis
passives.text: Once a round a weapon blow infects its target with a Symptom (1 CE). Every two Symptoms: it heals less and hits softer.

passives.name: Systemic Pestilence
passives.text: Foes hold PB + 2 Symptoms, and the Cure raises Patients.

feats.name: House Call
feats.text: A spectral gloved hand: The Cure reaches 25 ft.

feats.name: Field Surgeon
feats.text: Before 11th, a foe The Cure kills may still rise as your Patient (2 CE more).

feats.name: Humoral Imbalance
feats.text: A foe with 4+ Symptoms is slowed (not a great one).

domain.name: Operating Theater
domain.sureHit: Perfect Diagnosis: every chosen foe gains two Symptoms

techniques.name: Refining Clockworks
techniques.summary: Feed things into a portable cursed clockwork and choose how aggressively it interprets 'refinement' — then decide if one more Very Fine cycle is worth the risk.

arts.name: Rough
arts.text: the clockwork grinds the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2d8, and 1 Scrap (2 if it's ground to nothing)

arts.name: Very Fine
arts.text: 2 Scrap: a far greater refinement for a minute (your weapons hit half again as hard) — but one cycle in four the machine overdoes it, and your weapon is ruined for that minute instead (hits softer)

quick.name: Fine
quick.text: 1 Scrap: your held weapon is refined for a minute — keener (more criticals) and harder-hitting

maximum.name: Maximum: Masterwork Cycle
maximum.text: 3 Scrap: a flawless Very Fine for ten minutes, no risk

passives.name: Scrap
passives.text: Rough yields Scrap (up to PB + CE mod). Each art that spends CE uses 2 Scrap, if you have it, to cost 1 less.

passives.name: 1:1 (Technique Key 1)
passives.text: 1 CE: the item you hold becomes its transmuted counterpart, if it has one.

feats.name: Salvage Intake
feats.text: The machine catches what the battlefield throws away: a foe you drop within 30 ft yields 1 Scrap about half the time.

feats.name: Decoupled Line
feats.text: Intake here, Output there: Rough reaches 30 ft.

feats.name: Restorative Refinement
feats.text: Very Fine on a ruined weapon runs backward: it's restored and refined to Fine for a minute, no risk.

techniques.name: Shamebound Pursuit
techniques.summary: Make seeing your face a terrible commitment: Witnesses become quarry, distance builds Fury, and every obstacle between you becomes part of the attack.

arts.name: Pursuit
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (90 ft) becomes your Quarry: you always know where it is, and every round you close on it builds Fury (up to PB) — faster running, and a Pursuit Die (1d6; growing to 1d12) more per Fury on your blows against it · a Witness starts the hunt with half your Fury already risen

quick.name: Witness
quick.text: you uncover your face: every foe within 60 ft with a clear view of you recoils (it hits softer for 10 s) and becomes a Witness — there is no refusing it

passives.name: Nothing Stops the Pursuit
passives.text: While you pursue, blocks between you and your Quarry crumble as you charge, and nothing knocks you back.

feats.name: Grief-Fueled Momentum
feats.text: Once a round, when your Quarry hurts you, you gain 1 Fury.

feats.name: No Rest Until Silence
feats.text: When your Quarry falls you keep half your Fury for a minute: the next hunt starts with it.

feats.name: Inhuman Acceleration
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE, once a minute): with your Quarry 60+ ft away, you close the gap at once and arrive beside it.

domain.name: Compulsory Recognition
domain.sureHit: every chosen foe becomes a Witness whether it looks or not — and if you have no Quarry, the nearest becomes one, with your Fury already half risen

techniques.name: The Builder
techniques.summary: Animate a small construct that builds replicas of itself from nearby materials — and direct the swarm, carefully.

arts.name: Animate Builder
arts.text: a tiny construct for an hour: 1d6 a slam · each round a Builder on solid ground builds a replica (up to PB; twice PB from 6th)

quick.name: The Foreman
quick.text: four replicas merge into one large brute for the hour: 2d8 + 4 a slam

passives.name: Union Rates
passives.text: Replicas add PB to their slams.

passives.name: Double Shift
passives.text: You can keep twice PB Builders.

feats.name: Scrap Armor
feats.text: While a Builder is beside you, it interposes scrap: +4 defense.

feats.name: Assembly Line
feats.text: Builders replicate twice a round.

feats.name: Demolition Order
feats.text: Technique Key 1: every Builder and brute detonates — 2d6 fire to everything within 10 ft of each (a nimble foe halves it).

techniques.name: The Downward Stair
techniques.summary: Open a stairwell that descends impossibly far. Something knocks from below — use sparingly.

arts.name: Descend
arts.text: a stairwell opens at your feet for 10 minutes (one; two from 18th)

arts.name: The Bottom
arts.text: once per long rest: a foe trapped in your stairwell falls through the bottom — 10d6, and it surfaces far away (a strong will clings on)

quick.name: Go Down
quick.text: go down the nearest stairwell (or come back up): below you can't be seen or harmed, but you can't act

passives.name: The Trap
passives.text: A foe that steps onto an open stairwell falls in: 6d6, and it's stuck climbing out for a while.

feats.name: Down Only
feats.text: Near your own stairwell, nothing can knock you back.

feats.name: Watch Your Step
feats.text: Near your stairwell you move silently: foes are slower to notice you.

feats.name: Emergency Exit
feats.text: You can keep one more stairwell open.

techniques.name: The Possessive Mask
techniques.summary: Wear one body until it rots, tempt another into accepting the mask, and move your will across hosts.

arts.name: Temptation
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft) is tempted by the mask: one that fails gains Temptation (up to 3, for a minute), hitting you softer for each

arts.name: Host Transfer
arts.text: the mask settles on the foe at your cursor (10 ft): for a minute it's your host, turning on its own kind · every Temptation makes it harder to refuse, and at 3 it can't (great foes can't be worn)

quick.name: Sweetened Offer
quick.text: the foe at your cursor lowers its guard and wanders, docile, for a few seconds (any blow wakes it) · a tempted foe can't refuse, and stays docile twice as long (it spends a Temptation)

passives.name: Manifest Mask
passives.text: A porcelain mask: you sense the minds near you.

feats.name: Borrowed Aptitude
feats.text: While you wear a host, you keep the best of its training: you hit 10% harder and gain 4 defense.

feats.name: Never Without a Face
feats.text: Once per long rest, a blow that would kill you while you wear a host is paid by the host instead: it dies, and you stand at a quarter life.

domain.name: Curtain Call
domain.sureHit: the whole house is tempted at once: every chosen foe gains a Temptation

techniques.name: The Tickle Doctrine
techniques.summary: Weaponize joy itself: overcome enemies with euphoria until they cannot fight through the laughter.

arts.name: Tickle
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (30 ft; 60 from 3rd) laughs helplessly for a moment (longer from 11th), then hits softer for a minute · one that resists still giggles for a round

arts.name: Total Euphoria
arts.text: once per long rest: up to PB foes within 30 ft are overcome with laughter

passives.name: Contagious
passives.text: Foes beside your target catch the giggles: they hit softer for a minute.

passives.name: Hideous Laughter
passives.text: The laughter lasts much longer.

feats.name: Hysterics
feats.text: A foe that laughs helplessly may laugh far too hard: unless its will is strong, it takes 2d8 as well.

techniques.name: The Unfinished Score
techniques.summary: Begin the melody for power — and try to stop yourself from finishing it. The composer always pays.

arts.name: The Final Note
arts.text: once per long rest, while performing: the score completes — everything within 60 ft takes 10d10 (a strong will halves it), and you take 4d10 that nothing can soften

quick.name: The First Bars
quick.text: Focus, 1 minute: your technique hits ring with psychic damage (1d6; 2d6 from 3rd, 3d6 from 11th) · press again to stop — unless the music has you

passives.name: Compulsion
passives.text: If you're hurt while performing, the music may hold you: you can't stop until the Focus ends.

passives.name: The Audience
passives.text: When you begin, foes within 30 ft are frightened while you play (they hit softer).

passives.name: The Draw
passives.text: When you begin, foes within 60 ft are drawn toward the music.

feats.name: Perfect Pitch
feats.text: The music takes hold of you half as often.

feats.name: Earworm
feats.text: A foe your ringing technique hits hears the melody for a minute: it hits 10% softer (a strong will tunes it out).

techniques.name: With Many Voices
techniques.summary: Archive perfect voices, breathe away short-term memory, and lure the confused toward false cries in the dark.

arts.name: Amnestic Breath
arts.text: a 15-ft cone of amnestic mist: foes that fail lose a Moment (up to 3) — dazed for a moment, and hitting softer per Moment lost (a tough foe resists)

arts.name: AMN-C227 Saturation
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: a 15-ft aura of mist — foes that stay in it lose a Moment each round

quick.name: Thrown Voice
quick.text: a borrowed cry from your cursor (60 ft) for 5 s: foes that have lost a Moment wander toward it · from 6th, the first to reach it is mauled for 3d8 (1 CE)

passives.name: Troglobitic Senses
passives.text: You see in the dark, sense nearby creatures, and climb walls.

passives.name: Borrowed Distress
passives.text: A foe lured to your voice is mauled when it arrives (1 CE, once a round).

feats.name: Perfect Voiceprint
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE) throws a second voice to your cursor for 5 s: lured foes follow whichever voice is nearer.

feats.name: No New Memories
feats.text: A foe that loses its third Moment forgets it was fighting at all: it stands passive for 3 s (not a great one).

domain.name: Containment Corridors
domain.sureHit: Memory Break: every chosen foe loses a Moment

techniques.name: Black Flame Apostasy
techniques.summary: The godskin hunt: Apostle reach or Noble mass, black flame that burns a round late, and a Sabbath swept across the battlefield.

arts.name: Black Flame Orb
arts.text: an orb of black flame (90 ft): 3d8 and it Kindles what it hits

arts.name: Ritual Circle
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: a 15-ft ring of black flame around where you stand — every foe that crosses its edge is Kindled

quick.name: Godskin Stance
quick.text: for a minute wear a skin — Apostle: faster, longer reach · Noble: tougher, can't be knocked about (Technique Key 1 swaps for free)

maximum.name: Maximum: Godskin Sabbath
maximum.text: you and a phantom of your other skin sweep a 60-ft path along your aim: every foe crossed is knocked down and Twin-Kindled (the flame bursts in it twice) — a nimble foe is only Kindled

passives.name: Kindling
passives.text: Once a round a weapon blow Kindles its target (1 CE): a round later black flame bursts inside it (2d8; 3d8 from 6th, 4d8 from 11th).

passives.name: Swaddling Recovery
passives.text: Once a round, a weapon blow wraps you in a little life.

feats.name: Apostle's Reach
feats.text: In the Apostle's skin, Kindling costs no CE.

feats.name: Shared Vestments
feats.text: While you wear a Godskin Stance, the teammate nearest you within 15 ft shares its passive grace: tougher, faster, truer.

feats.name: Swaddling Cloth
feats.text: Swaddling Recovery may wrap the most hurt teammate within 15 ft instead of you, when they need it more.

techniques.name: Blacklight
techniques.summary: Consume the living for Biomass, reshape it into claws, blades and hammers, and finally release a viral bloom grown from something you ate.

arts.name: Consume
arts.text: a mauling blow on the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 2d8 — and a foe under a fifth of its life (not a great one) is eaten whole: Biomass by its size (5, 10 or 20), and you heal as much

arts.name: Armor
arts.text: 10 Biomass: for a minute your hide becomes a fortress — blows land far softer and you can't be knocked back, but you're slower

quick.name: Take Form
quick.text: reshape your arms into the chosen form: Claws (1d8, climb walls) · Musclemass (1d10, blows throw foes) · Blade (6th: 1d12, longer reach) · Hammerfist (6th: 1d10, a ground slam knocks down everything within 10 ft for 2 CE) · Whipfist (9th: 1d8, long reach, and a hit drags the foe 20 ft toward you for 1 CE) — press again to return to human

maximum.name: Maximum: Viral Cataclysm
maximum.text: spend an eaten elite (a great foe you've consumed or helped bring down): a 50-ft viral bloom — every foe in it is infected for a minute, rotting each round and spreading it when it dies (a tough foe resists)

passives.name: Biomass
passives.text: You hold up to 5 × level Biomass. Below half life, it mends you a little every second.

feats.name: Parkour Predator
feats.text: You climb without hands in any shape: you cling to walls, leap higher, and falls don't hurt you.

feats.name: Adaptive Biomass
feats.text: Once every 10 s, a creature's blow teaches you (1 CE + 5 Biomass): the next blow from its kind misses, and feeds you 5 Biomass and life.

techniques.name: Conduit Mimic
techniques.summary: Touch a power and it's yours — smoke, neon, video, concrete — each with its own shot, movement and finisher, until they erupt together.

arts.name: Mode Shot
arts.text: your Mode's shot (90 ft): Smoke — 2d8 fire that sets it burning · Neon — 2d8 that's often a critical · Video — 2d8 and confusion · Concrete — 2d10 and a shove

arts.name: Karmic Finisher
arts.text: once per Mode per long rest, at your cursor: Smoke — Orbital Drop (30 ft, 8d10, knocked down) · Neon — Overcharge (20 ft, 8d10, blinded) · Video — Angelic Storm (20 ft, 8d10, confused) · Concrete — Fortress (20 ft, 8d10, bound)

quick.name: Mode Movement
quick.text: Smoke — dash through foes as smoke · Neon — run as light (much faster) for a round · Video — fly on wings for a round · Concrete — harden: blows land far softer for a round

maximum.name: Maximum: Conduit Symphony
maximum.text: all four erupt together: everything within 40 ft takes 12d8 and is blinded or bound (a nimble foe halves it and keeps its feet)

passives.name: Sources
passives.text: Switching Mode needs its source nearby.

passives.name: Source Cache
passives.text: Each Mode stores one charge: switch to it anywhere once, refilled the next time you touch its source.

feats.name: Smoke & Mirrors
feats.text: Smoke Dash leaves a thick cloud where you stood: foes within 10 ft of it are blinded for a round (a hardy one coughs it off).

feats.name: Neon Runner
feats.text: Running as neon, you pass through foes as light: each one you run through takes 2d8 (a nimble foe halves it), once per run.

feats.name: Digital Angel
feats.text: Taking Video flight with 2 CE to spare hard-lights the wings into blades: everything within 15 ft takes 3d8.

feats.name: Concrete Skin
feats.text: Once a round, a blow that lands is petrified shut (1 CE): it lands 1d10 + your level softer.

techniques.name: Dark Moon Covenant
techniques.summary: Shards of cold moonlight, moon-brands that unravel a foe, a familiar that devours them — and an age of stars beyond causality.

arts.name: Lunar Bolt
arts.text: a shard of cold moonlight (60 ft, growing to 300 ft): 2d8 (3d8 from 11th, 4d8 from 18th) and a Lunar Sigil on what it hits — each sigil makes the foe hit softer and take more from your bolts

arts.name: Ashen Familiar
arts.text: a spectral wolf for an hour, 2d8 a bite (two from 11th)

arts.name: Freezing Mist
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: a 20-ft cloud at your cursor — every foe that lingers in it is branded and chilled each round

quick.name: Devour Memory
quick.text: your familiar savages the most-branded foe near it (10 ft): 1d6, + 4 for every sigil it detonates

passives.name: Cold Moon Guard
passives.text: Once a round, a blow on you is turned aside by moonlight (2 CE): far less of it lands.

passives.name: Snow Witch's Step
passives.text: Ice and snow don't slow you.

feats.name: Sigil Shatter
feats.text: Technique Key 1 breaks every Lunar Sigil on the foe at your cursor: 5 cold per sigil, and the cold sinks into its limbs.

feats.name: Occult Moon
feats.text: When Cold Moon Guard turns a blow aside, a Lunar Bolt answers the nearest foe (1 CE).

domain.name: Age of Stars
domain.sureHit: Dark Moon Passage: the moon crosses every chosen foe — a crushing cold blow, two Lunar Sigils, and its borrowed strength stripped away until the next pulse

techniques.name: Destined Death
techniques.summary: The rune of death, unbound: every clean blow brands a Fate Scar, and the scarred find their horizon shrinking until nothing is left of it.

arts.name: Black Blade Wave
arts.text: a black crescent down your aim (40 ft): 2d8, and a Fate Scar on everything it cuts

arts.name: Bestial Sling
arts.text: a 30-ft cone of falling stone: everything in it is scarred and knocked down (a nimble foe dodges it)

arts.name: Black Blade Spiral
arts.text: you whirl along your aim: up to PB foes you pass take 3d8 and a Fate Scar each

arts.name: Black Blade Eclipse
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: every weapon blow brands a Fate Scar for nothing — but healing you receive is halved

maximum.name: Maximum: Thousand Black Blades
maximum.text: every foe within 30 ft is scarred twice and knocked down (a nimble foe takes one scar and keeps its feet)

passives.name: Deathbrand
passives.text: Once a round, a weapon blow brands its target with a Fate Scar (1 CE). Scars last a minute; each makes the foe take more from you (5%; 7.5% from 6th, 10% from 18th). A foe at the cap can't heal.

passives.name: Death in Motion
passives.text: You jump higher.

feats.name: Beast's Agility
feats.text: The beast's stride ignores the floor: you can cling to and climb walls.

feats.name: Rune-Eater
feats.text: The dooms you brand linger: Fate Scars last two minutes instead of one.

feats.name: The Beast Collects
feats.text: When you'd fall, 3 CE harvests every Fate Scar on the most-scarred foe within 60 ft: you stand back up with 10 life per scar (if any).

domain.name: Night of Destined Death
domain.sureHit: Mortality Remembered: every chosen foe gains a Fate Scar and is slowed until the next pulse · one already at the cap can't heal

techniques.name: Dragonheart Incarnation
techniques.summary: Eat the heart, inherit the dragon: claws, scales and lineage breath in installments — until the debt comes due and the human outline goes.

arts.name: Dragonclaw
arts.text: a dragon's claw rakes the foe at your cursor (10 ft; 20 ft as a dragon): 1d8 + CE mod (2d8 as a dragon)

arts.name: Dragon Breath
arts.text: your lineage's breath down a 30-ft cone: 4d8 (5d8 in a 60-ft cone from 6th; a nimble or tough foe halves it) · as a dragon, 8d8 and just 1 CE every couple of rounds

arts.name: Communion Bite
arts.text: a dragon's maw closes on the foe at your cursor (10 ft): 5d8, and it's knocked down (a strong foe keeps its feet)

quick.name: Heartfire Surge
quick.text: for a round your blows burn with your lineage — 1d8 more and its affliction — and you move faster

maximum.name: Maximum: True Dragon
maximum.text: Focus, up to 10 minutes: you become a dragon — you fly, your scales thicken, claws rake twice as hard, and your breath is 8d8 and costs just 1 CE every couple of rounds

passives.name: Gravel Scales
passives.text: Dragon scales harden your skin (tougher at 11th and 18th).

passives.name: Draconic Senses
passives.text: You see in the dark.

feats.name: Winged Predator
feats.text: A melee blow landed while diving down knocks the foe flat (a strong one keeps its feet) and you rebound safely.

techniques.name: Flame of Frenzy
techniques.summary: A self-burning meter of Madness feeds a yellow flame that frightens, kindles and spreads — until the boundary between you and everything melts.

arts.name: Frenzied Burst
arts.text: +1 Madness · a gout of yellow flame (60 ft; 120 from 6th): two Frenzy dice (1d6; 1d8 from 6th) of fire and dread · a foe struck twice is frightened (it hits softer)

arts.name: Unendurable Frenzy
arts.text: +2 Madness · the Lord's apparition breathes: a 40-ft cone of six Frenzy dice, and everything in it is frightened

quick.name: Howl of Frenzy
quick.text: +1 Madness · Focus, 1 minute: your weapon blows burn for a Frenzy die more

passives.name: Madness
passives.text: Frenzy arts add Madness (0–10); it ebbs a point every 20 s you go without. Each point makes your Frenzy 5% stronger. At 7+ blows find you more easily; at 10 the flame takes you — you're confused for a while and fall back to 7.

passives.name: Burn the Pain
passives.text: Fear, confusion and stupor burn away the moment they take you (1 CE, +1 Madness).

passives.name: Kindled Contagion
passives.text: At 3+ Madness, a foe your Frenzy frightens is Kindled: it burns, and when it dies the flame leaps to the foes beside it.

feats.name: Feed the Flame
feats.text: Technique Key 1: take a point of Madness on purpose — your next Frenzy hit adds a Frenzy Die.

feats.name: Shabriri's Cry
feats.text: While Howl of Frenzy runs, once a round the foe at your cursor (30 ft) hears your cry: it freezes in fear for a round and is Frightened.

feats.name: Yellow-Eyed Prophet
feats.text: You sense creatures around you even through walls.

feats.name: Lord Candidate
feats.text: Once a long rest, when the flame would take you, it crowns you instead: you keep your mind and are mended.

domain.name: One Great, No More Distinction
domain.sureHit: Melt the Boundary: every chosen foe takes 4d12 fire and 4d12 dread, and can't be helped by anything until the next pulse

techniques.name: Gravity Sovereignty
techniques.summary: Violet marks that make everything answer to your gravity — pull, push, orbit — until the stars themselves fall on command.

arts.name: Vector Command
arts.text: every foe within 20 ft of your cursor is hurled 30 ft along your vector — toward you (Pull) or along your aim (Push) — and 2d8 as it lands (a strong foe may hold) · marked foes answer from anywhere in range, can't hold, and take 3d8

arts.name: Starcaller Cry
arts.text: a 20-ft sphere at your cursor (60 ft): every foe in it is dragged 30 ft toward its heart and takes 3d8 (a strong foe is only dragged 10 ft)

arts.name: Collapsing Stars
arts.text: PB violet gravity orbs seek foes (90 ft): 2d8 each, and each drags its target 10 ft

quick.name: Gravity Mark
quick.text: the foe at your cursor wears a violet mark for a minute (a strong foe may resist): it's slowed, and it answers your Vector Command from anywhere · once a round a weapon blow marks its target for 1 CE

maximum.name: Maximum: Festival of Falling Stars
maximum.text: for a minute three meteors form in orbit each round (up to nine); Technique Key 2 hurls them all at your cursor — 4d8 each in a 10-ft burst (a nimble foe halves it)

feats.name: Redmane Greatbow
feats.text: You mark the ammunition as you fire it: once a round, a ranged weapon hit on a marked foe pulls it 10 ft toward you.

feats.name: Starcaller's Mark
feats.text: What the cry cannot crush, it claims: a foe that holds against Starcaller Cry is marked for a minute.

feats.name: Lion's Gravity
feats.text: Anchored to your own law: nothing knocks you back, and once a round the foe that struck you is pulled 15 ft toward you.

feats.name: Grand Conjunction
feats.text: Technique Key 2 merges the meteors in orbit into one greater star: 4d8 per meteor in a 15-ft burst.

domain.name: Wailing Firmament
domain.sureHit: Heaven Falls: every chosen foe takes 6d8, is dragged toward the centre, and hangs suspended in the air until the next pulse

techniques.name: Judgement Cut
techniques.summary: An unbroken mind with a katana: Concentration builds with every clean cut, until space itself is severed.

arts.name: Judgement Cut
arts.text: space is cut at your cursor (60 ft): 4d10 in 10 ft (a nimble foe halves it), +1d10 on a marked foe

arts.name: Doppelganger
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: a spectral double repeats your weapon blows and Judgement Cuts for half

arts.name: Devil Trigger
arts.text: for a minute: flight, speed, blows land softer on you, you heal PB each round, and your blade bites 1d8 harder

arts.name: Judgement Cut End
arts.text: at 10 Concentration: everything within 40 ft is cut — 10d10 (a nimble foe halves it) · Concentration falls to 5

quick.name: Trick
quick.text: vanish and reappear 20 ft toward your cursor (30 ft at 5+ Concentration) — or beside your marked foe (30 ft; 40 at 5+)

maximum.name: Maximum: Dimensional Judgement
maximum.text: a cut aimed at distance itself: a 180-ft line down your aim, 12d10 (a nimble foe halves it)

passives.name: Concentration
passives.text: Every weapon blow you land while unhurt for a moment raises Concentration (up to 10); being hit drops it by 2. Each point sharpens your blows.

passives.name: Focused Draw
passives.text: Once a round a weapon blow draws 1 CE for 1d8 more.

feats.name: Rapid Slash
feats.text: Teleportation with a follow-through: your first weapon hit within 2 s of a Trick also cleaves a second foe within 10 ft for half.

feats.name: Perfect Sheathe
feats.text: The kill is the technique: dropping a foe spends 2 Concentration on one perfect sheathe — foes within 10 ft that see it freeze for a round.

feats.name: Dark Slayer
feats.text: At full Concentration, once every 10 s a blow about to land meets only the air you left (1 CE): you Trick 30 ft away.

techniques.name: One-Winged Calamity
techniques.summary: A long blade, a single black wing, and despair as a resource — until a star is brought down on the field.

arts.name: Shadow Flare
arts.text: dark flame clings to the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 3d8, and a foe that can't shrug it off gains Despair

arts.name: Heartless Angel
arts.text: the foe at your cursor (60 ft): 6d10, and unless it's very tough it can't heal for a round, despairs, and hits softer

quick.name: One Wing
quick.text: for a minute a black wing unfolds: you fly, move faster, your blade bites 1d8 harder, and fear can't touch you

maximum.name: Maximum: Supernova
maximum.text: mark a 30-ft sphere at your cursor (150 ft): a round later it detonates — 14d10 and 2 Despair (a tough foe halves it, no Despair) · a heavy blow on you before then may break the charge

passives.name: Masamune
passives.text: Your melee weapons reach much farther. Once a round a weapon blow draws 1 CE for 1d8 more and drags the foe toward you.

passives.name: Despair
passives.text: Foes gain Despair (up to 3) when your magic overwhelms them: each point makes them hit 10% softer, and you hit them 5% harder.

feats.name: Long Blade
feats.text: Once a round, a melee blow carries on into a second foe within 15 ft of the first, for half.

feats.name: Chosen by Jenova
feats.text: Jenova's cells devour what would change you: immune to poison, venom, feral bites and petrification.

feats.name: Black Materia
feats.text: The ritual, insured: no blow can scatter a gathering Supernova.

techniques.name: Prime Conduit
techniques.summary: A living battery: drink the city's current, throw it back as bolts, shockwaves and storms — and never be fully empty while the grid still hums.

arts.name: Alpha Bolt
arts.text: 1 Charge: a bolt of lightning at your cursor (90 ft) — 2d8 (3d8 from 11th)

arts.name: Shockwave
arts.text: 1 Charge: a 30-ft cone of force — 3d8, and everything in it is thrown back (a strong foe holds)

arts.name: Discharge
arts.text: at 6+ Charge: everything within 20 ft takes 1d8 per 2 Charge (a tough foe halves it) — you're left empty

arts.name: Ionic Storm
arts.text: 6 Charge: the sky strikes the foe at your cursor — 12d10 (a nimble foe halves it), 4d10 to those beside it

quick.name: Drain
quick.text: beside wiring, in rain or a storm, you refill all your Charge · otherwise you leech the foe at your cursor (30 ft): 1d8 and 2 Charge

maximum.name: Maximum: Empire Thunderhead
maximum.text: 8 Charge: a storm over 60 ft — lightning strikes up to PB foes, 8d10 each in a 10-ft burst (a nimble foe halves it)

passives.name: Charge
passives.text: You hold up to level + CE mod Charge (twice that at 20th). Every bolt, wave and storm spends it.

passives.name: Thunder Drop
passives.text: With Charge in you, falls don't hurt you — a hard landing spends 1 Charge to shock everything within 10 ft (2d8).

feats.name: Conductive Arc
feats.text: Aim at the metal, not the man: Alpha Bolt on a wet or heavily armored foe arcs on to every foe within 15 ft of it, for half.

feats.name: Polarity Shift
feats.text: Once a round, a shot about to hit you is bent back (1 CE + 1 Charge): it strikes the nearest foe within 60 ft instead.

feats.name: Karmic Overload
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (2 CE, at 6+ Charge): everything at once — foes within 20 ft take 1d8 per Charge and are paralyzed for a round (a tough foe halves it and keeps moving). You're left empty.

techniques.name: Scarlet Bloom
techniques.summary: An undefeated blade that feeds on every clean cut, and a scarlet rot that blooms in whatever it touches.

arts.name: Waterfowl Dance
arts.text: three flurries on the foe at your cursor (15 ft): 2 Scarlet Dice each, and every one can steal life and plant rot

arts.name: Scarlet Aeonia
arts.text: a scarlet flower blooms at your cursor (60 ft): 6d8 in 20 ft, and two Rot Marks on everything in it

arts.name: Scarlet Wings
arts.text: Focus, 1 minute: you fly, and your weapon blows bite one Scarlet Die harder

quick.name: Kick of the Severed
quick.text: right after a weapon blow: the foe is kicked 10 ft back (a strong foe holds) · if you have 1 CE, it's spent to knock it down as well

passives.name: Blade Lifesteal
passives.text: Each weapon blow heals one Scarlet Die (1d6; 1d8 from 6th, 1d10 from 11th), up to PB dice a round — never above half your life until 11th.

passives.name: Rotting Edge
passives.text: A critical weapon blow plants a Rot Mark (up to 5). Every round, each mark rots its foe for 1d6.

passives.name: Flowing Sword
passives.text: While you fight in melee you move faster.

feats.name: Flowing Blade Disciple
feats.text: Moving fast through a foe's reach leaves an afterimage: once every 10 s, its blow strikes that instead.

feats.name: Waterfowl Savant
feats.text: Waterfowl Dance ends in a defensive spiral: for 2 s, half the melee blows on you miss.

feats.name: Rot-Petal Squall
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE, with Scarlet Wings spread): a rot-laden gust — foes within 15 ft gain a Rot Mark (a tough one resists).

domain.name: Haligtree of the Third Bloom
domain.sureHit: Aeonian Bloom: a scarlet flower opens under every chosen foe — 5d12 rot and 3d12 poison, two Rot Marks — and you drink a Scarlet Die from each

techniques.name: Style Devil
techniques.summary: Indecision, weaponized: switch styles, vary your attacks, and ride the Style Rank from Dull to Smokin' Sexy Style.

arts.name: Stinger
arts.text: a lunging thrust 30 ft along your aim: 2d8 to everything you pass

arts.name: Rain Storm
arts.text: you spin upside down and rain bullets: 4d6 to everything within 25 ft

arts.name: Million Stab
arts.text: a flurry at the foe at your cursor (15 ft): five thrusts of 1d10

quick.name: Devil Trigger
quick.text: for a minute: flight, blows land softer on you, you heal PB each round, and every hit is a little harder

maximum.name: Maximum: Sin Devil Trigger
maximum.text: for a minute your rank holds at SSS — and when it ends, Judgement: every foe within 30 ft takes 12d10 (a nimble foe halves it)

passives.name: Style Rank
passives.text: Land a different attack from the last and your rank climbs (D to SSS); repeat yourself and it slips, stop hitting for 5 s and it falls. Each rank: +6% damage.

passives.name: Styles (Technique Key 1)
passives.text: Swordmaster: weapon blows 1d8 harder · Gunslinger: ranged blows 1d8 harder · Trickster: faster, and a third of blows miss you · Royal Guard: blows land a third softer.

passives.name: Quadruple Style
passives.text: At SS and above you keep your previous Style's benefits as well.

feats.name: Enemy Step
feats.text: The enemy is terrain: once a round, a melee blow landed in the air springboards you off it, and the push-off may knock it down.

feats.name: Jackpot
feats.text: A critical ranged hit sprays: up to two other foes within 15 ft take half of it.

techniques.name: Twin Moon Armament
techniques.summary: One hand draws moonlight, the other living flame: alternate them in rhythm, store blades in the air, and raise twin moons over the field.

arts.name: Carian Phalanx
arts.text: every stored blade looses at foes near your cursor: 2 Twin Dice each

arts.name: Flame Spiral
arts.text: a spiral of flame around you (10 ft): 4 Twin Dice (a nimble foe halves it), then you dart 10 ft along your aim

arts.name: Carian Sovereignty
arts.text: a great cut at the foe at your cursor (20 ft): 8 Twin Dice — then a 30-ft cone of 4 Twin Dice

quick.name: Manifest Twin Blades
quick.text: for a minute your weapon blows alternate Moon and Flame, each a Twin Die (1d6; 1d8 from 6th, 1d10 from 11th) harder · switching within a second adds a die and stores a Carian Phalanx blade (up to PB)

maximum.name: Maximum: Twin Moons
maximum.text: you rise and raise two moons: three shockwaves around you (20 ft) — 4, 4, then 6 Twin Dice; foes caught are knocked down, and those caught twice are hurled up

passives.name: Knightly Footwork
passives.text: While your blades are out you're harder to hit.

feats.name: Carian Dueling Form
feats.text: Technique Key 1 (1 CE) marks the foe at your cursor as your duelist for 10 s: your blade blows on it add a Twin Die.

feats.name: Phalanx Reserve
feats.text: Your glintblades screen you: once a round, a shot about to hit you may be caught by one of them (about half the time), spending it.

techniques.name: Umbral Witchcraft
techniques.summary: Dance with gunfire for punctuation, dodge into Witch Time, and pay your infernal creditors in other people's pain.

arts.name: Infernal Summon
arts.text: one demon attack at the foe at your cursor (60 ft): Gomorrah's bite 6d10 · Madama's fist 5d10 and a launch · Phantasmaraneae's web 4d10 and bound

arts.name: Demon Masquerade
arts.text: for a minute you wear your chosen demon: you fly, blows land softer on you, and your blows bite 1d10 harder

arts.name: Umbran Climax
arts.text: spend 3 Tempo: for a round every weapon blow calls a Wicked Weave for free

quick.name: Witch Time
quick.text: a split-second dodge: a blow that lands in the next moment misses, every foe within 40 ft slows to a crawl for 2 s, and you gain Tempo (once a round)

maximum.name: Maximum: Infernal Finale
maximum.text: spend 5 Tempo: all three demons strike at once, each at a different foe near your cursor

passives.name: Bullet Arts
passives.text: Once a round, after a weapon blow, your guns fire a free shot (30 ft, 1d6).

passives.name: Wicked Weave
passives.text: Two weapon blows within a second call a giant infernal limb (2 CE): 3d10, and the foe is launched (a strong foe holds).

feats.name: Umbran Sidestep
feats.text: Your dodge carries you: triggering Witch Time also slips you 15 ft toward your aim.

feats.name: Moon of Mahaa-Kalaa
feats.text: A melee blow that triggers Witch Time is parried into another foe within 10 ft of the attacker (1 Tempo): it takes the full blow.

feats.name: Bat Within
feats.text: Once every 10 s, a blow that lands burst you into bats (1 Tempo): it lands at half, and you reform 15 ft away.

feats.name: Pure Platinum
feats.text: Once a minute, your Witch Time is flawless: the slow lasts twice as long.

classes.pitch: A brawler with the least CE: tough hide, harder melee, and a Fighting Focus that shrugs off blows and won't let you fall.

features.name: Thick Hide
features.text: +2 defense per mastery bonus (+4 at level 1, +12 at 17).

features.name: Combat Prowess
features.text: +5% melee damage per mastery bonus (+10% at level 1, +30% at 17).

features.name: Fighting Focus
features.text: Class Art: a minute of focus — 20% less damage taken, +15% melee damage, no knockback. Mastery-bonus uses per long rest.

features.name: Reckless Blows
features.text: Down + Class Art toggles it: +15% melee crit chance, but you take 15% more damage.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: +12% melee speed.

features.name: Pursuer
features.text: Entering Fighting Focus lunges you at the nearest foe.

features.name: Honed Instincts
features.text: The first blow you take after a quiet spell starts Fighting Focus on its own (if you have a use).

features.name: Brutal Blows
features.text: Melee criticals deal +25% more (+50% at 13, +75% at 17).

features.name: Lock In
features.text: In Fighting Focus, a killing blow leaves you at 1 life — always the first time; each time after is 25% less sure, until a long rest.

features.name: Curse Resistance
features.text: In Fighting Focus: immune to Cursed, Cursed Inferno, Shadowflame, Ichor, Darkness and Blackout.

features.name: Endless Focus
features.text: Fighting Focus doesn't run down while you're fighting; it ends once you're out of combat.

features.name: Unstoppable
features.text: +100 max life and +10% melee damage.

classes.pitch: Speed and evasion: faster on foot, a dash, wall-running, marking a foe's weak points, and dodging the blow that would have mattered.

features.name: Quick Strikes
features.text: +10% melee speed and +5% crit chance.

features.name: Unparalleled Movement
features.text: +15% move speed (+25% at 6, +35% at 10, +45% at 14, +55% at 18). From 9th: run up walls and across water.

features.name: Swift Movement
features.text: Class Art: a dash the way you're moving, and enemies lose track of you for a moment. Every 1.5 s.

features.name: Sharp Eyes
features.text: Down + Class Art: read the foe nearest your cursor for 8 s — your hits on it crit 20% more often. Every 10 s.

features.name: Eagle Eyes
features.text: You see every creature around you (Hunter).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.text: +10% attack speed.

features.name: Evasion
features.text: Shots and blasts hit you for 20% less (35% from 15th).

features.name: Tactical Retreat
features.text: When a foe touches you, you get +60% speed for 1.5 s (+120% from 15th).

features.name: Scanning Eyes
features.text: Sharp Eyes also shows the foe's life, defense and damage, and your hits on it ignore 10 defense.

features.name: Sixth Sense
features.text: Immune to Darkness, Blackout and Obstructed.

features.name: Swift Dodge
features.text: A blow of 10% of your life or more misses you entirely — half your mastery bonus times per long rest.

features.name: Unfathomable Speed
features.text: Swift Movement is ready twice as often, and nothing can slow you (Slow, Chilled, Frozen, Webbed).

classes.pitch: The soldier: steel body, more attacks every few levels, a second wind, and debuffs that slide off.

features.name: Steel Body
features.text: +2 defense per mastery bonus.

features.name: Combat Prowess
features.text: +5% melee damage per mastery bonus.

features.name: Undaunted
features.text: Class Art: a second wind — heal 8% of your max life, plus 1% per level. One charge, two from 10th; each comes back after 2 minutes.

features.name: Battle Readiness
features.text: The first blow you land after 10 s out of combat deals +50%.

features.name: Unstoppable
features.text: A harmful debuff that lands on you is shaken off at once — every 90 s (45 s from 13th).

features.name: Steel Spirit
features.text: Debuffs on you run out a third faster.

features.name: Unerring Blows
features.text: +10% crit chance.

classes.pitch: Fights beside a bound shikigami of its own: it strikes with you, guards you, and whisks you out of danger.

features.name: Shikigami Companion
features.text: Class Art: call your bound shikigami (free once per long rest, then 3 CE). It fights beside you until it falls or 10 minutes pass. Class Art again sends it at the foe nearest your cursor; Down + Class Art dismisses it.

features.name: Martial Arts
