features.text: +10% melee speed and +5% melee damage.

features.name: Coordinated Blow
features.text: When your weapon hits a foe, your companion leaps at it too (every 1.5 s).

features.name: Shikigami Improvement
features.text: Your companion can fly and strikes for 1d6 more. Choose its form in the book.

features.name: United Front
features.text: Once a second when you hit a foe near your companion: it adds 1d8 — or, when you're below 40% life, it throws the foe back instead.

features.name: Advanced Shikigami
features.text: It strikes for 1d6 more again. Choose its greater form in the book.

features.name: Close Bond
features.text: Your companion takes 2% less damage per mastery bonus, and once per long rest it survives a killing blow.

features.name: Swift Escape
features.text: A blow of 15% of your life or more is halved and your companion whisks you to its side — mastery-bonus times per long rest.

features.name: Perfected Bond
features.text: Your companion deals 25% more and moves 25% faster.

classes.pitch: Barriers and healing: the Curtain, a Barrier that stops shots and keeps foes out, and the strongest Reverse Cursed Technique.

features.name: Curtain
features.text: Class Art (5 CE): drop a Curtain — a black dome 120 tiles across for 10 minutes. Inside, the sky darkens, monsters come twice as fast, and you see every one of them.

features.name: Barrier Technique
features.text: Down + Class Art (up to your CE power in CE): a barrier dome around you, 2 tiles + 3 per CE in radius. Shots can't cross into it and foes are pushed out; each blocked blow wears it down (25% of your life per CE, 50% from 9th). Lasts CE-power minutes; from 15th, blows from outside wear it half as fast.

features.name: Reverse Cursed Technique
features.text: You know RCT, and it heals twice as much per CE.

features.name: Reverse Technique Understanding
features.text: RCT heals three times as much per CE, also heals the most hurt ally within 8 tiles, comes back twice as fast, and your Healing Reserve doubles.

features.name: Mastered Reverse Technique
features.text: RCT heals three and a half times as much per CE and comes back three times as fast; your Healing Reserve is four times as deep.

features.name: Permanent Techniques
features.text: Your Curtain and Barrier last three times as long.

classes.pitch: The deepest CE and the most control: a reserve to draw on, and modifications that bend every art you cast.

features.name: Quick Recovery
features.text: Class Art: draw on your latent reserve — regain half your level (rounded up) in CE at once. Once per long rest.

features.name: Technique Creativity
features.text: Pick two modifications in the book (a third at 10th, a fourth at 17th). Down + Class Art switches which one is on; while on, it bends every art you cast for its extra CE.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.text: Quick Recovery can be used twice per long rest.

features.name: Signature Move
features.text: Pick one of your technique's arts in the book (not the Maximum or Domain): it costs no CE.

classes.pitch: No cursed energy, no technique — a body built past every limit instead: strength, speed, toughness, and immunity to Domains.

features.name: Restrained Body
features.text: No cursed energy, technique, RCT or Black Flash — in exchange: +10% max life (+1% per level), +15% melee damage (+5% at 5, 9, 13 and 17), +2 defense per mastery bonus, you see every creature (Hunter) and in the dark (Night Owl), and poison wears off twice as fast.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.text: +30% move speed (+10% more at 6, 10, 14 and 18); run up walls and across water.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.text: +10% melee speed.

features.name: Body Improvements
features.text: One body point per level, spent in the book on strength, speed, durability and mind improvements.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.text: Choose one in the book (it improves at 14th).

features.name: Ideal
features.text: Choose Prideful or Vengeful in the book; each grows at 9th, 13th and 17th.

features.name: Improved Body
features.text: +10% melee damage and +5% move speed; immune to poison and venom.

features.name: Resistant
features.text: Shots and blasts hit you for 15% less (25% at 14, 35% at 20).

features.name: Weapon Specialist
features.text: Melee criticals deal +25% more (+50% at 13, +75% at 17).

features.name: Celestial Body
features.text: A Domain's guarantee can't find you: hostile sure-hits pass you by, and their barriers don't hold you in.

features.name: Improved Fighting Style
features.text: Your fighting style improves.

features.name: Demigod's Figure
features.text: You hold your breath twice as long and can't be suffocated.

features.name: God of War
features.text: +10% damage and attack speed, 15% less damage from contact, and once per long rest a killing blow leaves you at 1 life.

feats.name: Basic Curtain
feats.text: When a fight starts with no Curtain over you, one falls on its own (5 CE): a dark dome 120 tiles across for 10 minutes where monsters come twice as fast and every one of them shows.

feats.name: Barrier Intruder
feats.text: Hostile Domains and Barriers can't hold you in.

feats.name: Falling Blossom Emotion
feats.text: Caught in a hostile Domain, you shroud yourself on your own (4 CE): for a minute its sure-hits can't touch you. And every 10 s, the next blow that reaches you is answered first — a critical counterstrike, and you take none of it.

feats.name: Hollow Wicker Basket
feats.text: Caught in a hostile Domain, a 15-ft woven barrier rises around you on its own (4 CE) for a minute; no sure-hit lands on anyone inside it.

feats.name: Incomplete Domain
feats.text: Before your Domain unlocks (or if your technique has none), the Domain key opens an incomplete one (10 CE): barrier-less, 100 ft around where you stand, for a minute. No sure-hit, but inside it you count as in your own Domain (at half the boost). 30 s of Burnout after.

feats.name: Simple Domain
feats.text: You know Simple Domain at once (it otherwise comes from beating an invasion).

feats.name: Refined Domain
feats.text: Choose how your Domain is refined.
options: Severe Damnification: your sure-hits deal 25% more
Cost Reduction: inside your Domain, arts cost half (rounded up)
Lightning Speed Release: inside your Domain, arts come back twice as fast
Improved Technique: inside your Domain, your arts deal 20% more

feats.name: Bottomless Cursed Energy
feats.text: +2 max CE per level.

feats.name: Immense Cursed Energy
feats.text: + your CE power to max CE.

feats.name: Malevolent Cursed Energy
feats.text: When you're hit in a fight, your killing intent floods 100 ft on its own (3 CE, once a minute): foes caught in it hit 15% softer for a minute (bosses shrug it off more easily).

feats.name: Cursed Energy Perception
feats.text: You see every creature and sense danger (Hunter, Dangersense).

feats.name: Cursed Enhancement
feats.text: Your cursed energy runs through your weapons: +12% weapon damage while you have at least a quarter of your CE.

feats.name: Cursed Imbuement
feats.text: Your weapon blows deal +3% per point of CE power.

feats.name: Curse Enhanced Body
feats.text: +2 defense per point of CE power.

feats.name: Cursed Energy Slash
feats.text: Every 5 s, a melee swing also sends a huge slash of cursed energy along a 30-ft line toward your cursor (3 CE), from your weapon's damage.

feats.name: Improved Cursed Energy Output
feats.text: Your arts deal 10% more; and every 6 s, a heavy blow on you is cut by spending 1 CE.

feats.name: Cursed Energy Trait
feats.text: Your cursed energy takes on a quality.
options: Smooth: +3 defense, +5% move speed, and every 6 s a blow on you is cut 15% for 1 CE
Elemental: your fire, cold, lightning and poison arts deal 10% more

feats.name: Cursed Energy Trait Mastery
feats.text: Your trait at full strength — Rough: arts +18%. Smooth: +6 defense, +10% move speed, blows cut 25%. Elemental: your arts also leave their element on the foe (burning, frostburn, a jolt, venom, shadowflame, ichor).

feats.name: Cursed Projectiles
feats.text: Your bullets, arrows and thrown weapons deal 10% more and pierce 2 defense per mastery bonus.

feats.name: One In A Billion
feats.text: Your arts never roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die. Once per long rest, an art you can't afford goes off anyway — free, and at full damage.

feats.name: Chanting
feats.text: Stand still without attacking for 1.5 s and you chant. The next art within 10 s rolls double dice, reaches half again as far, and its blows ignore defense.

feats.name: Blessed by Black Sparks
feats.text: Black Flash is four times as likely.

feats.name: Shikigami Specialist
feats.text: Your shikigami (Ten Shadows, or a Shikigami User's companion) deal and endure 25% more.

feats.name: Athlete
feats.text: You jump higher, climb walls a little, and never take fall damage.

feats.name: Charger
feats.text: After a second at full sprint, your next melee blow deals 30% more and throws the foe back.

feats.name: Defensive Duelist
feats.text: Every 4 s, a blow that reaches you while you hold a melee weapon is halved.

feats.name: Durable
feats.text: +2 life per second.

feats.name: Crusher
feats.text: +25% knockback; your melee criticals stagger foes for a moment.

feats.name: Piercer
feats.text: Your criticals deal 20% more.

feats.name: Slasher
feats.text: Your melee blows shred armor (Ichor for 3 s).

feats.name: Fighting Initiate
feats.text: Learn a fighting style.
options: Great Weapon Fighting: +8% melee crit chance
Blind Fighting: immune to Darkness, Blackout and Obstructed

feats.name: Great Weapon Master
feats.text: +10% melee damage but -5% melee crit chance; a melee critical or kill gives +30% melee speed for 2 s.

feats.name: Mobile
feats.text: +15% move speed; blows that reach you mid-swing are cut 20%.

feats.name: Polearm Master
feats.text: Spears and lances deal 15% more.

feats.name: Resilient
feats.text: Debuffs on you run out a quarter faster.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.text: Your melee blows deal 6% more (the better of two rolls).

feats.name: Tough
feats.text: +1% max life per level.

feats.name: Alert
feats.text: Never caught off guard: the first blow after a quiet spell is halved.

feats.name: Chef
feats.text: Well Fed and its stronger forms last 50% longer.

feats.name: Elemental Adept
feats.text: Choose an element; your arts of it deal 10% more and pierce 10 defense.

feats.name: Gunner
feats.text: Guns deal 10% more and fire 10% faster.

feats.name: Healer
feats.text: Healing potions heal 25% more.

feats.name: Inspiring Leader
feats.text: You and allies within 50 tiles of you have +5% max life.

feats.name: Keen Mind
feats.text: You always know the time, your heading and your depth (watch, compass, depth meter).

feats.name: Mounted Combatant
feats.text: +15% damage while mounted.

feats.name: Poisoner
feats.text: Your weapon blows poison foes 20% of the time; poisoned foes take 10% more from you.

feats.name: Sharpshooter
feats.text: Ranged blows deal 10% more past 25 tiles, 20% more past 50.

feats.name: Skulker
feats.text: Enemies notice you less.

feats.name: Reverse Cursed Technique Output
feats.text: Your melee blows on zombies and skeletons burn with reversed energy: +2d8 (1 CE, once a second).

feats.name: Reverse Technique Prodigy
feats.text: Your RCT also heals the most hurt ally within 8 tiles, and comes back twice as fast.

feats.name: Six Eyes
feats.text: Your arts can cost a tenth of their CE: mastery-bonus times per long rest at first, once per level from 6th, always from 14th. You see every creature, the dark, and ore through rock. Without a Blindfold, each minute of fighting overloads your eyes: -10% damage per minute (up to 3), easing once the fight's over.
